#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-013 apply pack - correct the four wrong column names in section 8
    of tools\measure\Measure-PpiqT013Sources.ps1.

.DESCRIPTION
    THE DEFECT THIS FIXES IS MINE. Section 8 of the measurement script queried
    public.connection_profiles, public.import_batches and public.mapping_definitions
    using column names I GUESSED rather than read. psql returned three errors:

        ERROR:  column "profile_code" does not exist
        ERROR:  column "status_code" does not exist      (import_batches)
        ERROR:  column "status_code" does not exist      (mapping_definitions)

    The real names come from the entity classes under
    Backend\PlantProcess.Domain\Entities\Integration\, read for this pack:

        ConnectionProfile.cs   ConnectionProfileCode, ConnectionProfileName,
                               ProviderType, ConnectionMode, IsActive
        ImportBatch.cs         ImportBatchCode, SourceObjectName, Status, RowCount
        MappingDefinition.cs   MappingCode, TargetEntityName, MappingVersion, IsActive

    Sections 1 to 7 and 9 already succeeded and are NOT touched.

.PARAMETER ReportOnly
    Preflight and anchor verification only. Writes nothing.

.PARAMETER Revert
    Restore the target from the newest backup this pack created.

.PARAMETER SkipGate
    Apply and self-check, but do not re-run the measurement. Use only when the
    database is unreachable; the pack then reports UNGATED rather than PASS.

.NOTES
    Contract: preflight -> file report (hash, timestamp, line endings, non-ASCII)
    -> case-collision scan of this pack -> anchored verify with diagnosis ->
    timestamped backup -> apply -> edit count check -> on-disk self-check ->
    execution gate -> auto-revert on any failure.

    Run from the repository root.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert,
    [switch]$SkipGate
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$PackName   = "T-013-section8-columns"
$TargetRel  = "tools\measure\Measure-PpiqT013Sources.ps1"
$BackupRoot = "tools\packs"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- utilities

function Say {
    param([string]$Text)
    Write-Host $Text
}

function Rule {
    param([string]$Text)
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("=" * 78)
    Write-Host $Text
    Write-Host ("=" * 78)
}

function Count-NonAscii {
    param([string]$Text)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Text)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) {
        if ([int]$ch -gt 126) { $n = $n + 1 }
    }
    return $n
}

function Get-LineEndingStyle {
    param([string]$Text)
    $crlf = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "`r`n")).Count
    $lf   = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "`n")).Count - $crlf
    if ($crlf -gt 0 -and $lf -eq 0) { return "CRLF" }
    if ($lf   -gt 0 -and $crlf -eq 0) { return "LF" }
    if ($crlf -eq 0 -and $lf -eq 0) { return "NONE" }
    return ("MIXED (CRLF " + $crlf + " / LF " + $lf + ")")
}

function Read-Text {
    param([string]$Path)
    return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)
}

function Write-Text {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Text)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

function Get-Sha {
    param([string]$Path)
    return (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------- the edit set
# Every anchor is a SINGLE LINE. A single-line anchor cannot be defeated by a
# CRLF-against-LF mismatch, which is what has broken multi-line anchors before.

$Edits = @(
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Id  = "E1 connection_profiles column list"
        Old = "SELECT profile_code, display_name, provider_code, is_active"
        New = "SELECT connection_profile_code, connection_profile_name, provider_type, connection_mode, is_active"
    },
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Id  = "E2 connection_profiles ORDER BY"
        Old = "ORDER BY profile_code;"
        New = "ORDER BY connection_profile_code;"
    },
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Id  = "E3 import_batches status column"
        Old = "SELECT import_batch_code, source_object_name, status_code, row_count"
        New = "SELECT import_batch_code, source_object_name, status, row_count"
    },
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Id  = "E4 mapping_definitions status column"
        Old = "SELECT mapping_code, target_entity_name, status_code, is_active"
        New = "SELECT mapping_code, target_entity_name, mapping_version, is_active"
    }
)

Rule ("PPIQ APPLY PACK - " + $PackName)

$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
Say ("Repo root : " + $RepoRoot)

$TargetAbs = Join-Path $RepoRoot $TargetRel
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $TargetAbs)) {
    Say ("[FAIL] target not found: " + $TargetRel)
    Say "       Run this pack from the repository root."
    exit 2
}
Say ("Target    : " + $TargetRel)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- revert

if ($Revert) {
    Rule "REVERT"
    $pattern = "_backup_" + $PackName + "_*"
    $backups = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRoot $BackupRoot) -Directory -Filter $pattern -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                 Sort-Object Name -Descending)
    if ($backups.Count -eq 0) {
        Say "[FAIL] no backup from this pack was found. Nothing to revert."
        exit 3
    }
    $newest = $backups[0]
    $saved  = Join-Path $newest.FullName "Measure-PpiqT013Sources.ps1"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $saved)) {
        Say ("[FAIL] backup folder exists but the file is missing: " + $saved)
        exit 3
    }
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $saved -Destination $TargetAbs -Force
    Say ("[OK] restored from " + $newest.Name)
    Say ("     target SHA now " + (Get-Sha $TargetAbs).Substring(0, 16) + "...")
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- preflight

Rule "PREFLIGHT - FILE REPORT"

$original = Read-Text $TargetAbs
$item     = Get-Item -LiteralPath $TargetAbs

Say ("SHA256        : " + (Get-Sha $TargetAbs))
Say ("Modified      : " + $item.LastWriteTime.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"))
Say ("Bytes         : " + $item.Length)
Say ("Line endings  : " + (Get-LineEndingStyle $original))
Say ("Non-ASCII     : " + (Count-NonAscii $original))

# --------------------------------------- case-collision scan on THIS pack
# PowerShell variable names are case-insensitive, so $E and $e are one
# variable. A foreach whose loop variable collides with its own array
# destroys the array on the first iteration and the loop still completes.
# Comments are stripped first so a comment mentioning a name cannot fire.

Rule "PREFLIGHT - CASE-COLLISION SCAN OF THIS PACK"

$selfPath = $PSCommandPath
$selfText = Read-Text $selfPath
$selfCode = (($selfText -split "`n") | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace '#.*$', '' }) -join "`n"
$names    = @([regex]::Matches($selfCode, '\$([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value })
$groups   = $names | Group-Object { $_.ToLowerInvariant() }
$collide  = @($groups | Where-Object { (@($_.Group | Sort-Object -Unique)).Count -gt 1 })

if ($collide.Count -gt 0) {
    Say "[FAIL] case-collision detected in this pack's own variable names:"
    foreach ($c in $collide) {
        Say ("       " + (($c.Group | Sort-Object -Unique) -join ", "))
    }
    Say "       Rename before running. A guard taught exceptions stops being a guard."
    exit 4
}
Say ("[OK] " + (@($groups)).Count + " distinct variable names, zero case collisions.")

# ----------------------------------------------------- anchor verification

Rule "ANCHOR VERIFICATION"

$anchorFail = 0
foreach ($ed in $Edits) {
    $hits = ([regex]::Matches($original, [regex]::Escape($ed.Old))).Count
    if ($hits -eq 1) {
        Say ("[OK]      " + $ed.Id)
    } else {
        $anchorFail = $anchorFail + 1
        Say ("[MISSING] " + $ed.Id + "  (matched " + $hits + " times, expected 1)")

        # Diagnosis printed from REAL BYTES, never from a guess.
        $probe = ($ed.Old -split '\s+')[0..2] -join ' '
        $near  = ([regex]::Matches($original, [regex]::Escape($probe))).Count
        Say ("          probe '" + $probe + "' appears " + $near + " times")
        if ($near -gt 0) {
            $idx  = $original.IndexOf($probe)
            $from = [Math]::Max(0, $idx - 40)
            $len  = [Math]::Min(180, $original.Length - $from)
            $seg  = $original.Substring($from, $len)
            Say  "          actual bytes around the first probe hit:"
            Say ("          " + ($seg -replace "`r", "<CR>" -replace "`n", "<LF>"))
        } else {
            Say "          the statement is absent entirely - wrong file or already edited."
        }

        # Has this edit already been applied?
        if ($original.Contains($ed.New)) {
            Say "          NOTE: the REPLACEMENT text is already present. This edit looks applied."
        }
    }
}

if ($anchorFail -gt 0) {
    Say ""
    Say ("[STOP] " + $anchorFail + " of " + $Edits.Count + " anchors did not verify. Nothing was written.")
    exit 5
}
Say ""
Say ("[OK] all " + $Edits.Count + " anchors verified exactly once.")

if ($ReportOnly) {
    Rule "REPORT ONLY - NOTHING WRITTEN"
    Say "Re-run without -ReportOnly to apply."
    exit 0
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ backup

Rule "BACKUP"

$stamp     = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$backupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot (Join-Path $BackupRoot ("_backup_" + $PackName + "_" + $stamp))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDir -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $TargetAbs -Destination (Join-Path $backupDir "Measure-PpiqT013Sources.ps1") -Force
Say ("[OK] " + $backupDir.Substring($RepoRoot.Length + 1))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- apply

Rule "APPLY"

$updated = $original
$applied = 0
foreach ($ed in $Edits) {
    $before = $updated
    $updated = $updated.Replace($ed.Old, $ed.New)
    if ($updated -ne $before) {
        $applied = $applied + 1
        Say ("[EDIT] " + $ed.Id)
    } else {
        Say ("[NOOP] " + $ed.Id + " - text did not change")
    }
}

if ($applied -ne $Edits.Count) {
    Say ""
    Say ("[FAIL] " + $applied + " of " + $Edits.Count + " edits changed the text. Rolling back.")
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $backupDir "Measure-PpiqT013Sources.ps1") -Destination $TargetAbs -Force
    Say "[OK] reverted. A pack that applies some of its edits is a pack that applies none."
    exit 6
}

Write-Text $TargetAbs $updated
Say ""
Say ("[OK] " + $applied + " of " + $Edits.Count + " edits written.")
Say ("     new SHA256   " + (Get-Sha $TargetAbs))
Say ("     line endings " + (Get-LineEndingStyle (Read-Text $TargetAbs)))
Say ("     non-ASCII    " + (Count-NonAscii (Read-Text $TargetAbs)))

# -------------------------------------------------------- on-disk self-check

Rule "SELF-CHECK ON DISK"

$disk      = Read-Text $TargetAbs
$checkFail = 0

foreach ($ed in $Edits) {
    if ($disk.Contains($ed.New)) {
        Say ("[OK]   present : " + $ed.Id)
    } else {
        $checkFail = $checkFail + 1
        Say ("[FAIL] missing : " + $ed.Id)
    }
    if ($disk.Contains($ed.Old)) {
        $checkFail = $checkFail + 1
        Say ("[FAIL] the OLD text survives for " + $ed.Id)
    }
}

# The three names psql rejected must not appear anywhere in the target.
foreach ($dead in @("status_code", "display_name", "provider_code")) {
    $n = ([regex]::Matches($disk, [regex]::Escape($dead))).Count
    if ($n -eq 0) {
        Say ("[OK]   absent  : " + $dead)
    } else {
        $checkFail = $checkFail + 1
        Say ("[FAIL] rejected column name still present " + $n + " times: " + $dead)
    }
}

# 'profile_code' must survive only inside 'connection_profile_code'.
$bare = ([regex]::Matches($disk, '(?<!connection_)profile_code')).Count
if ($bare -eq 0) {
    Say "[OK]   absent  : bare profile_code"
} else {
    $checkFail = $checkFail + 1
    Say ("[FAIL] bare profile_code still present " + $bare + " times")
}

if ((Count-NonAscii $disk) -gt 0) {
    $checkFail = $checkFail + 1
    Say "[FAIL] the edited file contains non-ASCII characters"
}

if ($checkFail -gt 0) {
    Say ""
    Say ("[FAIL] " + $checkFail + " self-check failures. Reverting.")
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $backupDir "Measure-PpiqT013Sources.ps1") -Destination $TargetAbs -Force
    Say "[OK] reverted."
    exit 7
}
Say ""
Say "[OK] self-check clean."

# -------------------------------------------------------------------- gate

if ($SkipGate) {
    Rule "GATE SKIPPED - RESULT IS UNGATED, NOT PASSED"
    Say "The edits are on disk and self-checked, but nothing has proved they run."
    Say "Re-run without -SkipGate once the database is reachable."
    exit 0
}

Rule "GATE - RE-RUN THE MEASUREMENT AND PROVE SECTION 8"
Say "Where the artifact is executable, execution is the only authority."
Say "A string check proves the text changed; only a run proves the query works."
Say ""

$prevConsoleEnc = [Console]::OutputEncoding
$prevOutputEnc  = $OutputEncoding
$captured       = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$gateExit       = 1

try {
    [Console]::OutputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    $OutputEncoding           = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

    & $TargetAbs 2>&1 | ForEach-Object {
        $line = [string]$_
        Write-Host $line
        [void]$captured.Add($line)
    }
    $gateExit = $LASTEXITCODE
}
finally {
    [Console]::OutputEncoding = $prevConsoleEnc
    $OutputEncoding           = $prevOutputEnc
}

$all      = ($captured -join "`n")
$sqlError = ([regex]::Matches($all, '(?i)ERROR:\s+column')).Count
$anyError = ([regex]::Matches($all, '(?i)^psql:.*ERROR:', [System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Multiline)).Count

Rule "GATE RESULT"
Say ("measurement exit      : " + $gateExit)
Say ("column errors in run  : " + $sqlError)
Say ("any psql errors       : " + $anyError)

if ($gateExit -ne 0 -or $sqlError -gt 0 -or $anyError -gt 0) {
    Say ""
    Say "[FAIL] the gate did not pass. Reverting."
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $backupDir "Measure-PpiqT013Sources.ps1") -Destination $TargetAbs -Force

[FILE_START]

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-014 apply pack - make the capture script honour an absolute -OutDir
    and refuse to report success when it has written nothing.

.DESCRIPTION
    TWO DEFECTS, BOTH MINE.

    D7  -OutDir is joined to the repository root unconditionally:
            $outFolder = Join-Path $repoRoot $OutDir
        Join-Path does not detect an absolute second argument, so when the proof
        runner passes a scratch folder under TEMP the script builds
        'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ\C:\Users\...' and the evidence lands
        nowhere the caller looks. Fixed by testing IsPathRooted first.

    D8  The script ends with an unconditional 'exit 0'. It printed
        '[OK] Capture profile written' and returned success while the write had
        failed. That is the same fault as the gate that passed while blind: a
        step reporting OK without checking its own output exists. The final
        block now re-reads the file it claims to have written and fails if it is
        absent or empty.

.PARAMETER ReportOnly
    Preflight and anchor verification only. Writes nothing.

.PARAMETER Revert
    Restore from the newest backup this pack created.

.NOTES
    Run from the repository root.
#>

    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

$TargetRel = "tools\measure\Measure-PpiqT014Capture.ps1"
$FileName  = "Measure-PpiqT014Capture.ps1"
$BackupRoot = "tools\packs"

function Say  { param([string]$T) Write-Host $T }
function Rule { param([string]$T) Write-Host ""; Write-Host ("=" * 78); Write-Host $T; Write-Host ("=" * 78) }

function Count-NonAscii {
    param([string]$Text)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Text)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 126) { $n = $n + 1 } }
    return $n
}

    Say "[OK] reverted."

# ============================================================== THE REAL GATE
Rule "GATE - RUN THE CAPTURE WITH BOTH STREAMS ON DISK"

Say "writes to the HOST, not the pipeline, so it captured nothing and passed"

$gDir = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("ppiq_t014_gate_" + $stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $gDir -Force | Out-Null
$gOut = Join-Path $gDir "stdout.txt"
$gErr = Join-Path $gDir "stderr.txt"

$before = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRoot "docs\m1\evidence") `
            -Filter "T-014_capture_profile_*.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)

$p = Start-Process -FilePath "powershell.exe" `
        -ArgumentList @("-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", $TargetAbs) `
        -WorkingDirectory $RepoRoot -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru `
        -RedirectStandardOutput $gOut -RedirectStandardError $gErr
$gExit = $p.ExitCode

$soText = ""
$seText = ""
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $gOut) { $soText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($gOut) }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $gErr) { $seText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($gErr) }

if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($soText)) {
    Say "--- child stdout ---"
    Say $soText
}
if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($seText)) {
    Say "--- child stderr ---"
    Say $seText
}

$both  = $soText + "`n" + $seText
$sqlEr = ([regex]::Matches($both, '(?i)(ERROR|FATAL):')).Count

$after = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRoot "docs\m1\evidence") `
           -Filter "T-014_capture_profile_*.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
           Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending)

$evPath = ""
$dRows  = 0
$eRows  = 0
if ($after.Count -gt $before.Count -and $after.Count -gt 0) {
    $evPath = $after[0].FullName
    $ev = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($evPath)

    # Count psql's OWN '(N rows)' footer inside each section slice. Matching row
    # SHAPES is fragile: the first version anchored with '$' after a pipe, and the
    # evidence file is CRLF, so the carriage return sat between them and every
    # Section D row failed to match while Section E - which had no anchor - counted
    # fine. The footer is emitted by psql itself and needs no shape assumption.
    function Get-SectionRows {
        param([string]$Text, [string]$FromMarker, [string]$ToMarker)
        $a = $Text.IndexOf($FromMarker)
        if ($a -lt 0) { return -1 }
        $b = $Text.IndexOf($ToMarker, $a)
        if ($b -lt 0) { $b = $Text.Length }
        $slice = $Text.Substring($a, $b - $a)
        $total = 0
        foreach ($m in [regex]::Matches($slice, '\((\d+) rows?\)')) {
            $total = $total + [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
        }
        return $total
    }

    $dRows = Get-SectionRows -Text $ev -FromMarker 'SECTION D - COMPLETE CATEGORICAL' -ToMarker 'SECTION E - IDENTIFIER SHAPE'
    $eRows = Get-SectionRows -Text $ev -FromMarker 'SECTION E - IDENTIFIER SHAPE'   -ToMarker 'SECTION F - PARENT-CHILD'
}

Rule "GATE RESULT"
Say ("capture exit     : " + $gExit)
Say ("ERROR or FATAL   : " + $sqlEr)
Say ("evidence file    : " + $(if ($evPath -eq "") { "NOT PRODUCED" } else { Split-Path $evPath -Leaf }))
Say ("Section D rows   : " + $dRows)
Say ("Section E rows   : " + $eRows)

$gFail = 0
if ($gExit -ne 0)      { $gFail = $gFail + 1; Say "[FAIL] capture exited non-zero" }
if ($sqlEr -gt 0)      { $gFail = $gFail + 1; Say "[FAIL] an ERROR or FATAL reached a stream" }
if ($evPath -eq "")    { $gFail = $gFail + 1; Say "[FAIL] no new evidence file was produced" }
if ($dRows -lt 0)      { $gFail = $gFail + 1; Say "[FAIL] Section D marker not found in the evidence file" }
elseif ($dRows -lt 40) { $gFail = $gFail + 1; Say "[FAIL] Section D returned $dRows rows, expected 40 or more" }
if ($eRows -lt 0)      { $gFail = $gFail + 1; Say "[FAIL] Section E marker not found in the evidence file" }
elseif ($eRows -lt 6)  { $gFail = $gFail + 1; Say "[FAIL] Section E returned $eRows rows, expected 6 or more" }

if ($gFail -gt 0) {
    Say ""
    Say ("[FAIL] " + $gFail + " gate failures. Reverting.")
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $backupDir $FileName) -Destination $TargetAbs -Force
    Say "[OK] reverted."
    exit 8
}

Rule "PASS"
Say ("Target   : " + $TargetRel)
Say ("SHA256   : " + (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $TargetAbs -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)
Say ("Backup   : " + $backupDir.Substring($RepoRoot.Length + 1))
Say ("Evidence : " + (Split-Path $evPath -Leaf))
Say ""
Say "All nine sections returned data and no stream carried an error."
Say ""
Say "  Remove-Item docs\m1\evidence\T-014_capture_profile_20260803_183731.txt"
Say "  Remove-Item docs\m1\evidence\T-014_capture_profile_20260803_184956.txt"

Say "  git commit -m ""T-014: fix Section D XML root and replace the blind gate"""
exit 0

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-014 - emit the three missing row-level standard deviations the frozen
    comparator specification requires.

.DESCRIPTION
    Comparator specification v2 section 3.5 defines the near-zero floor as
    4 * sd_underlying / sqrt(n), where sd_underlying is the captured standard
    deviation of the ROW-LEVEL DERIVED METRIC. It then claims every one of the
    six cases is already emitted by the capture profile.

    THAT CLAIM IS WRONG FOR THREE OF THE SIX, AND THE ERROR IS MINE.
    The deviation metrics do carry their standard deviation - sd_thk_dev,
    sd_wid_dev and sd_fdt_dev sit beside their means. The three RATIO metrics do
    not: implied slab density, coil-to-slab weight and heat-to-slabs weight are
    emitted as min, avg and max only.

    The specification's own clause governs: "Where a future aggregate has no
    captured row-level SD, the capture profile is extended to emit one BEFORE
    that aggregate is compared." This pack is that extension. The frozen document
    is not altered.

    After this pack the CAPTURED REFERENCE PROFILE MUST BE REGENERATED, because
    the reference must carry the columns the comparator reads. The underlying
    data is unchanged, so the regenerated profile differs only by three added
    columns.

.PARAMETER ReportOnly
    Preflight and anchor verification only. Writes nothing.

.PARAMETER Revert
    Restore from the newest backup this pack created.

.NOTES
    Run from the repository root.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]

    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

function Count-NonAscii {
    param([string]$Text)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Text)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 126) { $n = $n + 1 } }
    return $n
}

Rule ("PPIQ APPLY PACK - " + $PackName)

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Id  = "R1 implied slab density gains sd_density"
        Old = @'
SELECT round(min(weight_kg / NULLIF(width_mm*thickness_mm*length_mm/1e9, 0)), 1) AS min_density,
       round(avg(weight_kg / NULLIF(width_mm*thickness_mm*length_mm/1e9, 0)), 1) AS avg_density,
       round(max(weight_kg / NULLIF(width_mm*thickness_mm*length_mm/1e9, 0)), 1) AS max_density

        New = @'
SELECT round(min(weight_kg / NULLIF(width_mm*thickness_mm*length_mm/1e9, 0)), 1) AS min_density,
       round(avg(weight_kg / NULLIF(width_mm*thickness_mm*length_mm/1e9, 0)), 1) AS avg_density,
       round(max(weight_kg / NULLIF(width_mm*thickness_mm*length_mm/1e9, 0)), 1) AS max_density,
       round(coalesce(stddev_samp(weight_kg / NULLIF(width_mm*thickness_mm*length_mm/1e9, 0)), 0), 1) AS sd_density
FROM src_caster_oracle_shape.cast_pieces;
'@
    },
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Id  = "R2 coil-to-slab weight ratio gains sd_ratio"
        Old = @'
SELECT round(min(c.coil_weight_kg / NULLIF(p.weight_kg,0))::numeric, 4) AS min_ratio,
       round(avg(c.coil_weight_kg / NULLIF(p.weight_kg,0))::numeric, 4) AS avg_ratio,

        New = @'

       round(avg(c.coil_weight_kg / NULLIF(p.weight_kg,0))::numeric, 4) AS avg_ratio,
       round(max(c.coil_weight_kg / NULLIF(p.weight_kg,0))::numeric, 4) AS max_ratio,
       round(coalesce(stddev_samp(c.coil_weight_kg / NULLIF(p.weight_kg,0)), 0)::numeric, 4) AS sd_ratio

       round(coalesce(stddev_samp(ratio), 0),4) AS sd_ratio

'@

    else { Say ("[NOOP] " + $e.Id) }
}
if ($applied -ne $Edits.Count) {

$gOut = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("ppiq_ratio_sd_" + $stamp + "_out.txt")
$gErr = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("ppiq_ratio_sd_" + $stamp + "_err.txt")

        -ArgumentList @("-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", $TargetAbs) `

[FILE_START]
[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\Apply-PpiqT014CaptureSectionJ.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=325, SizeKB=13.93, SHA256='55A4D706A00F22E6EFE3C1649A3299CE6538C4D8D4D1C922CBA3DD6BFC3973ED', Modified='2026-08-04 00:06:10']

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-014 - add SECTION J, the process interval distributions, to the
    capture profile. Required by comparator specification v2.1 section 3.6.

.DESCRIPTION
    v2.1 replaced the timestamp rule. Absolute min_ts and max_ts become a horizon
    containment check; what is compared instead is the PROCESS INTERVAL - the
    generating relationship. Both the captured and the regenerated profile must
    therefore carry those intervals, so the capture script emits them.

    Section J emits one row per interval with count, min, p10, p25, p50, p75,
    p90, max, mean, standard deviation and distinct count. The comparator then
    applies the already frozen rules: an interval whose captured standard
    deviation is 0 is compared EXACTLY, and every other interval is compared as a
    distribution under sections 3.1 to 3.4.

    Twenty-five intervals, covering every stage transition and every source
    update lag. Two of them are known to be deterministic and will be compared
    exactly: the pass sample offset per stand, and the QA sample lag.

    THE GENERATOR IS NOT CHANGED BY THIS PACK AND THE SEED IS NOT CHANGED.

    After this pack the CAPTURED REFERENCE PROFILE IS REGENERATED, because the
    reference must carry the section the comparator reads.

.PARAMETER ReportOnly
    Preflight and anchor verification only. Writes nothing.

.PARAMETER Revert
    Restore from the newest backup this pack created.

.NOTES
    Run from the repository root.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$PackName   = "T-014-capture-section-j"
$TargetRel  = "tools\measure\Measure-PpiqT014Capture.ps1"
$FileName   = "Measure-PpiqT014Capture.ps1"
$BackupRoot = "tools\packs"

function Say  { param([string]$T) Write-Host $T }
function Rule { param([string]$T) Write-Host ""; Write-Host ("=" * 78); Write-Host $T; Write-Host ("=" * 78) }
function Count-NonAscii {
    param([string]$Text)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Text)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 126) { $n = $n + 1 } }
    return $n
}

Rule ("PPIQ APPLY PACK - " + $PackName)
$RepoRoot  = (Get-Location).Path
$TargetAbs = Join-Path $RepoRoot $TargetRel
Say ("Repo root : " + $RepoRoot)
Say ("Target    : " + $TargetRel)
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $TargetAbs)) { Say "[FAIL] target not found."; exit 2 }

if ($Revert) {
    Rule "REVERT"
    $b = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRoot $BackupRoot) -Directory `
           -Filter ("_backup_" + $PackName + "_*") -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
           Sort-Object Name -Descending)
    if ($b.Count -eq 0) { Say "[FAIL] no backup from this pack."; exit 3 }
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $b[0].FullName $FileName) -Destination $TargetAbs -Force
    Say ("[OK] restored from " + $b[0].Name)
    exit 0
}

Rule "PREFLIGHT"
$original = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($TargetAbs)
Say ("SHA256    : " + (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $TargetAbs -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)
Say ("Bytes     : " + (Get-Item -LiteralPath $TargetAbs).Length)
Say ("Non-ASCII : " + (Count-NonAscii $original))

$Anchor = @'
\qecho
\qecho ================================================================
\qecho END OF CAPTURE PROFILE
\qecho ================================================================
'@ -replace "`r`n", "`n"

$SectionJ = @'
\qecho
\qecho ================================================================
\qecho SECTION J - PROCESS INTERVAL DISTRIBUTIONS
\qecho THIS IS WHAT THE TIMESTAMP COMPARISON READS. sd 0 MEANS THE
\qecho INTERVAL IS DETERMINISTIC AND IS COMPARED EXACTLY.
\qecho ================================================================
WITH iv AS (
    SELECT 'A01_heat_cadence' AS interval_name,
           EXTRACT(epoch FROM (tap_start_utc - lag(tap_start_utc) OVER (ORDER BY tap_start_utc))) AS s
    FROM src_meltshop_pg.heats
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'A02_tap_duration', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (tap_end_utc - tap_start_utc))
    FROM src_meltshop_pg.heats
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'A03_heat_update_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (source_updated_at_utc - tap_end_utc))
    FROM src_meltshop_pg.heats
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'B01_lf_start_offset', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (l.treatment_start_utc - h.tap_start_utc))
    FROM src_meltshop_pg.lf_treatment l
    JOIN src_meltshop_pg.heats h ON h.heat_no = l.heat_no
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'B02_lf_duration', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (treatment_end_utc - treatment_start_utc))
    FROM src_meltshop_pg.lf_treatment
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'B03_lf_update_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (source_updated_at_utc - treatment_end_utc))
    FROM src_meltshop_pg.lf_treatment
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'C01_seq_start_offset', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (q.start_time - h.tap_start_utc))
    FROM src_caster_oracle_shape.cast_sequence q
    JOIN src_caster_oracle_shape.cast_pieces p ON p.sequence_no = q.sequence_no AND p.slab_no = 1
    JOIN src_meltshop_pg.heats h ON h.heat_no = p.heat_no
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'C02_seq_duration', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (end_time - start_time))
    FROM src_caster_oracle_shape.cast_sequence
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'C03_seq_update_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (last_update_ts - end_time))
    FROM src_caster_oracle_shape.cast_sequence
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'C04_cut_step_per_slab',
           EXTRACT(epoch FROM (p.cut_time - q.start_time)) / p.slab_no
    FROM src_caster_oracle_shape.cast_pieces p
    JOIN src_caster_oracle_shape.cast_sequence q ON q.sequence_no = p.sequence_no
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'C05_piece_update_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (last_update_ts - cut_time))
    FROM src_caster_oracle_shape.cast_pieces
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'D01_rolling_lag_from_tap', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (c.rolling_start_time - h.tap_start_utc))
    FROM src_hsm_oracle_shape.hsm_coils c
    JOIN src_meltshop_pg.heats h ON h.heat_no = c.heat_no
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'D02_rolling_duration', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (rolling_end_time - rolling_start_time))
    FROM src_hsm_oracle_shape.hsm_coils
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'D03_coil_update_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (last_update_ts - rolling_end_time))
    FROM src_hsm_oracle_shape.hsm_coils
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'E01_pass_offset_per_stand',
           EXTRACT(epoch FROM (m.sample_time - c.rolling_start_time)) / m.stand_no
    FROM src_hsm_oracle_shape.hsm_pass_measurements m
    JOIN src_hsm_oracle_shape.hsm_coils c ON c.coil_id = m.coil_id
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'E02_pass_update_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (last_update_ts - sample_time))
    FROM src_hsm_oracle_shape.hsm_pass_measurements
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F01_pkl_entry_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (o.entry_time_utc - c.rolling_end_time))
    FROM src_pkl_mssql_shape.pickle_orders o
    JOIN src_hsm_oracle_shape.hsm_coils c ON c.coil_id = o.coil_id
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F02_pkl_duration', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (exit_time_utc - entry_time_utc))
    FROM src_pkl_mssql_shape.pickle_orders
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F03_pkl_update_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (modified_at_utc - exit_time_utc))
    FROM src_pkl_mssql_shape.pickle_orders
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'G01_qa_sample_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (r.sample_time_utc - o.exit_time_utc))
    FROM src_pkl_mssql_shape.qa_lab_results r
    JOIN src_pkl_mssql_shape.pickle_orders o ON o.coil_id = r.coil_id
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'G02_qa_update_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (modified_at_utc - sample_time_utc))
    FROM src_pkl_mssql_shape.qa_lab_results
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'H01_defect_lag_from_rolling', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (d.event_time_utc - c.rolling_start_time))
    FROM src_inspection_mysql_shape.parsytec_surface_defects d
    JOIN src_hsm_oracle_shape.hsm_coils c ON c.coil_id = d.coil_id
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'H02_defect_update_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (updated_at_utc - event_time_utc))
    FROM src_inspection_mysql_shape.parsytec_surface_defects
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'I01_downtime_span', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (end_time_utc - start_time_utc))
    FROM src_inspection_mysql_shape.downtime_events
  UNION ALL
    SELECT 'I02_downtime_update_lag', EXTRACT(epoch FROM (updated_at_utc - end_time_utc))
    FROM src_inspection_mysql_shape.downtime_events
)
SELECT interval_name,
       count(*) AS observations,
       round(min(s)::numeric, 3) AS min_s,
       round(percentile_cont(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s)::numeric, 3) AS p10,
       round(percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s)::numeric, 3) AS p25,
       round(percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s)::numeric, 3) AS p50,
       round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s)::numeric, 3) AS p75,
       round(percentile_cont(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s)::numeric, 3) AS p90,
       round(max(s)::numeric, 3) AS max_s,
       round(avg(s)::numeric, 3) AS mean_s,
       round(coalesce(stddev_samp(s), 0)::numeric, 3) AS sd_s,
       count(DISTINCT s) AS distinct_values
FROM iv
WHERE s IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY interval_name
ORDER BY interval_name;

'@ -replace "`r`n", "`n"

Rule "ANCHOR VERIFICATION"
$hits = ([regex]::Matches($original, [regex]::Escape($Anchor))).Count

    Say ("[MISSING] the END OF CAPTURE PROFILE block matched " + $hits + " times, expected 1")

    exit 5
}

    exit 6

Say ("     new SHA256 " + (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $TargetAbs -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)
Say ("     non-ASCII  " + (Count-NonAscii $updated))

$cFail = 0

    Say ("[FAIL] " + $cFail + " self-check failures. Reverting.")
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $backupDir $FileName) -Destination $TargetAbs -Force
    exit 7
}
Say ""
Say "[OK] self-check clean."

Rule "GATE - REGENERATE THE CAPTURED REFERENCE"
$gOut = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("ppiq_secj_" + $stamp + "_out.txt")
$gErr = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("ppiq_secj_" + $stamp + "_err.txt")
$p = Start-Process -FilePath "powershell.exe" `
        -ArgumentList @("-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", $TargetAbs) `
        -WorkingDirectory $RepoRoot -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru `
        -RedirectStandardOutput $gOut -RedirectStandardError $gErr
$so = ""
$se = ""
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $gOut) { $so = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($gOut) }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $gErr) { $se = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($gErr) }
if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($se)) { Say "--- stderr ---"; Say $se }
$errs = ([regex]::Matches($so + "`n" + $se, '(?i)(ERROR|FATAL):')).Count

$newest = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRoot "docs\m1\evidence") `
            -Filter "T-014_capture_profile_*.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending)
$rows = 0
$det = ""
if ($newest.Count -gt 0) {
    $txt = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($newest[0].FullName)
    $i = $txt.IndexOf("SECTION J - PROCESS INTERVAL")
    if ($i -ge 0) {
        $slice = $txt.Substring($i)
        $m = [regex]::Match($slice, '\((\d+) rows?\)')
        if ($m.Success) { $rows = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value }
        foreach ($nm in @("A01_heat_cadence", "E01_pass_offset_per_stand", "G01_qa_sample_lag")) {

            if ($lm.Success) { $det = $det + "`n     " + $lm.Value.Trim() }
        }
    }
}

if ($newest.Count -gt 0) { Say ("new reference   : " + $newest[0].Name + "  (" + $newest[0].Length + " bytes)") }

Say "  git commit -m ""T-014: comparator spec v2.1, capture emits section J process intervals"""
exit 0

function Count-NonAscii {
    param([string]$Text)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Text)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 126) { $n = $n + 1 } }
    return $n
}

function Get-Eol {
    param([string]$Text)
    if (([regex]::Matches($Text, "`r`n")).Count -gt 0) { return "CRLF" }
    return "LF"
}

function Find-Line {
    # Returns an ARRAY always. PowerShell unrolls a one-element array and an
    # empty array on return, so a bare 'return $hits' yields an int or $null and
    # reading .Count on it throws under StrictMode. The leading comma prevents
    # the unroll; the caller also wraps in @() so neither end can regress.
    param([string[]]$Lines, [string]$Exact)
    $hits = @()
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Lines.Count; $i++) {
        if ($Lines[$i] -eq $Exact) { $hits += $i }
    }
    return ,$hits
}

$sentinels = @(
    [pscustomobject]@{ Key = "DO_START";  Text = 'DO $do$' },
    [pscustomobject]@{ Key = "DO_END";    Text = 'END $do$;' },
    [pscustomobject]@{ Key = "SEC_D_START"; Text = 'SELECT s AS schema_name, t AS table_name, k AS column_name, value, occurrences,' },
    [pscustomobject]@{ Key = "SEC_D_END";   Text = 'ORDER BY s, t, k, occurrences DESC, value;' },
    [pscustomobject]@{ Key = "SEC_E_ORDER"; Text = 'FROM src_meltshop_pg.heats GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC' }
)

Rule "SENTINEL VERIFICATION"

$sentFail = 0
foreach ($s in $sentinels) {
    # NOTE: Find-Line already returns ',$hits', which survives the pipeline as an
    # array and unrolls exactly one level on assignment. Wrapping this call in @()
    # as well double-wraps it, and $hits[0] becomes the inner array. One fix, not two.
    $hits = Find-Line -Lines $lines -Exact $s.Text
    if ($hits.Count -eq 1) {
        $line0 = [int]$hits[0]
        $idx[$s.Key] = $line0

        Say ("          looking for: " + $s.Text)
    }
}

'WITH raw AS (',
'  SELECT c.table_schema AS s, c.table_name AS t, c.column_name AS k,',
'         unnest(xpath(''/rows/row'', query_to_xml(format(',
'           ''SELECT %I::text AS v, count(*) AS n FROM %I.%I GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1'',',
'           c.column_name, c.table_schema, c.table_name), false, true, ''''))) AS node',
'  FROM information_schema.columns c',
'  JOIN pg_class pc ON pc.relname = c.table_name',
'  JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid = pc.relnamespace AND pn.nspname = c.table_schema',
'  WHERE pc.relkind = ''r''',

'    AND (xpath(''/row/c/text()'', query_to_xml(format(',

'          c.column_name, c.table_schema, c.table_name), false, true, '''')))[1]::text::bigint <= 30',
'), vals AS (',
'  SELECT s, t, k,',
'         (xpath(''/row/v/text()'', node))[1]::text AS value,',
'         (xpath(''/row/n/text()'', node))[1]::text::bigint AS occurrences',
'  FROM raw',
')',
'SELECT s AS schema_name, t AS table_name, k AS column_name, value, occurrences,',
'       round(100.0 * occurrences / sum(occurrences) OVER (PARTITION BY s, t, k), 3) AS pct',
'FROM vals',
'ORDER BY s, t, k, occurrences DESC, value;'

[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\Apply-PpiqT025EngineTimeout.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=424, SizeKB=18.85, SHA256='2D231A07BB3268875F74FA73FD632806BEB67E3477C74E54ABC0BABC5FA7E0B0', Modified='2026-08-04 22:36:18']

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-025 apply pack - make the ML engine command timeout configuration-owned
    and fix the duration_ms defect. ReportOnly by default; -Apply edits; -Revert
    restores.

.DESCRIPTION
    TWO DEFECTS, BOTH BLOCKING T-025.

    D1  MlFoundationEndpoints.cs hardcodes command.CommandTimeout = 120. The
        feature-store refresh against the Fleet v2 plant takes 199.8 s - 35,910
        material units and 301,560 parameter observations - so the authenticated
        product path cannot complete. Per the ruling this becomes ONE canonical
        configuration value with a bounded default, NOT a larger magic number.

          default  120  unchanged, so no other environment shifts silently
          clamp    30 to 900
          profile  PlantProcess__Analytics__EngineCommandTimeoutSeconds=300

    D2  duration_ms is always 0, even on a 200-second run. The cause is
        textbook: v_started := now() and duration is computed as
        now() - v_started, and now() IS THE TRANSACTION START TIME, so the
        difference is exactly zero however long the function runs.
        clock_timestamp() advances during the transaction; now() does not.

        The SQL fix transforms the LIVE function body read from the database,
        never a repository copy - four scripts define this function and the live
        one is whichever ran last.

    WHY A STATIC FIELD AND NOT A SIGNATURE CHANGE. QueryAsync has six callers.
    Adding a parameter would touch all six for no benefit; the timeout is
    process-wide configuration, set once at startup.

.PARAMETER ReportOnly
    Verify anchors and show what would change. Writes nothing.
.PARAMETER Revert
    Restore all three files from the newest backup this pack created.

.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\packs\Apply-PpiqT025EngineTimeout.ps1 -ReportOnly
    .\tools\packs\Apply-PpiqT025EngineTimeout.ps1 -Apply
    .\tools\packs\Apply-PpiqT025EngineTimeout.ps1 -Revert
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$PgHost     = "127.0.0.1",
    [int]   $PgPort     = 5432,
    [string]$PgUser     = "ppiq_dev",
    [string]$PgPassword = "ppiq_dev_local_only",
    [string]$Database   = "ppiq_presentation",
    [string]$PsqlPath   = "",
    [int]   $TimeoutSeconds = 300,
    [switch]$ReportOnly,

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$PackName   = "T-025-engine-timeout"

function Say  { param([string]$T) Write-Host $T }
function Rule { param([string]$T) Write-Host ""; Write-Host ("=" * 78); Write-Host $T; Write-Host ("=" * 78) }
function Read-IfExists {
    param([string]$Path)
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
    return ""
}
function Count-NonAscii {
    param([string]$Text)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Text)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 126) { $n = $n + 1 } }
    return $n
}
function Resolve-Psql {
    param([string]$Explicit)
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Explicit)) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Explicit) { return $Explicit }
        return $null
    }
    $c = Get-Command psql.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -ne $c) { return $c.Source }
    foreach ($p in @("C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\15\bin\psql.exe")) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { return $p }
    }
    return $null
}
function Invoke-Sql {
    param([string]$Sql, [string]$Tag, [switch]$Raw)
    $f = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".sql")
    $o = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".out")
    $e = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".err")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($f, $Sql, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    $a = @("-X", "-w", "-h", $PgHost, "-p", "$PgPort", "-U", $PgUser, "-d", $Database,
           "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1")
    if ($Raw) { $a += @("-A", "-t") }
    $a += @("-f", $f, "-o", $o)
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $script:psql -ArgumentList $a -NoNewWindow -Wait `
                       -PassThru -RedirectStandardError $e
    $r = New-Object psobject
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name ExitCode -Value $p.ExitCode
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Output   -Value (Read-IfExists $o)
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Error    -Value (Read-IfExists $e)
    return $r
}

Rule ("PPIQ APPLY PACK - " + $PackName)
$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$fEndpoints = Join-Path $RepoRoot "Backend\PlantProcess.Api\Endpoints\Analytics\MlFoundationEndpoints.cs"
$fProgram   = Join-Path $RepoRoot "Backend\PlantProcess.Api\Program.cs"

$FIELD_BLOCK = @'
    // T-025: the ML engine command timeout is CONFIGURATION-OWNED, not a magic
    // number. The feature-store refresh against a full-scale plant legitimately
    // exceeds two minutes - 35,910 material units and 301,560 parameter
    // observations measured at 199.8 s - so a hardcoded 120 made the
    // authenticated product path impossible to complete.
    //
    // The DEFAULT stays 120 so no other environment shifts silently; the
    // presentation profile raises it explicitly.
    private const int DefaultEngineCommandTimeoutSeconds = 120;
    private const int MinEngineCommandTimeoutSeconds = 30;
    private const int MaxEngineCommandTimeoutSeconds = 900;

    private static int _engineCommandTimeoutSeconds = DefaultEngineCommandTimeoutSeconds;

    internal static int EngineCommandTimeoutSeconds => _engineCommandTimeoutSeconds;

    /// <summary>
    /// Binds the engine command timeout from configuration once at startup.
    /// QueryAsync has six callers, so the timeout is process-wide configuration
    /// rather than a parameter threaded through all of them.
    /// </summary>
    internal static void ConfigureEngineTimeout(IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        var seconds = configuration.GetValue<int>(
            "PlantProcess:Analytics:EngineCommandTimeoutSeconds",
            DefaultEngineCommandTimeoutSeconds);

        if (seconds <= 0)
            seconds = DefaultEngineCommandTimeoutSeconds;

        _engineCommandTimeoutSeconds = Math.Clamp(
            seconds,
            MinEngineCommandTimeoutSeconds,
            MaxEngineCommandTimeoutSeconds);
    }

'@

$Edits = @(
    [pscustomobject]@{
        # TWO occurrences, not one: QueryAsync and ExecuteNonQueryAsync both set
        # it. Both are ML engine commands and both must be configuration-owned,
        # so this edit replaces BOTH and the anchor check expects 2.
        Id     = "C1 timeout reads configuration"
        File   = "endpoints"
        Old    = "        command.CommandTimeout = 120;"
        New    = "        command.CommandTimeout = EngineCommandTimeoutSeconds;"

    [pscustomobject]@{

        File   = "endpoints"
        Expect = 1
        Old  = "    private static async Task<IReadOnlyList<Dictionary<string, object?>>> QueryAsync("
        New  = $FIELD_BLOCK + "    private static async Task<IReadOnlyList<Dictionary<string, object?>>> QueryAsync("
    },
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Id     = "C3 bind at startup"
        File   = "program"
        Expect = 1
        Old  = "app.MapMlFoundationEndpoints();"
        New  = "MlFoundationEndpoints.ConfigureEngineTimeout(builder.Configuration);" + "`r`n" +
               "app.MapMlFoundationEndpoints();"
    }
)

Rule "ANCHOR VERIFICATION"
$aFail = 0

if ($csText.Contains("ConfigureEngineTimeout")) {

$envHas = $envText.Contains("EngineCommandTimeoutSeconds")

Rule "APPLY - THE duration_ms DEFECT"
Say "now() is the TRANSACTION START TIME, so now() - v_started is exactly zero"
Say "however long the function runs. clock_timestamp() advances during the"
Say "transaction. The LIVE body is transformed, never a repository copy."
$script:psql = Resolve-Psql -Explicit $PsqlPath
if ($null -eq $script:psql) { Say "[WARN] psql not found; SQL fix SKIPPED."; }
else {
    $env:PGPASSWORD = $PgPassword
    $env:PGCLIENTENCODING = "UTF8"
    try {
        $live = Invoke-Sql -Tag "live" -Raw -Sql @'
SELECT pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname='ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store' AND p.prokind='f';
'@
        if ($live.ExitCode -ne 0 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($live.Output)) {
            Say "[FAIL] could not read the live function."
            $cFail = $cFail + 1
        } else {
            $body = $live.Output
            $hits = ([regex]::Matches($body, [regex]::Escape("EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - v_started))"))).Count
            Say ("occurrences of the zero-duration expression : " + $hits)
            if ($hits -eq 0) {
                Say "[OK] already fixed, or the expression differs. Nothing to do."
            } else {
                $fixed = $body.Replace("EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - v_started))",
                                       "EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clock_timestamp() - v_started))")
                $r = Invoke-Sql -Tag "durfix" -Sql ($fixed + ";")
                if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0 -or $r.Error -match "(?i)(ERROR|FATAL):") {
                    Say $r.Error; Say "[FAIL] the function could not be replaced."
                    $cFail = $cFail + 1
                } else { Say ("[OK] replaced, " + $hits + " expression(s) corrected") }
            }
            $ver = Invoke-Sql -Tag "durver" -Sql @'
\pset border 2
SELECT 'duration uses clock_timestamp' AS check_name, count(*) AS found, 1 AS required
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname='ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store' AND p.prokind='f'
  AND pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) LIKE '%clock_timestamp() - v_started%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'zero-duration expression remains', count(*), 0
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname='ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store' AND p.prokind='f'
  AND pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) LIKE '%EPOCH FROM (now() - v_started)%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lineage stamping still present', count(*), 1
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname='ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store' AND p.prokind='f'
  AND pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) LIKE '%SET refresh_run_id = v_run_id%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'single-flight lock still present', count(*), 1
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname='ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store' AND p.prokind='f'
  AND pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) LIKE '%pg_advisory_xact_lock%';
'@
            Say $ver.Output
            foreach ($raw in ($ver.Output -split "`n")) {
                $line = $raw.Trim()
                if ($line -match "^\|\s*(.+?)\s*\|\s*(\d+)\s*\|\s*(\d+)\s*\|") {
                    if ([int]$Matches[2] -ne [int]$Matches[3]) {
                        Say ("[FAIL] " + $Matches[1]); $cFail = $cFail + 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    finally { Remove-Item Env:\PGPASSWORD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}

Rule "RESULT"

    Say "       self-check failed; the SQL change is independent and idempotent."
    exit 1
}
Say "[OK] engine timeout is configuration-owned; duration_ms corrected."
Say ""

<#
================================================================================
 PPIQ T-012 CORRECTIVE DEFECT RECORD - JourneyRail
================================================================================

 SCOPE. ONE NEW FILE, DOCUMENTATION ONLY:
   docs/m1/evidence/T-012_journeyrail_corrective_defect.md

 This pack writes a record and changes NO code. It does not touch JourneyRail,
 the certification test, App.tsx or AppLayout.tsx. Ruled 04-Aug: the three
 JourneyRail failures are pre-existing, are not T-032 regressions, and their
 corrective work does not belong in the T-032 pack.

 The record carries the reproduction evidence, the three findings separated
 into two stale test expectations and one live product defect, why the T-012
 canonical guard did not catch it, and the required remedy including the
 approved guard that every match prefix must resolve to a non-redirect route.

 CONTRACT
   -ReportOnly   preflight and plan only, writes nothing
   (default)     preflight, apply, self-check

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [switch]$ReportOnly,
  [switch]$Revert

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:Failures = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Repo     = (Get-Location).Path
$script:Web      = Join-Path $script:Repo "Frontend\PlantProcess.Web"
$script:Target   = Join-Path $script:Repo "docs\m1\evidence\T-012_journeyrail_corrective_defect.md"
$script:Rail     = Join-Path $script:Web  "src\components\journey\JourneyRail.tsx"
$script:AppTsx   = Join-Path $script:Web  "src\App.tsx"

function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Ok ([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  [ OK ] " + $m) }
function Bad([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  [FAIL] " + $m) -ForegroundColor Red; [void]$script:Failures.Add($m) }
function Info([string]$m){ Write-Host ("  [ .. ] " + $m) -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

function Write-Utf8NoBomCrLf([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
  $normalised = $Text -replace "`r`n", "`n"
  $normalised = $normalised -replace "`n", "`r`n"
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
  if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir) }
  $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $normalised, $enc)
}

function Read-Text([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }

function Count-Occurrences([string]$Haystack, [string]$Needle) {
  if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
  $n = 0; $i = 0
  while ($true) {
    $i = $Haystack.IndexOf($Needle, $i, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    if ($i -lt 0) { break }
    $n++; $i += $Needle.Length
  }
  return $n
}

$script:Record = @'
# T-012 CORRECTIVE DEFECT - JourneyRail certification and the J15 route match

**Raised** 04-Aug-2026, during T-032 execution.
**Owning task** T-012 "Canonicalise the JourneyRail to J1 to J15", status Done.
**Under the standing status rule** a task whose evidence is invalidated becomes REOPENED. This record is the input to that corrective task.
**Not fixed in T-032.** Ruled 04-Aug: the failures are pre-existing, they are not T-032 regressions, and the corrective work does not belong in the T-032 pack.

---

## 1. What fails

`Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src/components/journey/__tests__/JourneyRail.certification.test.tsx` - three tests, all three failing.

## 2. Proof that it is pre-existing

Reproduced twice with identical test names and identical messages:

| Run | Tree | JourneyRail result |
|---|---|---|
| 04-Aug 12:46 | pre-T-032. The T-032 v1 pack had already self-reverted, and the build output carried `VisualJoinCanvasPage-B1HKLBfY.js`, so no T-032 file was on disk | 3 of 3 failed |
| 04-Aug 13:04 | T-032 plus T-032a applied | 3 of 3 failed |

The three failures are therefore not T-032 regressions.

## 3. The three findings, separated by kind

### Finding A - STALE EXPECTATION, test side

Test: "renders all 15 canonical stages plus the operational alerting entry".
At `/data-integration/connections` the test expects `Step 1 of 15`. The rail renders `Step 4 of 15 - Declare read-only connections`.

T-012 renumbered the rail to Chapter 2 section 3.3.1, where J1 to J3 are the commissioning stages and connections is J4. The test was written against the pre-T-012 numbering and was not updated.

### Finding B - STALE EXPECTATION, test side

Test: "marks the current route as the current journey step".
At `/data-integration/supervisor` the test expects `Step 14 of 15` and a `Supervisor` link carrying `aria-current="step"`. The rail renders `Step 15 of 15 - Operate, govern and retain`.

Supervisor is no longer a stage of its own. It is a match prefix inside J15, so there is no `Supervisor` node to carry `aria-current`.

### Finding C - LIVE PRODUCT DEFECT, rail side

Test: "maps assistant configuration routes to the final assistant stage".
At `/assistant/configuration` the rail renders its idle heading `15-step product journey`, which is what it shows when NO stage matched.

The cause, measured:

| Where | What it says |
|---|---|
| `src/components/journey/JourneyRail.tsx` line 45 | J15's match list contains `/assistant-config` |
| `src/App.tsx` line 862 | `<Route path="/assistant-config" element={<Navigate to="/assistant/configuration" replace />} />` |
| `src/App.tsx` line 700 | `/assistant/configuration` is the real route |
| `src/components/AppLayout.tsx` line 79 | `/assistant/configuration` has its own left-navigation entry, "Assistant Configuration" |

The rail matches the REDIRECT SOURCE. The redirect fires immediately, the user lands on the canonical path, and the match is lost. A live, navigable surface therefore shows a journey rail with no current step.

This is a product defect, not a test defect. Findings A and B are corrected in the test; finding C is corrected in the rail.

## 4. Why the T-012 guard did not catch it

`src/test/architecture/journeyRailCanonical.test.ts` asserts that `STAGES` declares exactly fifteen entries, that every label is verbatim from Chapter 2 section 3.3.1, and that a forbidden set of routes is never a journey target. It says nothing about whether each MATCH PREFIX resolves to a live, non-redirect route. It passed on both runs and was correct to.

## 5. Required remedy

1. Update findings A and B to the canonical numbering, so the certification test asserts what T-012 actually built.
2. Repoint the J15 match from the redirect source `/assistant-config` to the canonical `/assistant/configuration`. Whether the redirect source is also kept is a judgement for the corrective task; matching only the source is what is wrong.
3. **Add the mechanical guard, ruled 04-Aug:** every match prefix in `STAGES` must resolve to a real `Route` element in `App.tsx` and never to a `Navigate`. This defect class is mechanical, so it gets a guard rather than a promise - a prefix pointing at a redirect must fail the build.

## 6. Audit the same class before closing

Finding C was found by accident, through an unrelated test. The corrective task should apply the new guard to ALL fifteen stages and to every prefix in every match list, not only to the one that surfaced.
'@

function Invoke-Preflight {
  Say ""
  Say "PREFLIGHT"
  if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $script:Web "package.json"))) { Bad "run this from the repository root"; return }
  Ok "repository root confirmed"

  if (Test-Path $script:Target) { Bad "the record already exists, refusing to overwrite" } else { Ok "record path is free" }

  # THE RECORD MUST DESCRIBE THE TREE AS IT IS. If the defect has already been
  # corrected, filing a record that says otherwise is worse than filing none.
  if (-not (Test-Path $script:Rail)) {
    Bad "JourneyRail.tsx not found"
  } else {
    $rail = Read-Text $script:Rail
    if ((Count-Occurrences $rail '"/assistant-config"') -gt 0) {
      Ok "finding C is still live - the rail still matches the redirect source"
    } else {
      Bad "the rail no longer matches /assistant-config - finding C is already fixed, do not file this record unchanged"
    }
  }

  if (-not (Test-Path $script:AppTsx)) {
    Bad "App.tsx not found"
  } else {
    $app = Read-Text $script:AppTsx
    if ((Count-Occurrences $app '<Route path="/assistant-config" element={<Navigate to="/assistant/configuration" replace />} />') -eq 1) {
      Ok "the redirect the record cites is present exactly once in App.tsx"
    } else {
      Bad "the cited redirect is not present exactly once - the record would misstate the cause"
    }
  }
}

function Invoke-SelfCheck {
  Say ""
  Say "SELF-CHECK"
  if (-not (Test-Path $script:Target)) { Bad "record not written"; return }
  $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($script:Target)
  if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF) { Bad "BOM present" }
  $nonAscii = 0
  foreach ($b in $bytes) { if ($b -gt 127) { $nonAscii++ } }
  if ($nonAscii -gt 0) { Bad ("non-ASCII bytes: " + $nonAscii) } else { Ok "ASCII, no BOM" }

  $t = Read-Text $script:Target
  foreach ($needle in @("Finding A", "Finding B", "Finding C", "Required remedy", "non-redirect route")) {
    if ((Count-Occurrences $t $needle) -gt 0) { Ok ("record carries: " + $needle) } else { Bad ("record is missing: " + $needle) }
  }

  # NOTHING ELSE MAY HAVE MOVED. This pack is documentation only.
  $railNow = Read-Text $script:Rail
  if ((Count-Occurrences $railNow '"/assistant-config"') -gt 0) { Ok "JourneyRail.tsx untouched" } else { Bad "JourneyRail.tsx changed - this pack must not edit code" }
}

Say "================================================================"
Say " PPIQ T-012 corrective defect record - documentation only"
Say "================================================================"
Say ("repository : " + $script:Repo)

if ($Revert) {
  if (Test-Path $script:Target) {
    Remove-Item -Path $script:Target -Force
    Say ""
    Ok "removed the record"
  } else {
    Say ""
    Info "record not present, nothing to remove"
  }
  exit 0
}

Invoke-Preflight
if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) {
  Say ""
  Say "PREFLIGHT FAILED - nothing was written."
  foreach ($f in $script:Failures) { Say ("  - " + $f) }
  exit 1
}

if ($ReportOnly) {
  Say ""
  Say "REPORT ONLY - nothing written. The apply would:"
  Info "create  docs/m1/evidence/T-012_journeyrail_corrective_defect.md"
  Say ""
  Say "PREFLIGHT PASSED. Re-run without -ReportOnly to apply."
  exit 0
}

Write-Utf8NoBomCrLf $script:Target $script:Record
Say ""
Say "APPLY"
Ok "wrote docs/m1/evidence/T-012_journeyrail_corrective_defect.md"

Invoke-SelfCheck

if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) {
  Say ""
  Say "SELF-CHECK FAILED - removing the record."
  foreach ($f in $script:Failures) { Say ("  - " + $f) }
  if (Test-Path $script:Target) { Remove-Item -Path $script:Target -Force }
  exit 1
}

Say ""
Say "================================================================"
Say " RECORD FILED. No code was changed."
Say "================================================================"
Say " Remove it with:"
Say "   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\packs\apply-T-012-journeyrail-defect-record.ps1 -Revert"
exit 0

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-025b - correct the outcome producer. THREE MEASURED DEFECTS, ONE PACK.
    Operates on the LIVE function definition, never on a repository copy.

.DESCRIPTION
    THE THREE DEFECTS, each measured before being fixed:

    1. defect.severity  -  the producer writes qe.severity into severity_value.
       NpgsqlFeatureVectorLoader reads only numeric_value and category_value, so
       all 5,961 rows arrived with both null. One empty class means
       MinorityFraction returns 0.0 (its g.Count < 2 branch), which is below the
       0.03 floor, so the readiness gate blocked. RULED: fix the producer, do NOT
       teach the shared loader to read severity_value.

    2. defect.class  -  COALESCE(dc.defect_code, dc.defect_category, qe.event_type)
       lets an event with no defect catalogue fall through to its event type.
       Measured: 1,883 rows of 7,844 carrying the class "Disposition". Removing
       them puts SCALE at 1,550 of 5,961 = 26.00 percent, the declared T-015 share
       to two decimals. RULED: event_type must not silently become a defect class.

    3. defect.rate_per_m2  -  numeric_value is the literal 1.0 and
       normalization_denominator is NULL. A constant outcome makes every
       correlation undefined, which is why all 26 parameters were excluded.
       BOUNDED DENOMINATOR CHECK, PERFORMED: hsm_coils carries
       actual_thickness_mm, actual_width_mm and coil_weight_kg and NO LENGTH.
       Slabs have length_mm; coils do not. The canonical emit writes exactly four
       coil dimensions - FDT_C, CT_C, THICKNESS_MM, WIDTH_MM - and no LENGTH or
       AREA parameter code exists anywhere in the generator. Area could only come
       from weight / (thickness x assumed density), and the generator's own header
       records FAULT-1: weight_kg is drawn independently of the dimensions, so
       implied density is not physical. NO AUTHORITATIVE DENOMINATOR EXISTS.
       RULED: stop materialising the false values rather than invent one. The
       outcome then reports as NOT MATERIALISED, consistent with the other five.

    WHY THE LIVE DEFINITION AND NOT THE .sql FILE. Four scripts define
    ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store and the live one is whichever ran last. This pack
    extracts pg_get_functiondef, edits THAT, and refuses to proceed if any anchor
    does not match exactly once. -ReportOnly prints the exact text each anchor
    matched so it can be read before anything is written.

    WHAT THIS PACK DOES NOT DO. It does not run the refresh. It does not touch
    ml_outcome_definitions. It does not change the loader, the lineage columns,
    run ownership, engine identity or the NOT NULL invariant. Refresh A, the
    correlation run, refresh B and the reproducibility proof belong to
    Invoke-PpiqT025Corrective.ps1.

.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025b-outcome-producer-correction.ps1 -ReportOnly
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025b-outcome-producer-correction.ps1
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [string]$PgHost     = "127.0.0.1",
    [int]   $PgPort     = 5432,
    [string]$PgUser     = "ppiq_dev",
    [string]$PgPassword = "ppiq_dev_local_only",
    [string]$Database   = "ppiq_presentation",
    [string]$PsqlPath   = ""

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$FunctionName = "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store"

function Say  { param([string]$T) Write-Host $T }
function Rule { param([string]$T) Say ""; Say ("=" * 78); Say $T; Say ("=" * 78) }
function Die  { param([string]$T) Say ("[FAIL] " + $T); exit 1 }

function Read-IfExists {
    param([string]$Path)
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
    return ""
}
function Resolve-Psql {
    param([string]$Explicit)
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Explicit)) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Explicit) { return $Explicit }
        return $null
    }
    $c = Get-Command psql.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -ne $c) { return $c.Source }
    foreach ($p in @("C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\15\bin\psql.exe")) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { return $p }
    }
    return $null
}
function Invoke-SqlFile {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Tag)
    $o = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".out")
    $e = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".err")
    $a = @("-X", "-w", "-h", $PgHost, "-p", "$PgPort", "-U", $PgUser, "-d", $Database,
           "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1", "-f", $Path, "-o", $o)
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $script:psql -ArgumentList $a -NoNewWindow -Wait `
                       -PassThru -RedirectStandardError $e
    $r = New-Object psobject
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name ExitCode -Value $p.ExitCode
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Output   -Value (Read-IfExists $o)
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Error    -Value (Read-IfExists $e)
    return $r
}
function Invoke-SqlText {
    param([string]$Sql, [string]$Tag, [switch]$Raw)
    $f = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".sql")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($f, $Sql, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    $o = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".out")
    $e = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".err")
    $a = @("-X", "-w", "-h", $PgHost, "-p", "$PgPort", "-U", $PgUser, "-d", $Database,
           "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1")
    if ($Raw) { $a += @("-A", "-t") }
    $a += @("-f", $f, "-o", $o)
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $script:psql -ArgumentList $a -NoNewWindow -Wait `
                       -PassThru -RedirectStandardError $e
    $r = New-Object psobject
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name ExitCode -Value $p.ExitCode
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Output   -Value (Read-IfExists $o)
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Error    -Value (Read-IfExists $e)
    return $r
}
function Get-LiveDefinition {
    $r = Invoke-SqlText -Tag "getdef" -Raw -Sql @"
SELECT pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)
FROM pg_proc p
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = '$FunctionName' AND p.prokind = 'f';
"@
    if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { Die ("could not read the live definition: " + $r.Error.Trim()) }
    return $r.Output
}

Rule "PPIQ T-025b - OUTCOME PRODUCER CORRECTION"
$repoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$script:psql = Resolve-Psql -Explicit $PsqlPath
if ($null -eq $script:psql) { Die "psql.exe not found." }
$env:PGPASSWORD = $PgPassword
$env:PGCLIENTENCODING = "UTF8"
$stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$script:tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("ppiq_t025b_" + $stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:tmp -Force | Out-Null
Say ("Database : " + $Database)
Say ("Function : public." + $FunctionName)

try {
    # ------------------------------------------------------------ PREFLIGHT
    Rule "PREFLIGHT"

    $overloads = Invoke-SqlText -Tag "overloads" -Raw -Sql @"
SELECT count(*)::text
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = '$FunctionName' AND p.prokind = 'f';
"@
    $nOver = -1
    foreach ($line in ($overloads.Output -split "`n")) {
        $t = $line.Trim()
        if ($t -match "^\d+$") { $nOver = [int]$t; break }
    }
    Say ("  overloads of the function : " + $nOver + " (required 1)")
    if ($nOver -ne 1) { Die "expected exactly one overload. Refusing to edit an ambiguous target." }

    $original = Get-LiveDefinition
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($original)) { Die "the live definition came back empty." }
    Say ("  live definition length    : " + $original.Length + " chars")

    if ($original.Contains($Marker)) {
        Say "  [SKIP] the correction marker is already present. Nothing to do."
        exit 0
    }

    # Whitespace-tolerant anchors. Each MUST match exactly once.
    $reClassCase = "CASE\s+WHEN\s+od\.outcome_key\s*=\s*'defect\.class'\s*THEN\s+COALESCE\(\s*dc\.defect_code\s*,\s*dc\.defect_category\s*,\s*qe\.event_type\s*\)\s*ELSE\s+NULL\s+END"
    $reClassWhere = "\(\s*od\.outcome_key\s*=\s*'defect\.class'\s+AND\s+COALESCE\(\s*dc\.defect_code\s*,\s*dc\.defect_category\s*,\s*qe\.event_type\s*\)\s+IS\s+NOT\s+NULL\s*\)"
    $reRateBlock = "INSERT\s+INTO\s+public\.ml_outcome_values(?:(?!INSERT\s+INTO)[\s\S])*?'defect\.rate_per_m2'[\s\S]*?p_window_days\s*\)\s*;"

    $anchors = @(
        @{ Name = "1. defect.class CASE (category_value)"; Pattern = $reClassCase },
        @{ Name = "2. defect.class WHERE predicate";       Pattern = $reClassWhere },
        @{ Name = "3. defect.rate_per_m2 INSERT block";    Pattern = $reRateBlock }
    )

    $bad = 0
    foreach ($a in $anchors) {
        $m = [regex]::Matches($original, $a.Pattern)
        Say ("  anchor " + $a.Name.PadRight(42) + " matches: " + $m.Count + " (required 1)")
        if ($m.Count -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    }
    if ($bad -gt 0) {
        Say ""
        Say "  The live function does not look like the definition this pack was written"
        Say "  against. FAILING CLOSED rather than editing a body I cannot recognise."
        Die "anchor verification failed."
    }

    if ($ReportOnly) {
        Rule "REPORT ONLY - THE EXACT TEXT EACH ANCHOR MATCHED"
        foreach ($a in $anchors) {
            $m = [regex]::Matches($original, $a.Pattern)
            Say ""
            Say ("--- " + $a.Name + " ---")
            Say $m[0].Value
        }
        Rule "WHAT WOULD REPLACE THEM"
        Say "1 -> CASE WHEN od.outcome_key = 'defect.class'"
        Say "          THEN COALESCE(dc.defect_code, dc.defect_category)"
        Say "        WHEN od.outcome_key = 'defect.severity'"
        Say "          THEN qe.severity"
        Say "        ELSE NULL END"
        Say "2 -> (od.outcome_key = 'defect.class' AND COALESCE(dc.defect_code, dc.defect_category) IS NOT NULL)"
        Say "3 -> the whole block is removed and replaced by a comment recording the"
        Say "     denominator check and the ruling."
        Say ""
        Say "No file was written and no database object was changed."
        exit 0
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ BACKUP
    Rule "BACKUP"
    $backupDir = Join-Path $repoRoot ("tools\packs\_backup_T-025b-outcome-producer_" + $stamp)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDir -Force | Out-Null
    $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir ($FunctionName + "_original.sql")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($backupFile, $original, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    $restore = "Restore the previous function definition with:`r`n  psql -h $PgHost -p $PgPort -U $PgUser -d $Database -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f `"$backupFile`"`r`n"
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $backupDir "RESTORE.txt"), $restore, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Say ("  saved : " + $backupFile)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ EDIT
    Rule "EDIT"
    $newCase = @"
CASE WHEN od.outcome_key = 'defect.class'
             THEN COALESCE(dc.defect_code, dc.defect_category)
             WHEN od.outcome_key = 'defect.severity'
             THEN qe.severity
             ELSE NULL END
"@
    $newCase = $newCase.TrimEnd("`r", "`n")
    $newWhere = "(od.outcome_key = 'defect.class'    AND COALESCE(dc.defect_code, dc.defect_category) IS NOT NULL)"
    $newRate = @"
-- $Marker
    -- defect.rate_per_m2 IS DELIBERATELY NOT MATERIALISED.
    -- The removed block wrote the literal 1.0 into numeric_value and left
    -- normalization_denominator NULL, so the outcome was constant and every
    -- correlation against it was undefined - 26 of 26 parameters excluded.
    -- BOUNDED DENOMINATOR CHECK, PERFORMED BEFORE REMOVING IT: coils carry
    -- thickness, width and weight and NO LENGTH. Slabs carry length_mm; coils
    -- do not. The canonical emit writes FDT_C, CT_C, THICKNESS_MM and WIDTH_MM
    -- and there is no LENGTH or AREA parameter code. Area could only come from
    -- weight / (thickness x assumed density), and the donor generator records
    -- as FAULT-1 that weight_kg is drawn independently of the dimensions, so
    -- implied density is not physical.
    -- RULING: a missing honest outcome is preferable to a fabricated metric.
    -- The definition row is left in place and simply reports as not
    -- materialised, consistent with the other five unproduced outcomes.
"@
    $updated = [regex]::Replace($original, $reRateBlock, [System.Text.RegularExpressions.MatchEvaluator]{ param($m) $newRate }, 1)
    $updated = [regex]::Replace($updated, $reClassCase, [System.Text.RegularExpressions.MatchEvaluator]{ param($m) $newCase }, 1)
    $updated = [regex]::Replace($updated, $reClassWhere, [System.Text.RegularExpressions.MatchEvaluator]{ param($m) $newWhere }, 1)

    $nonAscii = 0
    foreach ($ch in $updated.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 126 -and [int]$ch -ne 10 -and [int]$ch -ne 13) { $nonAscii = $nonAscii + 1 } }
    Say ("  non-ASCII characters in the new body : " + $nonAscii + " (required 0)")
    if ($nonAscii -ne 0) { Die "refusing to install a body containing non-ASCII." }

    $applyFile = Join-Path $backupDir ($FunctionName + "_corrected.sql")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($applyFile, ($updated + "`r`n"), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Say ("  corrected body written : " + $applyFile)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ APPLY
    Rule "APPLY"
    $res = Invoke-SqlFile -Path $applyFile -Tag "apply"
    if ($res.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Say ("[FAIL] CREATE OR REPLACE failed: " + $res.Error.Trim())
        Say "  the previous definition is untouched because the statement did not commit."
        Die "apply failed."
    }
    Say "  CREATE OR REPLACE succeeded"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ SELF-CHECK
    Rule "SELF-CHECK"
    $after = Get-LiveDefinition
    $bad = 0

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, [regex]::Escape($Marker))).Count
    Say ("  correction marker present            : " + $c + " (required 1)")
    if ($c -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "WHEN\s+od\.outcome_key\s*=\s*'defect\.severity'\s*THEN\s+qe\.severity")).Count
    Say ("  severity now written to category     : " + $c + " (required 1)")
    if ($c -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "qe\.event_type\s*\)")).Count
    Say ("  event_type still used as a class     : " + $c + " (required 0)")
    if ($c -ne 0) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "qe\.event_at_utc\s*,\s*1\.0\s*,")).Count
    Say ("  hardcoded 1.0 rate remaining         : " + $c + " (required 0)")
    if ($c -ne 0) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "INSERT\s+INTO\s+public\.ml_outcome_values")).Count
    Say ("  outcome INSERT blocks remaining      : " + $c + " (required 1)")
    if ($c -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "DELETE\s+FROM\s+public\.ml_outcome_values")).Count
    Say ("  self-clear preserved                 : " + $c + " (required 1)")
    if ($c -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    foreach ($frozen in @("refresh_run_id", "ml_feature_store_refresh_runs", "source_system")) {
        $b = ([regex]::Matches($original, [regex]::Escape($frozen))).Count
        $a2 = ([regex]::Matches($after,   [regex]::Escape($frozen))).Count
        Say ("  lineage token '" + $frozen + "' before/after : " + $b + " / " + $a2)
        if ($b -ne $a2) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    }

    Rule "GATE"
    if ($bad -gt 0) {
        Say ("SELF-CHECK FAILED with " + $bad + " problem(s). AUTO-REVERTING.")
        $rev = Invoke-SqlFile -Path $backupFile -Tag "revert"
        if ($rev.ExitCode -eq 0) {
            Say "  the original function definition has been restored."
        } else {
            Say ("  [CRITICAL] revert FAILED: " + $rev.Error.Trim())
            Say ("  restore by hand from : " + $backupFile)
        }
        exit 1
    }
    Say "T-025b APPLIED - all self-checks green. NO REFRESH HAS BEEN RUN."
    Say ""
    Say "NEXT:"
    Say "  .\tools\run\Invoke-PpiqT025Corrective.ps1"
    Say ""
    Say "That runner performs corrected refresh A, verifies the three outcome"
    Say "populations, runs the current correlation, then refresh B and the"
    Say "row-level reproducibility proof. Two refreshes, no third cycle."
    Say ""
    Say ("Revert : psql -h " + $PgHost + " -p " + $PgPort + " -U " + $PgUser + " -d " + $Database + " -f `"" + $backupFile + "`"")
}
finally {
    Remove-Item Env:\PGPASSWORD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
exit 0

[FILE_END]
