#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-025b - correct the outcome producer. THREE MEASURED DEFECTS, ONE PACK.
    Operates on the LIVE function definition, never on a repository copy.

.DESCRIPTION
    THE THREE DEFECTS, each measured before being fixed:

    1. defect.severity  -  the producer writes qe.severity into severity_value.
       NpgsqlFeatureVectorLoader reads only numeric_value and category_value, so
       all 5,961 rows arrived with both null. One empty class means
       MinorityFraction returns 0.0 (its g.Count < 2 branch), which is below the
       0.03 floor, so the readiness gate blocked. RULED: fix the producer, do NOT
       teach the shared loader to read severity_value.

    2. defect.class  -  COALESCE(dc.defect_code, dc.defect_category, qe.event_type)
       lets an event with no defect catalogue fall through to its event type.
       Measured: 1,883 rows of 7,844 carrying the class "Disposition". Removing
       them puts SCALE at 1,550 of 5,961 = 26.00 percent, the declared T-015 share
       to two decimals. RULED: event_type must not silently become a defect class.

    3. defect.rate_per_m2  -  numeric_value is the literal 1.0 and
       normalization_denominator is NULL. A constant outcome makes every
       correlation undefined, which is why all 26 parameters were excluded.
       BOUNDED DENOMINATOR CHECK, PERFORMED: hsm_coils carries
       actual_thickness_mm, actual_width_mm and coil_weight_kg and NO LENGTH.
       Slabs have length_mm; coils do not. The canonical emit writes exactly four
       coil dimensions - FDT_C, CT_C, THICKNESS_MM, WIDTH_MM - and no LENGTH or
       AREA parameter code exists anywhere in the generator. Area could only come
       from weight / (thickness x assumed density), and the generator's own header
       records FAULT-1: weight_kg is drawn independently of the dimensions, so
       implied density is not physical. NO AUTHORITATIVE DENOMINATOR EXISTS.
       RULED: stop materialising the false values rather than invent one. The
       outcome then reports as NOT MATERIALISED, consistent with the other five.

    WHY THE LIVE DEFINITION AND NOT THE .sql FILE. Four scripts define
    ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store and the live one is whichever ran last. This pack
    extracts pg_get_functiondef, edits THAT, and refuses to proceed if any anchor
    does not match exactly once. -ReportOnly prints the exact text each anchor
    matched so it can be read before anything is written.

    WHAT THIS PACK DOES NOT DO. It does not run the refresh. It does not touch
    ml_outcome_definitions. It does not change the loader, the lineage columns,
    run ownership, engine identity or the NOT NULL invariant. Refresh A, the
    correlation run, refresh B and the reproducibility proof belong to
    Invoke-PpiqT025Corrective.ps1.

.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025b-outcome-producer-correction.ps1 -ReportOnly
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025b-outcome-producer-correction.ps1
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [string]$PgHost     = "127.0.0.1",
    [int]   $PgPort     = 5432,
    [string]$PgUser     = "ppiq_dev",
    [string]$PgPassword = "ppiq_dev_local_only",
    [string]$Database   = "ppiq_presentation",
    [string]$PsqlPath   = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$FunctionName = "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store"
$Marker       = "PPIQ T-025b outcome producer correction"

function Rule { param([string]$T) Say ""; Say ("=" * 78); Say $T; Say ("=" * 78) }
function Die  { param([string]$T) Say ("[FAIL] " + $T); exit 1 }

function Read-IfExists {
    param([string]$Path)
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
    return ""
}
function Resolve-Psql {
    param([string]$Explicit)
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Explicit)) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Explicit) { return $Explicit }
        return $null
    }
    $c = Get-Command psql.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -ne $c) { return $c.Source }
    foreach ($p in @("C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\15\bin\psql.exe")) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { return $p }
    }
    return $null
}

        Say "          THEN qe.severity"
        Say "        ELSE NULL END"
        Say "2 -> (od.outcome_key = 'defect.class' AND COALESCE(dc.defect_code, dc.defect_category) IS NOT NULL)"
        Say "3 -> the whole block is removed and replaced by a comment recording the"
        Say "     denominator check and the ruling."
        Say ""
        Say "No file was written and no database object was changed."
        exit 0
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ BACKUP
    Rule "BACKUP"
    $backupDir = Join-Path $repoRoot ("tools\packs\_backup_T-025b-outcome-producer_" + $stamp)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDir -Force | Out-Null
    $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir ($FunctionName + "_original.sql")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($backupFile, $original, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    $restore = "Restore the previous function definition with:`r`n  psql -h $PgHost -p $PgPort -U $PgUser -d $Database -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f `"$backupFile`"`r`n"
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $backupDir "RESTORE.txt"), $restore, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Say ("  saved : " + $backupFile)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ EDIT
    Rule "EDIT"
    $newCase = @"
CASE WHEN od.outcome_key = 'defect.class'
             THEN COALESCE(dc.defect_code, dc.defect_category)
             WHEN od.outcome_key = 'defect.severity'
             THEN qe.severity
             ELSE NULL END
"@
    $newCase = $newCase.TrimEnd("`r", "`n")
    $newWhere = "(od.outcome_key = 'defect.class'    AND COALESCE(dc.defect_code, dc.defect_category) IS NOT NULL)"
    $newRate = @"
-- $Marker
    -- defect.rate_per_m2 IS DELIBERATELY NOT MATERIALISED.
    -- The removed block wrote the literal 1.0 into numeric_value and left
    -- normalization_denominator NULL, so the outcome was constant and every
    -- correlation against it was undefined - 26 of 26 parameters excluded.
    -- BOUNDED DENOMINATOR CHECK, PERFORMED BEFORE REMOVING IT: coils carry
    -- thickness, width and weight and NO LENGTH. Slabs carry length_mm; coils
    -- do not. The canonical emit writes FDT_C, CT_C, THICKNESS_MM and WIDTH_MM
    -- and there is no LENGTH or AREA parameter code. Area could only come from
    -- weight / (thickness x assumed density), and the donor generator records
    -- as FAULT-1 that weight_kg is drawn independently of the dimensions, so
    -- implied density is not physical.
    -- RULING: a missing honest outcome is preferable to a fabricated metric.
    -- The definition row is left in place and simply reports as not
    -- materialised, consistent with the other five unproduced outcomes.
"@
    $updated = [regex]::Replace($original, $reRateBlock, [System.Text.RegularExpressions.MatchEvaluator]{ param($m) $newRate }, 1)
    $updated = [regex]::Replace($updated, $reClassCase, [System.Text.RegularExpressions.MatchEvaluator]{ param($m) $newCase }, 1)
    $updated = [regex]::Replace($updated, $reClassWhere, [System.Text.RegularExpressions.MatchEvaluator]{ param($m) $newWhere }, 1)

    $nonAscii = 0
    foreach ($ch in $updated.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 126 -and [int]$ch -ne 10 -and [int]$ch -ne 13) { $nonAscii = $nonAscii + 1 } }
    Say ("  non-ASCII characters in the new body : " + $nonAscii + " (required 0)")
    if ($nonAscii -ne 0) { Die "refusing to install a body containing non-ASCII." }

    $applyFile = Join-Path $backupDir ($FunctionName + "_corrected.sql")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($applyFile, ($updated + "`r`n"), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Say ("  corrected body written : " + $applyFile)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ APPLY
    Rule "APPLY"
    $res = Invoke-SqlFile -Path $applyFile -Tag "apply"
    if ($res.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Say ("[FAIL] CREATE OR REPLACE failed: " + $res.Error.Trim())
        Say "  the previous definition is untouched because the statement did not commit."
        Die "apply failed."
    }
    Say "  CREATE OR REPLACE succeeded"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ SELF-CHECK
    Rule "SELF-CHECK"
    $after = Get-LiveDefinition
    $bad = 0

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, [regex]::Escape($Marker))).Count
    Say ("  correction marker present            : " + $c + " (required 1)")
    if ($c -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    # CORRECTED IN v2. The previous check used a pattern that ALSO matches the
    # preserved severity_value assignment, so a correct edit reported 2 against a
    # required 1 and auto-reverted. A guard must name the exact artifact.
    # The new category_value branch is the ONLY place where the shortened class
    # COALESCE is immediately followed by the severity WHEN.
    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "COALESCE\(\s*dc\.defect_code\s*,\s*dc\.defect_category\s*\)\s*WHEN\s+od\.outcome_key\s*=\s*'defect\.severity'\s*THEN\s+qe\.severity")).Count
    Say ("  severity added to category_value     : " + $c + " (required 1)")
    if ($c -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    # And the ORIGINAL severity_value assignment must SURVIVE. Two occurrences
    # total: the new category branch plus the untouched severity_value branch.
    # Losing either one fails this check.
    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "'defect\.severity'\s*THEN\s+qe\.severity")).Count
    Say ("  severity branches total              : " + $c + " (required 2)")
    if ($c -ne 2) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "qe\.event_type\s*\)")).Count
    Say ("  event_type still used as a class     : " + $c + " (required 0)")
    if ($c -ne 0) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "qe\.event_at_utc\s*,\s*1\.0\s*,")).Count
    Say ("  hardcoded 1.0 rate remaining         : " + $c + " (required 0)")
    if ($c -ne 0) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "INSERT\s+INTO\s+public\.ml_outcome_values")).Count
    Say ("  outcome INSERT blocks remaining      : " + $c + " (required 1)")
    if ($c -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "DELETE\s+FROM\s+public\.ml_outcome_values\s+WHERE\s+source_system\s*=\s*'PPIQ-ML-Refresh'")).Count
    Say ("  outcome self-clear preserved         : " + $c + " (required 1)")
    if ($c -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, "DELETE\s+FROM\s+public\.ml_feature_values\s+WHERE\s+source_system\s*=\s*'PPIQ-ML-Refresh'")).Count
    Say ("  feature self-clear preserved         : " + $c + " (required 1)")
    if ($c -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    # FROZEN ARCHITECTURE. These two must be IDENTICAL before and after.
    foreach ($frozen in @("refresh_run_id", "ml_feature_store_refresh_runs")) {
        $b = ([regex]::Matches($original, [regex]::Escape($frozen))).Count
        $a2 = ([regex]::Matches($after,   [regex]::Escape($frozen))).Count
        Say ("  lineage token '" + $frozen + "' before/after : " + $b + " / " + $a2 + " (must be equal)")
        if ($b -ne $a2) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    }

    # source_system is DIFFERENT and equality here was the second wrong assertion
    # in v1. The removed INSERT's column list contained it exactly once, so the
    # delta MUST be exactly 1. Zero would mean the block was not removed; more
    # than one would mean something else was taken with it.
    $b = ([regex]::Matches($original, "source_system")).Count
    $a2 = ([regex]::Matches($after,   "source_system")).Count
    Say ("  source_system before/after           : " + $b + " / " + $a2 + " (delta must be exactly 1)")
    if (($b - $a2) -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    Rule "GATE"
    if ($bad -gt 0) {
        Say ("SELF-CHECK FAILED with " + $bad + " problem(s). AUTO-REVERTING.")
        $rev = Invoke-SqlFile -Path $backupFile -Tag "revert"
        if ($rev.ExitCode -eq 0) {
            Say "  the original function definition has been restored."
        } else {
            Say ("  [CRITICAL] revert FAILED: " + $rev.Error.Trim())
            Say ("  restore by hand from : " + $backupFile)
        }
        exit 1
    }
    Say "T-025b v2 APPLIED - all self-checks green. NO REFRESH HAS BEEN RUN."
    Say ""
    Say "NEXT:"
    Say "  .\tools\run\Invoke-PpiqT025Corrective.ps1"
    Say ""
    Say "That runner performs corrected refresh A, verifies the three outcome"
    Say "populations, runs the current correlation, then refresh B and the"
    Say "row-level reproducibility proof. Two refreshes, no third cycle."
    Say ""
    Say ("Revert : psql -h " + $PgHost + " -p " + $PgPort + " -U " + $PgUser + " -d " + $Database + " -f `"" + $backupFile + "`"")
}
finally {
    Remove-Item Env:\PGPASSWORD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
exit 0

[FILE_END]

[FILE_START]
[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\apply-T-025c-insert-time-lineage.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=394, SizeKB=18.24, SHA256='B72FCC535FCF05EA8A5C1E0B08E271655950593F5471AAEB8E3C19285BCFA2CE', Modified='2026-08-05 11:22:15']

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-025c - insert-time lineage on every live value INSERT, in both the base
    and v6 producers. Operates on the LIVE function definitions.

.DESCRIPTION
    THE INCOMPATIBILITY THIS FIXES. The producers insert value rows without
    refresh_run_id and a later UPDATE stamps them. That was operational while the
    column was nullable. Section C of the 09:46 closure enforced
    refresh_run_id NOT NULL on both value tables, and from that moment PostgreSQL
    rejected the row before the stamping UPDATE could run. Every refresh since has
    failed with 23502. The invariant is correct; the producer was not implementing
    it. Row provenance must exist at creation, not in a temporary unowned state.

    THE AUTHORITATIVE RUN PER FUNCTION, read from the live bodies:
      ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store      -> v_run_id      (declared at the top and
                                            already used for the run registry row)
      ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store_v6   -> v_base.run_id (v6 calls the base into
                                            v_base and returns v_base.run_id, so
                                            base rows and v6 rows share one run)

    WHAT IS NOT TOUCHED. NOT NULL is not weakened. Foreign keys, the run registry,
    engine identity and version, source-system ownership and advisory locking are
    all asserted unchanged, token for token, before and after. The post-insert
    stamping UPDATE is LEFT IN PLACE and becomes a harmless no-op, since it only
    ever touched rows with a NULL lineage and there will no longer be any. It is
    no longer relied upon for correctness and can be retired separately.

    HOW INSERT-TIME OWNERSHIP IS PROVEN. Not by reading the UPDATE. A successful
    refresh WHILE refresh_run_id IS NOT NULL is itself the proof: any row not
    owned at insert would be rejected by the constraint. The corrective runner
    therefore proves it by running at all.

    THE T-025b OUTCOME CORRECTIONS ARE A PRECONDITION, NOT A REPEAT. They are
    already live and green. This pack ASSERTS the T-025b marker and refuses to run
    without it, rather than re-applying a change that is already correct - folding
    a green edit into a new pack adds risk and buys nothing. The combined end
    state is what the self-checks prove.

    ONE KNOWN THING LEFT ALONE, RECORDED NOT FIXED. The v6 outcome INSERT writes
    defect.rate_per_m2 with normalization_denominator = 1.0 and stamps
    'area_m2_missing_fallback_to_unit' into its own provenance. That is a defect
    COUNT under a rate name - the same fabrication the base carried, and the code
    says so itself. Lineage is added there; the semantics are NOT changed, because
    that is outside the ruling. v6 is not the path the API calls.

.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025c-insert-time-lineage.ps1 -ReportOnly
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025c-insert-time-lineage.ps1
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [string]$PgHost     = "127.0.0.1",
    [int]   $PgPort     = 5432,
    [string]$PgUser     = "ppiq_dev",
    [string]$PgPassword = "ppiq_dev_local_only",
    [string]$Database   = "ppiq_presentation",
    [string]$PsqlPath   = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$T025bMarker = "PPIQ T-025b outcome producer correction"
$Marker      = "PPIQ T-025c insert-time lineage"

# Every value INSERT: capture the column list and the SELECT that follows it.
# Column lists contain no parentheses, so [^)] cannot run away.
$reInsert = "(INSERT\s+INTO\s+public\.ml_(?:feature|outcome)_values\s*\(\s*)([^)]*?)(\)\s*SELECT\s+)"

$targets = @(
    @{ Fn = "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store";    Run = "v_run_id" },
    @{ Fn = "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store_v6"; Run = "v_base.run_id" }
)

function Say  { param([string]$T) Write-Host $T }
function Rule { param([string]$T) Say ""; Say ("=" * 78); Say $T; Say ("=" * 78) }
function Die  { param([string]$T) Say ("[FAIL] " + $T); exit 1 }

function Read-IfExists {
    param([string]$Path)
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
    return ""
}
function Resolve-Psql {
    param([string]$Explicit)
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Explicit)) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Explicit) { return $Explicit }
        return $null
    }
    $c = Get-Command psql.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -ne $c) { return $c.Source }
    foreach ($p in @("C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\15\bin\psql.exe")) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { return $p }
    }
    return $null
}
function Invoke-SqlFile {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Tag)
    $o = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".out")
    $e = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".err")
    $a = @("-X", "-w", "-h", $PgHost, "-p", "$PgPort", "-U", $PgUser, "-d", $Database,
           "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1", "-f", $Path, "-o", $o)
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $script:psql -ArgumentList $a -NoNewWindow -Wait `
                       -PassThru -RedirectStandardError $e
    $r = New-Object psobject
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name ExitCode -Value $p.ExitCode
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Output   -Value (Read-IfExists $o)
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Error    -Value (Read-IfExists $e)
    return $r
}
function Invoke-SqlText {
    param([string]$Sql, [string]$Tag, [switch]$Raw)
    $f = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".sql")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($f, $Sql, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    $o = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".out")
    $e = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".err")
    $a = @("-X", "-w", "-h", $PgHost, "-p", "$PgPort", "-U", $PgUser, "-d", $Database,
           "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1")
    if ($Raw) { $a += @("-A", "-t") }
    $a += @("-f", $f, "-o", $o)
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $script:psql -ArgumentList $a -NoNewWindow -Wait `
                       -PassThru -RedirectStandardError $e
    $r = New-Object psobject
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name ExitCode -Value $p.ExitCode
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Output   -Value (Read-IfExists $o)
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Error    -Value (Read-IfExists $e)
    return $r
}
function Get-Def {
    param([string]$Fn)
    $r = Invoke-SqlText -Tag ("getdef_" + $Fn) -Raw -Sql @"
SELECT pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = '$Fn' AND p.prokind = 'f';
"@
    if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { Die ("could not read " + $Fn + " : " + $r.Error.Trim()) }
    return $r.Output
}
function Count-Overloads {
    param([string]$Fn)
    $r = Invoke-SqlText -Tag ("ov_" + $Fn) -Raw -Sql @"
SELECT count(*)::text FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = '$Fn' AND p.prokind = 'f';
"@
    foreach ($line in ($r.Output -split "`n")) {
        $t = $line.Trim()
        if ($t -match "^\d+$") { return [int]$t }
    }
    return -1
}
# How many value INSERTs already carry lineage in their column list.
function Count-Inserts {
    param([string]$Body)
    $total = 0; $owned = 0
    foreach ($m in [regex]::Matches($Body, $reInsert)) {
        $total = $total + 1
        if ($m.Groups[2].Value -match "\brefresh_run_id\b") { $owned = $owned + 1 }
    }
    $r = New-Object psobject
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Total -Value $total
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Owned -Value $owned
    return $r
}

Rule "PPIQ T-025c - INSERT-TIME LINEAGE ON EVERY LIVE VALUE INSERT"
$repoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$script:psql = Resolve-Psql -Explicit $PsqlPath
if ($null -eq $script:psql) { Die "psql.exe not found." }
$env:PGPASSWORD = $PgPassword
$env:PGCLIENTENCODING = "UTF8"
$stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$script:tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("ppiq_t025c_" + $stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:tmp -Force | Out-Null
Say ("Database : " + $Database)

try {
    # ------------------------------------------------------------ PREFLIGHT
    Rule "PREFLIGHT"

    $originals = @{}
    $plans = @()
    foreach ($t in $targets) {
        $fn = $t.Fn
        $n = Count-Overloads -Fn $fn
        Say ("  " + $fn.PadRight(36) + " overloads: " + $n + " (required 1)")
        if ($n -ne 1) { Die ("expected exactly one overload of " + $fn) }
        $body = Get-Def -Fn $fn
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($body)) { Die ($fn + " definition came back empty.") }
        $originals[$fn] = $body
        $c = Count-Inserts -Body $body
        Say ("  " + "".PadRight(36) + " length " + $body.Length + " chars, value INSERTs " +
             $c.Total + ", already owning lineage " + $c.Owned)
        if ($c.Total -lt 1) { Die ($fn + " has no value INSERT matching the expected shape.") }
        if ($body.Contains($Marker)) {
            Say ("  " + "".PadRight(36) + " [SKIP] already carries the T-025c marker.")
        }
        $plans += @{ Fn = $fn; Run = $t.Run; Body = $body; Total = $c.Total; Owned = $c.Owned }
    }

    # T-025b is a PRECONDITION. It is already live; this pack does not repeat it.
    $baseBody = $originals["ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store"]
    $hasB = ([regex]::Matches($baseBody, [regex]::Escape($T025bMarker))).Count
    Say ("  T-025b outcome corrections present  : " + $hasB + " (required 1)")
    if ($hasB -ne 1) {
        Say "  T-025c assumes the T-025b outcome corrections are already installed."
        Die "T-025b marker not found. Apply apply-T-025b-outcome-producer-correction-v2.ps1 first."
    }

    if ($ReportOnly) {
        Rule "REPORT ONLY - EVERY VALUE INSERT THAT WOULD BE CHANGED"
        foreach ($p in $plans) {
            Say ""
            Say ("--- " + $p.Fn + "   run identity: " + $p.Run + " ---")
            $i = 0
            foreach ($m in [regex]::Matches($p.Body, $reInsert)) {
                $i = $i + 1
                $already = "no"
                if ($m.Groups[2].Value -match "\brefresh_run_id\b") { $already = "YES - would be skipped" }
                $head = ($m.Groups[0].Value -replace "\s+", " ")
                if ($head.Length -gt 150) { $head = $head.Substring(0, 150) }
                Say ("  [" + $i + "] already owned: " + $already)
                Say ("      " + $head)
            }
        }
        Rule "WHAT WOULD BE INSERTED"
        Say "  refresh_run_id, is added at the FRONT of each column list and the run"
        Say "  identity at the FRONT of the matching SELECT list, so no existing"
        Say "  column-to-value position moves."
        Say ""
        Say "No file was written and no database object was changed."
        exit 0
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ BACKUP
    Rule "BACKUP"
    $backupDir = Join-Path $repoRoot ("tools\packs\_backup_T-025c-insert-time-lineage_" + $stamp)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDir -Force | Out-Null
    $restoreLines = "Restore BOTH function definitions, base first:`r`n"
    foreach ($p in $plans) {
        $bf = Join-Path $backupDir ($p.Fn + "_original.sql")
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($bf, $p.Body, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
        Say ("  saved : " + $bf)
        $restoreLines += ("  psql -h $PgHost -p $PgPort -U $PgUser -d $Database -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f `"" + $bf + "`"`r`n")
    }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $backupDir "RESTORE.txt"), $restoreLines,
        (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ EDIT AND APPLY
    Rule "EDIT AND APPLY"
    $applied = @()
    foreach ($p in $plans) {
        $runExpr = $p.Run
        $script:changed = 0
        $ev = [System.Text.RegularExpressions.MatchEvaluator]{
            param($m)
            if ($m.Groups[2].Value -match "\brefresh_run_id\b") { return $m.Value }
            $script:changed = $script:changed + 1
            return ($m.Groups[1].Value + "refresh_run_id, " + $m.Groups[2].Value +
                    $m.Groups[3].Value + $script:runExprForEval + ", ")
        }
        $script:runExprForEval = $runExpr
        $updated = [regex]::Replace($p.Body, $reInsert, $ev)
        Say ("  " + $p.Fn.PadRight(36) + " INSERTs rewritten: " + $script:changed +
             " of " + $p.Total)
        if ($script:changed -lt 1 -and $p.Owned -lt $p.Total) {
            Die ($p.Fn + ": nothing was rewritten and not everything was already owned.")
        }

        # Marker goes immediately after the language declaration so it survives
        # pg_get_functiondef and is trivially assertable.
        if (-not $updated.Contains($Marker)) {
            $updated = [regex]::Replace($updated, "(AS\s*\`$function\`$|AS\s*\`$\`$)",
                ('$1' + "`r`n-- " + $Marker + " - run identity supplied at row creation, never stamped after."), 1)
        }

        $nonAscii = 0
        foreach ($ch in $updated.ToCharArray()) {
            if ([int]$ch -gt 126 -and [int]$ch -ne 10 -and [int]$ch -ne 13) { $nonAscii = $nonAscii + 1 }
        }
        if ($nonAscii -ne 0) { Die ($p.Fn + ": refusing to install a body containing non-ASCII.") }

        $af = Join-Path $backupDir ($p.Fn + "_corrected.sql")
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($af, ($updated + "`r`n"), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
        $res = Invoke-SqlFile -Path $af -Tag ("apply_" + $p.Fn)
        if ($res.ExitCode -ne 0) {
            Say ("[FAIL] CREATE OR REPLACE failed for " + $p.Fn + " : " + $res.Error.Trim())
            Say "  rolling back anything already applied in this pack."
            foreach ($done in $applied) {
                $rb = Join-Path $backupDir ($done + "_original.sql")
                Invoke-SqlFile -Path $rb -Tag ("revert_" + $done) | Out-Null
            }
            Die "apply failed."
        }
        Say ("  " + $p.Fn.PadRight(36) + " CREATE OR REPLACE succeeded")
        $applied += $p.Fn
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ SELF-CHECK
    Rule "SELF-CHECK"
    $bad = 0
    foreach ($p in $plans) {
        $fn = $p.Fn
        $after = Get-Def -Fn $fn
        Say ""
        Say ("  --- " + $fn + " ---")

        $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, [regex]::Escape($Marker))).Count
        Say ("    T-025c marker present              : " + $c + " (required 1)")
        if ($c -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

        # THE END-STATE ASSERTION. Not "did the edit run" but "is every value
        # INSERT now owned at creation". A magic count would go stale; this
        # cannot, because it compares the body against itself.
        $cnt = Count-Inserts -Body $after
        Say ("    value INSERTs                      : " + $cnt.Total)
        Say ("    of those owning lineage            : " + $cnt.Owned + " (required " + $cnt.Total + ")")
        if ($cnt.Owned -ne $cnt.Total) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
        if ($cnt.Total -ne $p.Total) {
            Say ("    [FAIL] the number of value INSERTs changed from " + $p.Total)
            $bad = $bad + 1
        }

        $c = ([regex]::Matches($after, ("\)\s*SELECT\s+" + [regex]::Escape($p.Run) + ","))).Count
        Say ("    SELECTs leading with " + $p.Run.PadRight(14) + ": " + $c + " (required " + $cnt.Total + ")")
        if ($c -ne $cnt.Total) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

        # FROZEN. Token counts must be identical - none of these is touched.
        foreach ($frozen in @("ml_feature_store_refresh_runs", "source_system",
                              "pg_advisory", "engine_key", "engine_version")) {
            $b = ([regex]::Matches($p.Body, [regex]::Escape($frozen))).Count
            $a2 = ([regex]::Matches($after,  [regex]::Escape($frozen))).Count
            Say ("    frozen '" + $frozen.PadRight(30) + "' before/after : " + $b + " / " + $a2)
            if ($b -ne $a2) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
        }
    }

    Say ""
    Say "  --- the invariant itself, read from the catalogue ---"
    $inv = Invoke-SqlText -Tag "invariant" -Sql @"
SELECT table_name, column_name, is_nullable
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'public'
  AND table_name IN ('ml_feature_values', 'ml_outcome_values')
  AND column_name = 'refresh_run_id'
ORDER BY table_name;
"@
    Say $inv.Output
    $nullable = Invoke-SqlText -Tag "nullable" -Raw -Sql @"
SELECT count(*)::text FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'public'
  AND table_name IN ('ml_feature_values', 'ml_outcome_values')
  AND column_name = 'refresh_run_id' AND is_nullable = 'YES';
"@
    $nn = -1
    foreach ($line in ($nullable.Output -split "`n")) {
        $t = $line.Trim()
        if ($t -match "^\d+$") { $nn = [int]$t; break }
    }
    Say ("    columns still NULLABLE             : " + $nn + " (required 0 - NOT NULL must survive)")
    if ($nn -ne 0) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ GATE
    Rule "GATE"
    if ($bad -gt 0) {
        Say ("SELF-CHECK FAILED with " + $bad + " problem(s). AUTO-REVERTING BOTH FUNCTIONS.")
        foreach ($done in $applied) {
            $rb = Join-Path $backupDir ($done + "_original.sql")
            $r = Invoke-SqlFile -Path $rb -Tag ("revert2_" + $done)
            if ($r.ExitCode -eq 0) { Say ("  restored " + $done) }
            else { Say ("  [CRITICAL] revert FAILED for " + $done + " : " + $r.Error.Trim()) }
        }
        exit 1
    }
    Say "T-025c APPLIED - all self-checks green. NO REFRESH HAS BEEN RUN."
    Say ""
    Say "Insert-time ownership is NOT proven by reading the stamping UPDATE. It is"
    Say "proven by a refresh succeeding at all while refresh_run_id is NOT NULL -"
    Say "any row not owned at insert would be rejected by the constraint."
    Say ""
    Say "NEXT:"
    Say "  .\tools\run\Invoke-PpiqT025Corrective-v2.ps1"
    Say ""
    Say ("Revert : see " + (Join-Path $backupDir "RESTORE.txt"))
}
finally {
    Remove-Item Env:\PGPASSWORD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
exit 0

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-025 closure record. Writes TWO documents. No database, no engine,
    no refresh, no source change.

.DESCRIPTION
    Per the ruling: record the current state honestly with produced findings,
    exclusions, readiness-blocked runs, not-configured learning and bounded risk
    execution all kept separate, then record the T216 capability gap explicitly so
    it does not disappear when T-025 closes.

    ONE THING IN THE RULING DOES NOT MATCH THE DATABASE AND IS WRITTEN AS
    MEASURED, NOT AS EXPECTED. The ruling asked the evidence to prove
    reason = "unsupported method pairing". The recorded reason is

    NotApplicable exactly as expected; the reason string is wrong, because Measure
    returns NaN for an unsupported pairing just as it does for a constant input
    and the exclusion path attributes every NaN to zero variance. Both documents
    quote the recorded reason verbatim and then state why it is misleading, and
    the T216 record carries it as a second defect in the same path.

    This pack writes documents only. It changes nothing that runs.

.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025-closure-record.ps1 -ReportOnly
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025-closure-record.ps1
#>

[CmdletBinding()]

    [switch]$ReportOnly
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:closureBody = @'
# T-025 CLOSURE RECORD - Compute and populate the presentation analysis entities with the real engines

Milestone / Phase : M1 / M1-P1b
Database          : ppiq_presentation
Closed            : 2026-08-05
Backlog authority : PPIQ_Backlog_v2.9.1_03Aug2026 (FROZEN)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THE TASK REQUIRED
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Run the product's own statistical, correlation, feature and readiness engines over
the canonical operational entities and persist what they return. THESE ARE
COMPUTED, NEVER AUTHORED. Where an engine legitimately refuses - insufficient
support, readiness not met - THE REFUSAL IS THE RESULT AND IS PERSISTED AS SUCH.

Validation: every analysis entity row carries a compute run identity that names
the engine, its inputs and its version; no analysis row exists without one;
re-running the engines over the same canonical data reproduces the same results;
at least one genuine refusal is present and rendered honestly; no hand-authored
row is present anywhere in the analysis entities.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. THE FINAL STATE, WITH EACH CATEGORY KEPT SEPARATE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  produced findings              0
  method exclusions             26   defect.severity, one per numeric parameter
  readiness-blocked runs         7   defect.class plus the six unmaterialised outcomes
  learning                       4 catalogued / 0 enabled / NOT CONFIGURED
  bounded risk execution       500 evaluated of 35,910 eligible

AN EXCLUSION IS NOT A FINDING AND IS NOT COUNTED AS ONE. The writer emits one row
into ml_correlation_results_v2 per excluded feature, carrying method
'NotApplicable', sample_size 0 and an evidence_json marked excluded. A finding
carries a method, a coefficient and a sample size above zero. An earlier gate of
mine counted rows in that table and reported PASS on 26 exclusion records; the
corrected gate requires the finding predicate and reports 0.

THE RISK NUMBER IS A BOUNDED ENGINE-EXECUTION PROOF, NOT COVERAGE. 500 of 35,910
material units were evaluated. No customer-visible surface may claim
full-population risk coverage on the strength of it.

THE LEARNING CATALOGUE IS PRESENT AND UNCONFIGURED. Four jobs exist and
ml_learning_job_catalog_v1.is_enabled is NOT NULL DEFAULT false, so all four are
disabled. That is a configuration state, not a missing catalogue. No job was
enabled to manufacture a green result.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. WHAT WAS PROVEN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  insert-time lineage                  PASS
  NOT NULL invariant                   PASS
  corrective refresh A                 PASS   200 in 81.5 s
  corrective refresh B                 PASS   200 in 67.0 s
  row-level reproducibility            PASS   A EXCEPT B = 0, B EXCEPT A = 0 over 517,602 rows
  corrected outcome materialisation    PASS
  stale-result quarantine              PASS   52 rows removed, 466 compute runs preserved
  risk bounded execution               PASS   500 of 35,910
  genuine readiness refusal            PASS   persisted, on corrected data

INSERT-TIME OWNERSHIP IS PROVEN BY THE REFRESH SUCCEEDING AT ALL. With
refresh_run_id NOT NULL on both value tables, any row not owned at creation would
be rejected by the constraint. The proof is not a reading of the post-insert
stamping UPDATE, which is now a no-op and is no longer relied upon for
correctness.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. THE THREE PRODUCER DEFECTS CORRECTED, AND HOW EACH WAS MEASURED
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

4.1 defect.severity was written to a column the loader never reads.
    The producer put qe.severity into severity_value. NpgsqlFeatureVectorLoader
    reads only numeric_value and category_value, so all 5,961 rows arrived with
    both null. A single empty class makes MinorityFraction return 0.0 through its
    g.Count < 2 branch, below the 0.03 readiness floor.
    CORRECTED: severity is now written to category_value as well; severity_value
    is preserved. Measured after: 5,961 rows, three levels -
    low 1,702 (28.552 percent), high 1,894 (31.773), medium 2,365 (39.675).
    Minority fraction 0.28552, readiness Ready.

4.2 defect.class was contaminated by an event_type fallback.
    COALESCE(dc.defect_code, dc.defect_category, qe.event_type) let a quality
    event with no defect catalogue fall through to its event type. Measured
    before: 1,883 of 7,844 rows carried the class "Disposition".
    CORRECTED: the fallback is removed. Measured after: 0 Disposition rows,
    population 5,961, fourteen classes, and SCALE at 1,550 of 5,961 =
    26.002 percent against the 26.0 percent declared in the T-015 catalogue.

4.3 defect.rate_per_m2 was the literal 1.0.
    The insert hardcoded the value and left normalization_denominator NULL.
    Measured before: min 1, max 1 across 7,844 rows. A constant outcome makes
    every correlation against it undefined.
    BOUNDED DENOMINATOR CHECK, PERFORMED BEFORE REMOVING IT: hsm_coils carries
    actual_thickness_mm, actual_width_mm and coil_weight_kg and NO LENGTH. Slabs
    carry length_mm; coils do not. The canonical emit writes exactly four coil
    dimensions - FDT_C, CT_C, THICKNESS_MM, WIDTH_MM - and no LENGTH or AREA
    parameter code exists in the generator. Area could only be reconstructed as
    weight / (thickness x assumed density), and the donor generator records as
    FAULT-1 that weight_kg is drawn independently of the dimensions, so implied
    density is not physical.
    A second, independent corroboration: the v6 producer's own rate_per_m2 insert
    writes normalization_denominator = 1.0 and stamps
    'area_m2_missing_fallback_to_unit' into its provenance JSON. The codebase
    states the gap itself.
    CORRECTED: the outcome is no longer materialised. Measured after: 0 rows. The
    definition row remains and the outcome reports as not materialised, which is
    the honest state. A missing honest outcome is preferable to a fabricated
    analytical metric.

4.4 A fourth defect, in the schema-versus-producer contract.
    Enforcing refresh_run_id NOT NULL made both producers unrunnable, because they
    inserted value rows without lineage and stamped them afterwards. Every refresh
    failed with 23502 until the run identity was supplied at insert in all five
    live value INSERTs - three in the base producer using v_run_id, two in v6
    using v_base.run_id, so base rows and v6 rows share one authoritative run.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. THE REMAINING ZERO-FINDING CONDITION IS A PRODUCT CAPABILITY GAP
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

defect.severity now holds valid categorical data and clears readiness. It then
excluded all 26 parameters. The cause is not the data.

Backend/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core/Methods/MethodSelector.cs covers four cases:

  Numeric      x Numeric        -> Spearman, or MutualInformation if nonlinear
  Binary       x Numeric        -> PointBiserial
  Categorical  x Categorical    -> CramersV
  anything else                 -> NotApplicable, IsApplicable = false

MapOutcome maps both 'multinomial' and 'ordinal' to VariableType.Categorical.
Every materialised outcome is therefore Categorical and all 26 features at grain
coil are Numeric. Numeric x Categorical has no entry, so the selector returns
NotApplicable for every parameter, Measure returns NaN, and every parameter is
excluded. NO PAIRING AVAILABLE IN THE CURRENT CANONICAL POPULATION CAN PRODUCE A
FINDING, REGARDLESS OF READINESS.

THE RECORDED EXCLUSION REASON IS MISLEADING AND IS QUOTED HERE VERBATIM SO THAT
NOBODY IS SENT AFTER THE WRONG THING:

  method = NotApplicable
  reason = "Undefined statistic (constant / zero-variance input)."

The method is correct. The reason is not. Measure returns NaN for an unsupported
pairing exactly as it does for a constant input, and the exclusion path attributes
every NaN to zero variance. The parameters in question carry between 1,096 and
4,528 distinct values each over 7,247 to 7,844 aligned pairs, so zero variance is
demonstrably false. The engine is blaming the data for a missing method.

Owner: T216 rigorous statistics. See T216_capability_gap_numeric_x_categorical.md.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. WHAT WAS DELIBERATELY NOT DONE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  - No ANOVA, eta-squared, Kruskal-Wallis or other Numeric x Categorical method
    was implemented. That is T216 scope and belongs outside a data task.
  - No new numeric outcome was created to force a positive correlation finding.
  - No third Feature Store refresh was performed.
  - No learning job was enabled.
  - NpgsqlFeatureVectorLoader was not modified; the defect was local to the
    producers.
  - NOT NULL was not weakened. The producers were corrected to satisfy it.
  - The v6 rate_per_m2 semantics were left unchanged. Lineage was added there;
    the mislabelled metric is recorded, not silently corrected, because it is
    outside this task and v6 is not the path the API calls.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. EVIDENCE FILES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  docs/m1/evidence/T-025_readiness_diagnosis_20260805_104841.txt
  docs/m1/evidence/T-025_readiness_diagnosis_B_20260805_105315.txt
  docs/m1/evidence/T-025_corrective_v2_20260805_112352.txt
  docs/m1/evidence/T-025_exclusion_reasons_20260805_113814.txt

  tools/packs/apply-T-025a-risk-matrix-entry.ps1
  tools/packs/apply-T-025b-outcome-producer-correction-v2.ps1

  tools/run/Invoke-PpiqT025Readiness.ps1
  tools/run/Invoke-PpiqT025ReadinessB.ps1
  tools/run/Invoke-PpiqT025Corrective-v2.ps1
  tools/run/Invoke-PpiqT025ExclusionReasons.ps1

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. STATUS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

T-025 = DONE.

The Feature Store is closed permanently and is not to be reopened. The outcome
producer is frozen. Zero findings is the measured truth about what this product
can currently compute from this plant, and it is recorded as such rather than
worked around.

'@

$script:t216Body = @'
# T216 CAPABILITY GAP - no Numeric-feature x categorical-outcome statistical method

Raised    : 2026-08-05, from T-025 execution evidence
Owner     : T216 rigorous statistics
Severity  : blocks any correlation finding against a categorical outcome
Status    : OPEN

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
THE GAP
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Backend/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core/Methods/MethodSelector.cs selects a method
from the shape of the variable pair:

  Numeric      x Numeric        -> Spearman, or MutualInformation if nonlinear
  Binary       x Numeric        -> PointBiserial
  Categorical  x Categorical    -> CramersV
  anything else                 -> NotApplicable, IsApplicable = false

There is no Numeric x Categorical entry. A numeric process parameter measured
against a categorical or ordinal quality outcome has no selectable test, so the
engine excludes every parameter and returns no finding.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
THE CURRENT EXAMPLE, MEASURED
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  outcome  : defect.severity, declared 'ordinal', mapped to Categorical
             5,961 rows, three levels, low 28.552 / high 31.773 / medium 39.675
             readiness gate: Ready, minority fraction 0.28552
  features : 26 numeric parameters at grain coil, 7,247 to 7,844 aligned pairs
             each, 1,096 to 4,528 distinct values each
  result   : 26 of 26 excluded, 0 findings

The same applies to defect.class, declared 'multinomial'. Every materialised
outcome in the presentation database is categorical and every feature is numeric.

This is the first question an industrial user asks: does tap temperature relate to
defect severity. The candidate methods are one-way ANOVA, eta-squared, or
Kruskal-Wallis for the ordinal case. None is present.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A SECOND DEFECT IN THE SAME PATH - THE REASON STRING IS WRONG
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The exclusion is persisted as:

  method = NotApplicable
  reason = "Undefined statistic (constant / zero-variance input)."

Measure returns NaN for an unsupported pairing exactly as it does for a constant
input, and AdvancedCorrelationComputeService attributes every NaN to zero
variance. The parameters carry thousands of distinct values, so the recorded
reason is demonstrably false and points an investigator at the data instead of at
the method matrix.

Whoever closes the method gap should also give the unsupported-pairing case its
own exclusion reason, so that a future reader is told the truth.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WHY THIS WAS NOT FIXED IN T-025
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Adding a statistical method is T216 scope. Implementing it inside a data task
would pull rigorous-statistics work into M1-P1b, and creating a new numeric
outcome purely to obtain a positive finding would be manufacturing a result. The
ruling was to record the gap and close T-025 on the corrected honest state.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DEPENDENCY NOTE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If a later task requires a positive correlation finding against a categorical
outcome - T-026 or T-027 are the near candidates - T216 is its dependency. T-025
is not to be reopened to manufacture one.

'@


function Say  { param([string]$T) Write-Host $T }
function Rule { param([string]$T) Say ""; Say ("=" * 78); Say $T; Say ("=" * 78) }

$repoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$stamp    = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$outDir   = Join-Path $repoRoot "docs\m1\evidence"

$files = @(
    @{ Name = "T-025_CLOSURE.md";                              Body = $script:closureBody },
    @{ Name = "T216_capability_gap_numeric_x_categorical.md";  Body = $script:t216Body }
)

Rule "PPIQ T-025 CLOSURE RECORD"
Say ("Repo      : " + $repoRoot)
Say ("Output    : " + $outDir)

Rule "PREFLIGHT"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outDir)) {
    Say ("  evidence folder does not exist and will be created")
} else {
    Say ("  evidence folder present")
}
foreach ($f in $files) {
    $p = Join-Path $outDir $f.Name
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) {
        Say ("  " + $f.Name.PadRight(48) + " EXISTS - would be backed up then replaced")
    } else {
        Say ("  " + $f.Name.PadRight(48) + " new")
    }
    $na = 0
    foreach ($ch in $f.Body.ToCharArray()) {
        if ([int]$ch -gt 126 -and [int]$ch -ne 10 -and [int]$ch -ne 13) { $na = $na + 1 }
    }
    Say ("  " + "".PadRight(48) + " non-ASCII " + $na + " (required 0), " +
         $f.Body.Length + " chars")
    if ($na -ne 0) { Say "[FAIL] refusing to write non-ASCII."; exit 1 }
}

if ($ReportOnly) {
    Say ""
    Say "REPORT ONLY - no file was written."
    exit 0
}

Rule "WRITE"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $outDir -Force | Out-Null
}
$backupDir = Join-Path $repoRoot ("tools\packs\_backup_T-025-closure-record_" + $stamp)
$enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
foreach ($f in $files) {
    $p = Join-Path $outDir $f.Name
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $backupDir)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDir -Force | Out-Null
        }
        Copy-Item $p (Join-Path $backupDir $f.Name) -Force
        Say ("  backed up " + $f.Name)
    }
    $crlf = ($f.Body -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $crlf, $enc)
    Say ("  wrote " + $p)
}

Rule "SELF-CHECK"
$bad = 0
foreach ($f in $files) {
    $p = Join-Path $outDir $f.Name
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { Say ("[FAIL] missing " + $f.Name); $bad = $bad + 1; continue }
    $txt = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p)
    $hasBom = ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 239 -and $bytes[1] -eq 187 -and $bytes[2] -eq 191)
    $na = 0
    foreach ($ch in $txt.ToCharArray()) {
        if ([int]$ch -gt 126 -and [int]$ch -ne 10 -and [int]$ch -ne 13) { $na = $na + 1 }
    }
    Say ("  " + $f.Name.PadRight(48) + " bytes " + $bytes.Length + ", BOM " + $hasBom + ", non-ASCII " + $na)
    if ($hasBom) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    if ($na -ne 0) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    if ($txt.Length -ne $f.Body.Length -and $txt.Length -lt 100) { Say "[FAIL] suspiciously short"; $bad = $bad + 1 }
}

# The closure document must keep the five categories separate and must NOT claim
# a finding. These name the exact artifacts required by the ruling.
$closure = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $outDir "T-025_CLOSURE.md"))
foreach ($needle in @("produced findings              0",
                      "method exclusions             26",
                      "readiness-blocked runs         7",
                      "4 catalogued / 0 enabled / NOT CONFIGURED",
                      "500 evaluated of 35,910 eligible",
                      "AN EXCLUSION IS NOT A FINDING")) {
    $c = ([regex]::Matches($closure, [regex]::Escape($needle))).Count
    Say ("  closure states '" + $needle.Trim() + "' : " + $c + " (required at least 1)")
    if ($c -lt 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
}

Rule "GATE"
if ($bad -gt 0) {
    Say ("SELF-CHECK FAILED with " + $bad + " problem(s).")
    Say "The written documents are left in place for inspection; nothing that runs"
    Say "was changed by this pack, so there is nothing to revert."
    exit 1
}
Say "T-025 CLOSURE RECORD WRITTEN - all self-checks green."
Say ""
Say "Commit:"
Say "  git add docs/m1/evidence/T-025_CLOSURE.md docs/m1/evidence/T216_capability_gap_numeric_x_categorical.md"
Say "  git commit -m `"T-025 closure record and T216 numeric x categorical capability gap`""
Say ""
Say "REMAINING: T-024 requirement 8, the browser acceptance."
exit 0
