[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\apply-T-025d-durability.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=578, SizeKB=28.77, SHA256='21783DE15761771A19FF9EC0E98F73C578CCC7FB7D611317FD3EE2A0127BBF12', Modified='2026-08-05 14:38:23']

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-025d - source-of-truth durability. Makes the numbered SQL replay chain
    converge on the proven T-025 state. NO analytical execution of any kind.

.DESCRIPTION
    THE DEFECT. The authoritative rebuild mechanism is the numbered SQL replay
    chain - New-AcceptanceEmptyDb.ps1 states it, and there are no EF migration
    artifacts in the repository. Four things the live database depends on are
    absent from that chain:

      refresh_run_id column, FK, index, engine_key/engine_version
          lived only in tools/run/Invoke-PpiqT025LineageMigration.ps1, which is
          tracked but is a PowerShell runner and is not part of the replay
      corrected base producer   (T-025b outcome fixes + T-025c insert-time lineage)
          lived only in the live database
      corrected v6 producer     (T-025c insert-time lineage)
          lived only in the live database
      refresh_run_id NOT NULL
          lived only in the live database

    refresh_run_id appears in ZERO tracked .sql files, and 200_phase02 creates
    ml_feature_values without it. Meanwhile Rebuild-PresentationDb.ps1 re-applies
    741 on every rebuild - its own comment says it must, "or the engine re-blinds
    on every rebuild". So a fresh replay converged on the OLD semantics against a
    table with no lineage column.

    THE FIX. One numbered script, 760, becomes the final convergent authority for
    the complete durability contract. 201 and 741 are NOT patched: the replay may
    still encounter the earlier definitions, and 760 supersedes them at the end.
    Acceptance is that a full ordered replay reaches 760 and lands on the proven
    state - not that every historical script independently carries the latest body.

    THE FUNCTION BODIES ARE CAPTURED, NOT REWRITTEN. pg_get_functiondef of the
    live, proven functions is embedded verbatim. Parity is therefore by
    construction rather than by argument, which matters because the live bodies
    have drifted from 741 and 201 through patches that were never tracked.

    NOT NULL FAILS CLOSED. 760 adds the lineage objects, installs the corrected
    producers, then verifies there are ZERO rows with refresh_run_id IS NULL
    before enforcing NOT NULL. If legacy rows lack lineage it RAISES with an
    instruction to regenerate under control. It never backfills an invented run
    identity to make itself apply.

    THE RUNNER STOPS BEING A SECOND DEFINITION. Its command surface is preserved;
    only the block that assembled its own SQL is replaced by a read of 760. If
    that block does not match exactly - because the parallel worker has changed it
    - this pack FAILS CLOSED and leaves the runner untouched rather than
    overwriting somebody else's edit.

    NO REFRESH. No feature store, correlation, risk or learning execution. The
    only database access is read-only capture and read-only verification.

.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025d-durability.ps1 -ReportOnly
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025d-durability.ps1
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [string]$PgHost     = "127.0.0.1",
    [int]   $PgPort     = 5432,
    [string]$PgUser     = "ppiq_dev",
    [string]$PgPassword = "ppiq_dev_local_only",
    [string]$Database   = "ppiq_presentation",
    [string]$PsqlPath   = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$SqlName   = "760_t025_lineage_and_outcome_producer.sql"
$MarkerB   = "PPIQ T-025b outcome producer correction"
$MarkerC   = "PPIQ T-025c insert-time lineage"
$MarkerD   = "PPIQ T-025d authoritative durability definition"

function Say  { param([string]$T) Write-Host $T }
function Rule { param([string]$T) Say ""; Say ("=" * 78); Say $T; Say ("=" * 78) }
function Die  { param([string]$T) Say ("[FAIL] " + $T); exit 1 }

function Read-IfExists {
    param([string]$Path)
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
    return ""
}
function Resolve-Psql {
    param([string]$Explicit)
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Explicit)) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Explicit) { return $Explicit }
        return $null
    }
    $c = Get-Command psql.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -ne $c) { return $c.Source }
    foreach ($p in @("C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\15\bin\psql.exe")) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { return $p }
    }
    return $null
}
function Invoke-SqlText {
    param([string]$Sql, [string]$Tag)
    $f = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".sql")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($f, $Sql, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    $o = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".out")
    $e = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".err")
    $a = @("-X", "-w", "-A", "-t", "-h", $PgHost, "-p", "$PgPort", "-U", $PgUser,
           "-d", $Database, "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1", "-f", $f, "-o", $o)
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $script:psql -ArgumentList $a -NoNewWindow -Wait `
                       -PassThru -RedirectStandardError $e
    $r = New-Object psobject
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name ExitCode -Value $p.ExitCode
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Output   -Value (Read-IfExists $o)
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Error    -Value (Read-IfExists $e)
    return $r
}
function Get-Def {
    param([string]$Fn)
    $r = Invoke-SqlText -Tag ("def_" + $Fn) -Sql @"
SELECT pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = '$Fn' AND p.prokind = 'f';
"@
    if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { Die ("could not read " + $Fn + " : " + $r.Error.Trim()) }
    return $r.Output
}
function Get-Scalar {
    param([string]$Sql, [string]$Tag)
    $r = Invoke-SqlText -Sql $Sql -Tag $Tag
    foreach ($line in ($r.Output -split "`n")) {
        $t = $line.Trim()
        if ($t.Length -gt 0) { return $t }
    }
    return ""
}
# The predicate set that defines "the proven T-025 semantics". Used on the live
# bodies AND on the generated file, so parity is checked rather than assumed.
function Get-Semantics {
    param([string]$Body)
    $reInsert = "(INSERT\s+INTO\s+public\.ml_(?:feature|outcome)_values\s*\(\s*)([^)]*?)(\)\s*SELECT\s+)"
    $total = 0; $owned = 0
    foreach ($m in [regex]::Matches($Body, $reInsert)) {
        $total = $total + 1
        if ($m.Groups[2].Value -match "\brefresh_run_id\b") { $owned = $owned + 1 }
    }
    $s = New-Object psobject
    Add-Member -InputObject $s -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Inserts     -Value $total
    Add-Member -InputObject $s -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Owned       -Value $owned
    Add-Member -InputObject $s -MemberType NoteProperty -Name EventType   -Value ([regex]::Matches($Body, "qe\.event_type\s*\)")).Count
    Add-Member -InputObject $s -MemberType NoteProperty -Name FakeRate    -Value ([regex]::Matches($Body, "qe\.event_at_utc\s*,\s*1\.0\s*,")).Count
    Add-Member -InputObject $s -MemberType NoteProperty -Name SeverityCat -Value ([regex]::Matches($Body, "COALESCE\(\s*dc\.defect_code\s*,\s*dc\.defect_category\s*\)\s*WHEN\s+od\.outcome_key\s*=\s*'defect\.severity'\s*THEN\s+qe\.severity")).Count
    return $s
}

Rule "PPIQ T-025d - SOURCE-OF-TRUTH DURABILITY"
$repoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$script:psql = Resolve-Psql -Explicit $PsqlPath
if ($null -eq $script:psql) { Die "psql.exe not found." }
$env:PGPASSWORD = $PgPassword
$env:PGCLIENTENCODING = "UTF8"
$stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$script:tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("ppiq_t025d_" + $stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:tmp -Force | Out-Null

$sqlPath     = Join-Path $repoRoot ("Backend\database\scripts\" + $SqlName)
$rebuildPath = Join-Path $repoRoot "scripts\demo\Rebuild-PresentationDb.ps1"
$serverPath  = Join-Path $repoRoot "deploy\server\apply-server-db-scripts.sh"
$runnerPath  = Join-Path $repoRoot "tools\run\Invoke-PpiqT025LineageMigration.ps1"
$closurePath = Join-Path $repoRoot "docs\m1\evidence\T-025_CLOSURE.md"

try {
    # ------------------------------------------------------------ PREFLIGHT
    Rule "PREFLIGHT"
    foreach ($f in @($rebuildPath, $serverPath, $runnerPath, $closurePath)) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Die ("missing tracked file: " + $f) }
        Say ("  present : " + $f.Substring($repoRoot.Length + 1))
    }

    foreach ($fn in @("ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store", "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store_v6")) {
        $n = Get-Scalar -Tag ("ov_" + $fn) -Sql @"
SELECT count(*)::text FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = '$fn' AND p.prokind = 'f';
"@
        Say ("  " + $fn.PadRight(36) + " overloads " + $n + " (required 1)")
        if ($n -ne "1") { Die ("expected exactly one overload of " + $fn) }
    }

    $baseDef = Get-Def -Fn "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store"
    $v6Def   = Get-Def -Fn "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store_v6"
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($baseDef) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($v6Def)) {
        Die "a live definition came back empty."
    }

    # CAPTURING AN UNCORRECTED BODY WOULD MAKE THE DEFECT PERMANENT IN TRACKED
    # SOURCE, which is worse than leaving it untracked. Refuse unless proven.
    $hasB = ([regex]::Matches($baseDef, [regex]::Escape($MarkerB))).Count
    $hasCb = ([regex]::Matches($baseDef, [regex]::Escape($MarkerC))).Count
    $hasCv = ([regex]::Matches($v6Def,   [regex]::Escape($MarkerC))).Count
    Say ("  base carries T-025b               : " + $hasB + " (required 1)")
    Say ("  base carries T-025c               : " + $hasCb + " (required 1)")
    Say ("  v6 carries T-025c                 : " + $hasCv + " (required 1)")
    if ($hasB -ne 1 -or $hasCb -ne 1 -or $hasCv -ne 1) {
        Die "the live functions are not the corrected ones. Refusing to freeze an uncorrected body into tracked source."
    }

    $liveBase = Get-Semantics -Body $baseDef
    $liveV6   = Get-Semantics -Body $v6Def
    Say ("  live base : inserts " + $liveBase.Inserts + ", owning lineage " + $liveBase.Owned +
         ", event_type fallback " + $liveBase.EventType + ", literal-1.0 rate " + $liveBase.FakeRate +
         ", severity-in-category " + $liveBase.SeverityCat)
    Say ("  live v6   : inserts " + $liveV6.Inserts + ", owning lineage " + $liveV6.Owned)
    if ($liveBase.Owned -ne $liveBase.Inserts -or $liveV6.Owned -ne $liveV6.Inserts) {
        Die "a live value INSERT does not own its lineage. The live state is not the proven one."
    }
    if ($liveBase.EventType -ne 0 -or $liveBase.FakeRate -ne 0 -or $liveBase.SeverityCat -ne 1) {
        Die "the live base producer does not carry the T-025b semantics."
    }

    $nullRows = Get-Scalar -Tag "nulls" -Sql @"
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ml_feature_values WHERE refresh_run_id IS NULL)
     + (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ml_outcome_values WHERE refresh_run_id IS NULL);
"@
    Say ("  live rows without lineage         : " + $nullRows + " (required 0)")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ GENERATE
    Rule "GENERATE " + $SqlName
    $nl = "`r`n"
    $header = @"
-- ============================================================================
-- $SqlName
-- $MarkerD
--
-- THE AUTHORITATIVE TRACKED DEFINITION OF THE COMPLETE T-025 DURABILITY STATE.
--
-- WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The numbered SQL replay chain is the real rebuild
-- mechanism for this product - New-AcceptanceEmptyDb.ps1 states it, and there
-- are no EF migration artifacts in the repository. Before this file, four
-- things the live database depended on were absent from that chain: the
-- refresh_run_id lineage objects, the corrected base producer, the corrected v6
-- producer, and the NOT NULL invariant. refresh_run_id appeared in no tracked
-- .sql file at all, while Rebuild-PresentationDb.ps1 re-applied 741 on every
-- rebuild. A full replay therefore converged on the OLD semantics against a
-- table that had no lineage column.
--
-- WHAT IT SUPERSEDES. This script is the FINAL convergent authority for the two
-- refresh producers. The earlier definitions are deliberately left unmodified
-- and are expected to be encountered first during an ordered replay:
--     200_phase02_ml_foundation_feature_store_pgvector.sql  creates the tables
--     201_phase02_ml_feature_store_v6_completion.sql        defines v6
--     740_feature_store_heat_lineage_and_defect_outcomes.sql
--     741_feature_store_coil_grain_projection.sql           defines the base
-- Acceptance is that a full ordered replay REACHES THIS FILE and lands on the
-- proven state, not that every historical script independently carries the
-- latest body.
--
-- THE SEMANTICS FROZEN HERE, each proven in ppiq_presentation before capture:
--     defect.class        no qe.event_type fallback into the defect taxonomy
--     defect.severity     category_value populated so the loader can see it
--     defect.rate_per_m2  the false literal-1.0 materialisation removed; no
--                         authoritative m2 denominator exists in canonical
--     base INSERTs        refresh_run_id supplied at row creation
--     v6 INSERTs          the same authoritative run supplied at row creation
--
-- The post-insert NULL-stamping UPDATE is retained inside the captured bodies.
-- It is a proven no-op once every INSERT owns its lineage, and it is NOT relied
-- upon for correctness. It may be retired separately.
--
-- THE FUNCTION BODIES BELOW ARE pg_get_functiondef OUTPUT CAPTURED VERBATIM from
-- the proven live functions. They are not re-derived, because the live bodies had
-- drifted from 741 and 201 through patches that were never tracked.
--
-- NO TRANSACTION CONTROL. This file contains no BEGIN or COMMIT so that it
-- composes with psql -1 in Rebuild-PresentationDb.ps1 and with the autocommit
-- replay in deploy/server/apply-server-db-scripts.sh without warnings.
--
-- Captured from : $Database
-- Captured at   : $stamp
-- ============================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. LINEAGE
ALTER TABLE public.ml_feature_values
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS refresh_run_id uuid NULL;
ALTER TABLE public.ml_outcome_values
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS refresh_run_id uuid NULL;

-- engine identity on the AUTHORITATIVE run record. No second run concept.
ALTER TABLE public.ml_feature_store_refresh_runs
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS engine_key text NULL;
ALTER TABLE public.ml_feature_store_refresh_runs
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS engine_version text NULL;

DO `$ppiq`$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
                  WHERE conname = 'fk_ml_feature_values_refresh_run') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.ml_feature_values
      ADD CONSTRAINT fk_ml_feature_values_refresh_run
      FOREIGN KEY (refresh_run_id)
      REFERENCES public.ml_feature_store_refresh_runs(id);
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
                  WHERE conname = 'fk_ml_outcome_values_refresh_run') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.ml_outcome_values
      ADD CONSTRAINT fk_ml_outcome_values_refresh_run
      FOREIGN KEY (refresh_run_id)
      REFERENCES public.ml_feature_store_refresh_runs(id);
  END IF;
END
`$ppiq`$;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_ml_feature_values_refresh_run_id
  ON public.ml_feature_values (refresh_run_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_ml_outcome_values_refresh_run_id
  ON public.ml_outcome_values (refresh_run_id);

-- ------------------------------------------------- 2. CORRECTED BASE PRODUCER
"@

    $middle = @"

-- --------------------------------------------------- 3. CORRECTED V6 PRODUCER
"@

    $footer = @"

-- ------------------------------------------ 4. THE INVARIANT, FAILING CLOSED
-- Lineage is NOT fabricated for legacy rows to make this script apply. If any
-- derived row has no run identity, the correct response is a controlled
-- regeneration through the authenticated product path, not an invented uuid.
DO `$ppiq`$
DECLARE
  v_orphans bigint;
BEGIN
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ml_feature_values WHERE refresh_run_id IS NULL)
       + (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ml_outcome_values WHERE refresh_run_id IS NULL)
    INTO v_orphans;

  IF v_orphans > 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      MESSAGE = format('T-025d: %s derived row(s) have no refresh_run_id. NOT NULL '
                       'is NOT enforced and no lineage has been fabricated. Clear the '
                       'derived values and regenerate them through the authenticated '
                       'refresh endpoint, then re-apply this script.', v_orphans);
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
              WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ml_feature_values'
                AND column_name = 'refresh_run_id' AND is_nullable = 'YES') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.ml_feature_values ALTER COLUMN refresh_run_id SET NOT NULL;
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
              WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ml_outcome_values'
                AND column_name = 'refresh_run_id' AND is_nullable = 'YES') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.ml_outcome_values ALTER COLUMN refresh_run_id SET NOT NULL;
  END IF;
END
`$ppiq`$;
"@

    $sqlText = $header + $nl + $baseDef.TrimEnd() + ";" + $nl + $middle + $nl +
               $v6Def.TrimEnd() + ";" + $nl + $footer + $nl
    $sqlText = ($sqlText -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"

    $na = 0
    foreach ($ch in $sqlText.ToCharArray()) {
        if ([int]$ch -gt 126 -and [int]$ch -ne 10 -and [int]$ch -ne 13) { $na = $na + 1 }
    }
    Say ("  generated length  : " + $sqlText.Length + " chars")
    Say ("  non-ASCII         : " + $na + " (required 0)")
    if ($na -ne 0) { Die "refusing to write non-ASCII into tracked SQL." }

    $genSem = Get-Semantics -Body $sqlText
    Say ("  generated : inserts " + $genSem.Inserts + ", owning lineage " + $genSem.Owned +
         ", event_type fallback " + $genSem.EventType + ", literal-1.0 rate " + $genSem.FakeRate +
         ", severity-in-category " + $genSem.SeverityCat)

    if ($ReportOnly) {
        Rule "REPORT ONLY"
        Say "Would write:"
        Say ("  " + $SqlName + "  (" + $sqlText.Length + " chars)")
        Say "Would register it in:"
        Say "  scripts\demo\Rebuild-PresentationDb.ps1"
        Say "  deploy\server\apply-server-db-scripts.sh"
        Say "Would delegate tools\run\Invoke-PpiqT025LineageMigration.ps1 to it."
        Say "Would repair the evidence list in docs\m1\evidence\T-025_CLOSURE.md."
        Say ""
        Say "Nothing was written."
        exit 0
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ BACKUP
    Rule "BACKUP"
    $backupDir = Join-Path $repoRoot ("tools\packs\_backup_T-025d-durability_" + $stamp)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDir -Force | Out-Null
    $edited = @()
    foreach ($f in @($rebuildPath, $serverPath, $runnerPath, $closurePath)) {
        Copy-Item $f (Join-Path $backupDir (Split-Path $f -Leaf)) -Force
        Say ("  saved " + (Split-Path $f -Leaf))
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ WRITE 760
    Rule "WRITE THE AUTHORITATIVE SCRIPT"
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($sqlPath, $sqlText, $enc)
    Say ("  wrote " + $sqlPath)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ REGISTER
    Rule "REGISTER IN BOTH REPLAY PATHS"
    $bad = 0

    $rb = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($rebuildPath)
    $rbAnchor = "'741_feature_store_coil_grain_projection.sql','742_feature_regrain_generic.sql','750_forensics_audit_subsystem.sql'"
    if (([regex]::Matches($rb, [regex]::Escape($rbAnchor))).Count -ne 1) {
        Say "[FAIL] the Rebuild-PresentationDb migration list is not the expected one."
        $bad = $bad + 1
    } else {
        $rb = $rb.Replace($rbAnchor, $rbAnchor + ",'" + $SqlName + "'")
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($rebuildPath, $rb, $enc)
        Say "  Rebuild-PresentationDb.ps1 now applies 760 after 741/742/750"
        $edited += $rebuildPath
    }

    $sv = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($serverPath)
    $svAnchor = '  "203_phase02_ml_compute_v6_wrapper_hotfix.sql"'
    if (([regex]::Matches($sv, [regex]::Escape($svAnchor))).Count -ne 1) {
        Say "[FAIL] the server replay list is not the expected one."
        $bad = $bad + 1
    } else {
        $sv = $sv.Replace($svAnchor, $svAnchor + "`n  `"" + $SqlName + "`"")
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($serverPath, $sv, $enc)
        Say "  apply-server-db-scripts.sh now applies 760 last"
        $edited += $serverPath
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ DELEGATE
    Rule "REMOVE THE SECOND DEFINITION"
    $rn = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($runnerPath)
    $reBlock = "(?s)    \`$ddl = @'.*?'@\r?\n    \`$full = \`$ddl \+ \`$newBase[^\r\n]*"
    $hits = ([regex]::Matches($rn, $reBlock)).Count
    Say ("  runner SQL-assembly block matches : " + $hits + " (required 1)")
    if ($hits -ne 1) {
        Say "  [SKIP] FAILING CLOSED on the runner. The block is not the one this pack"
        Say "         was written against, which most likely means the parallel worker"
        Say "         has changed it. The runner is left untouched; 760 is still the"
        Say "         authority and the rest of this correction stands."
    } else {
        $delegate = @"
    # T-025d: THE AUTHORITY IS THE TRACKED SQL, NOT THIS SCRIPT.
    # This runner used to carry its own copy of the lineage DDL and derive the
    # function bodies by transforming the live ones. Two independent definitions
    # of the same contract drift. The numbered replay chain is the real rebuild
    # mechanism, so Backend\database\scripts\$SqlName is now the single
    # source of truth and this runner is an execution vehicle for it.
    `$authoritative = Join-Path `$repoRoot ("Backend\database\scripts\$SqlName")
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath `$authoritative)) {
        Say ("[FAIL] the authoritative script is missing: " + `$authoritative)
        exit 1
    }
    `$full = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(`$authoritative)
"@
        $rn = [regex]::Replace($rn, $reBlock, [System.Text.RegularExpressions.MatchEvaluator]{ param($m) $delegate }, 1)
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($runnerPath, $rn, $enc)
        Say "  runner now executes 760 instead of its own SQL"
        $edited += $runnerPath
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ EVIDENCE
    Rule "REPAIR THE T-025 EVIDENCE REFERENCES"
    $cl = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($closurePath)
    $before = ([regex]::Matches($cl, "tools/packs/apply-T-025")).Count
    Say ("  dangling tools/packs references   : " + $before)
    $oldList = @"
  tools/packs/apply-T-025a-risk-matrix-entry.ps1
  tools/packs/apply-T-025b-outcome-producer-correction-v2.ps1
  tools/packs/apply-T-025c-insert-time-lineage.ps1
"@
    $newList = @"
  Backend/database/scripts/$SqlName
  Backend/PlantProcess.Api/Security/PlantAccessControl.cs
  tools/run/Invoke-PpiqT025LineageMigration.ps1
"@
    $oldList = ($oldList -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"
    $newList = ($newList -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"
    if ($cl.Contains($oldList.TrimEnd("`r", "`n"))) {
        $cl = $cl.Replace($oldList.TrimEnd("`r", "`n"), $newList.TrimEnd("`r", "`n"))
        $note = "`r`n  NOTE: tools/packs/* were EXECUTION VEHICLES, not durable evidence. They are`r`n  gitignored, as are the _backup_* directories. The permanent record of every`r`n  T-025 database change is $SqlName.`r`n"
        $cl = $cl.Replace("--------------------------------------------------------------------------------`r`n8. STATUS", $note + "--------------------------------------------------------------------------------`r`n8. STATUS")
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($closurePath, $cl, $enc)
        $edited += $closurePath
        Say "  replaced the pack list with tracked artifacts"
    } else {
        Say "[FAIL] the evidence list in T-025_CLOSURE.md is not the expected one."
        $bad = $bad + 1
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ SELF-CHECK
    Rule "SELF-CHECK"
    $sqlNow = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($sqlPath)
    $nowSem = Get-Semantics -Body $sqlNow

    Say "  SEMANTIC PARITY, generated file against the live functions:"
    foreach ($pair in @(
        @{ n = "value INSERTs";            a = ($liveBase.Inserts + $liveV6.Inserts);   b = $nowSem.Inserts },
        @{ n = "INSERTs owning lineage";   a = ($liveBase.Owned + $liveV6.Owned);       b = $nowSem.Owned },
        @{ n = "event_type fallback";      a = ($liveBase.EventType + $liveV6.EventType); b = $nowSem.EventType },
        @{ n = "literal-1.0 rate insert";  a = ($liveBase.FakeRate + $liveV6.FakeRate); b = $nowSem.FakeRate },
        @{ n = "severity-in-category";     a = ($liveBase.SeverityCat + $liveV6.SeverityCat); b = $nowSem.SeverityCat })) {
        Say ("    " + $pair.n.PadRight(28) + " live " + $pair.a + " / source " + $pair.b)
        if ($pair.a -ne $pair.b) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    }
    if ($nowSem.Owned -ne $nowSem.Inserts) {
        Say "    [FAIL] a value INSERT in the tracked source does not own its lineage"
        $bad = $bad + 1
    }

    foreach ($needle in @("ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS refresh_run_id",
                          "fk_ml_feature_values_refresh_run",
                          "fk_ml_outcome_values_refresh_run",
                          "ix_ml_feature_values_refresh_run_id",
                          "engine_key",
                          "engine_version",
                          "ALTER COLUMN refresh_run_id SET NOT NULL",
                          "RAISE EXCEPTION",
                          $MarkerD)) {
        $c = ([regex]::Matches($sqlNow, [regex]::Escape($needle))).Count
        Say ("    token '" + $needle + "' : " + $c + " (required at least 1)")
        if ($c -lt 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    }

    $rbNow = Read-IfExists $rebuildPath
    $svNow = Read-IfExists $serverPath
    $rnNow = Read-IfExists $runnerPath
    $clNow = Read-IfExists $closurePath
    Say ("  Rebuild-PresentationDb names 760  : " + ([regex]::Matches($rbNow, [regex]::Escape($SqlName))).Count + " (required at least 1)")
    if (-not $rbNow.Contains($SqlName)) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    Say ("  server replay names 760           : " + ([regex]::Matches($svNow, [regex]::Escape($SqlName))).Count + " (required at least 1)")
    if (-not $svNow.Contains($SqlName)) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    Say ("  runner carries its own DDL still  : " + ([regex]::Matches($rnNow, "ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS refresh_run_id")).Count + " (required 0)")
    if ($rnNow -match "ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS refresh_run_id") { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    $after = ([regex]::Matches($clNow, "tools/packs/apply-T-025")).Count
    Say ("  closure dangling references       : " + $after + " (required 0)")
    if ($after -ne 0) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ GATE
    Rule "GATE"
    if ($bad -gt 0) {
        Say ("SELF-CHECK FAILED with " + $bad + " problem(s). AUTO-REVERTING.")
        foreach ($f in $edited) {
            Copy-Item (Join-Path $backupDir (Split-Path $f -Leaf)) $f -Force
            Say ("  restored " + (Split-Path $f -Leaf))
        }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sqlPath) { Remove-Item $sqlPath -Force; Say "  removed the generated 760" }
        exit 1
    }
    Say "T-025d APPLIED - all self-checks green. NO DATABASE WAS MODIFIED."
    Say ""
    Say "  authoritative rebuild path    = numbered SQL replay"
    Say ("  authoritative T-025 SQL       = " + $SqlName)
    Say "  both rebuild paths registered = PASS"

    Say "  git commit -m `"T-025d durability: 760 becomes the tracked authority for lineage and the corrected producers`""
}

[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\apply-T-025e-v6-eventtype-hotfix.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=281, SizeKB=13.6, SHA256='8F0FE3F1ADD2254A6FE3E6EC7502F20039C10F60E85465D11EEAA1BE117D8BCA', Modified='2026-08-05 14:50:51']

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-025e - post-closure durability hotfix. Removes the qe.event_type
    fallback from the v6 producer, in BOTH the live function and tracked source.

.DESCRIPTION
    WHY THIS IS NOT AN OPEN KNOWN DEFECT. deploy/server/apply-server-db-scripts.sh
    ends by invoking ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store_v6(3650) directly, so the
    fallback is an EXECUTABLE semantic regression on the server path, not dormant
    history. A quality event with no defect catalogue would be promoted into the
    defect taxonomy under its own event type - the contamination measured here as
    1,883 Disposition rows of 7,844 and removed from the base producer by T-025b.

    T-025 REMAINS DONE. This is a narrowly bounded hotfix to a defect found by the
    T-025d parity check, not a reopening. No Feature Store refresh, no correlation
    run, no analysis of any kind.

    BOTH SIDES OR NEITHER. The live function and Backend/database/scripts/760 are
    corrected in the same pack, because correcting one without the other recreates
    exactly the drift T-025d existed to close. If either edit cannot be made
    safely, both are reverted.

    THE ANCHOR IS SHAPE-BASED, NOT LITERAL. The fallback is matched as a COALESCE
    whose final argument is qe.event_type, required to appear EXACTLY ONCE in each
    target. jsonb_build_object('eventType', qe.event_type, ...) is not matched,
    because provenance is not taxonomy and that mention must survive.

.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025e-v6-eventtype-hotfix.ps1 -ReportOnly
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-025e-v6-eventtype-hotfix.ps1
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [string]$PgHost     = "127.0.0.1",
    [int]   $PgPort     = 5432,
    [string]$PgUser     = "ppiq_dev",
    [string]$PgPassword = "ppiq_dev_local_only",
    [string]$Database   = "ppiq_presentation",
    [string]$PsqlPath   = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$SqlName = "760_t025_lineage_and_outcome_producer.sql"
$MarkerE = "PPIQ T-025e v6 defect.class fallback removed"

# A COALESCE whose LAST argument is qe.event_type. No nested parens inside, so it
# cannot run away, and jsonb_build_object(...) is not matched.
$reFallback = "COALESCE\(\s*([^()]*?)\s*,\s*qe\.event_type\s*\)"
# Counts the fallback as a TAXONOMY use. Provenance mentions end in a comma.
$reClassUse = "qe\.event_type\s*\)"

function Say  { param([string]$T) Write-Host $T }
function Rule { param([string]$T) Say ""; Say ("=" * 78); Say $T; Say ("=" * 78) }
function Die  { param([string]$T) Say ("[FAIL] " + $T); exit 1 }

function Read-IfExists {
    param([string]$Path)
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
    return ""
}
function Resolve-Psql {
    param([string]$Explicit)
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Explicit)) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Explicit) { return $Explicit }
        return $null
    }
    $c = Get-Command psql.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -ne $c) { return $c.Source }
    foreach ($p in @("C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17\bin\psql.exe",
                     "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\15\bin\psql.exe")) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { return $p }
    }
    return $null
}
function Invoke-SqlFile {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Tag)
    $e = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".err")
    $o = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".out")
    $a = @("-X", "-w", "-h", $PgHost, "-p", "$PgPort", "-U", $PgUser, "-d", $Database,
           "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1", "-f", $Path, "-o", $o)
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $script:psql -ArgumentList $a -NoNewWindow -Wait `
                       -PassThru -RedirectStandardError $e
    $r = New-Object psobject
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name ExitCode -Value $p.ExitCode
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Error    -Value (Read-IfExists $e)
    return $r
}
function Invoke-SqlText {
    param([string]$Sql, [string]$Tag)
    $f = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".sql")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($f, $Sql, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    $o = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".out")
    $e = Join-Path $script:tmp ($Tag + ".err")
    $a = @("-X", "-w", "-A", "-t", "-h", $PgHost, "-p", "$PgPort", "-U", $PgUser,
           "-d", $Database, "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1", "-f", $f, "-o", $o)
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $script:psql -ArgumentList $a -NoNewWindow -Wait `
                       -PassThru -RedirectStandardError $e
    $r = New-Object psobject
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name ExitCode -Value $p.ExitCode
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Output   -Value (Read-IfExists $o)
    Add-Member -InputObject $r -MemberType NoteProperty -Name Error    -Value (Read-IfExists $e)
    return $r
}
function Get-Def {
    param([string]$Fn)
    $r = Invoke-SqlText -Tag ("def_" + $Fn) -Sql @"
SELECT pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = '$Fn' AND p.prokind = 'f';
"@
    if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { Die ("could not read " + $Fn + " : " + $r.Error.Trim()) }
    return $r.Output
}

Rule "PPIQ T-025e - v6 defect.class FALLBACK HOTFIX"
$repoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$script:psql = Resolve-Psql -Explicit $PsqlPath
if ($null -eq $script:psql) { Die "psql.exe not found." }
$env:PGPASSWORD = $PgPassword
$env:PGCLIENTENCODING = "UTF8"
$stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$script:tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("ppiq_t025e_" + $stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:tmp -Force | Out-Null
$sqlPath = Join-Path $repoRoot ("Backend\database\scripts\" + $SqlName)

try {
    # ------------------------------------------------------------ PREFLIGHT
    Rule "PREFLIGHT"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sqlPath)) { Die ("missing tracked authority: " + $sqlPath) }

    $baseDef = Get-Def -Fn "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store"
    $v6Def   = Get-Def -Fn "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store_v6"
    $srcText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($sqlPath)

    if ($v6Def.Contains($MarkerE)) {
        Say "  [SKIP] the live v6 function already carries the hotfix marker."
        exit 0
    }

    $liveBaseUse = ([regex]::Matches($baseDef, $reClassUse)).Count
    $liveV6Use   = ([regex]::Matches($v6Def,   $reClassUse)).Count
    $srcUse      = ([regex]::Matches($srcText, $reClassUse)).Count
    Say ("  live base  event_type as taxonomy : " + $liveBaseUse + " (required 0, already correct)")
    Say ("  live v6    event_type as taxonomy : " + $liveV6Use + " (required 1, the defect)")
    Say ("  760 source event_type as taxonomy : " + $srcUse + " (required 1, captured at parity)")
    if ($liveBaseUse -ne 0) { Die "the base producer regressed. Stopping - this pack only treats v6." }
    if ($liveV6Use -ne 1)   { Die "expected exactly one v6 taxonomy fallback." }
    if ($srcUse -ne 1)      { Die "expected exactly one fallback in the tracked source." }

    $mV6  = [regex]::Matches($v6Def, $reFallback)
    $mSrc = [regex]::Matches($srcText, $reFallback)
    Say ("  live v6    COALESCE anchor matches : " + $mV6.Count + " (required 1)")
    Say ("  760 source COALESCE anchor matches : " + $mSrc.Count + " (required 1)")
    if ($mV6.Count -ne 1 -or $mSrc.Count -ne 1) { Die "the fallback anchor is not unique." }
    if ($mV6[0].Value -ne $mSrc[0].Value) {
        Say ("    live : " + $mV6[0].Value)
        Say ("    760  : " + $mSrc[0].Value)
        Die "the live and tracked fallbacks differ. They must be identical before both are corrected."
    }

    $oldExpr = $mV6[0].Value
    $newExpr = "COALESCE(" + $mV6[0].Groups[1].Value + ")"
    Say ""
    Say "  BEFORE : $oldExpr"
    Say "  AFTER  : $newExpr"
    Say "  A quality event with no defect catalogue now yields NULL for defect.class"
    Say "  and is excluded by the producer's own IS NOT NULL predicate, exactly as"
    Say "  the base producer has behaved since T-025b."

    # Provenance must SURVIVE. eventType in source_json is not taxonomy.
    $provV6 = ([regex]::Matches($v6Def, "'eventType'\s*,\s*qe\.event_type")).Count
    Say ("  provenance 'eventType' mentions in live v6 : " + $provV6 + " (must be preserved)")

    if ($ReportOnly) {
        Rule "REPORT ONLY"
        Say "Would correct the live v6 function and the tracked 760 definition."
        Say "Nothing was written and no database object was changed."
        exit 0
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ BACKUP
    Rule "BACKUP"
    $backupDir = Join-Path $repoRoot ("tools\packs\_backup_T-025e-v6-hotfix_" + $stamp)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDir -Force | Out-Null
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    $v6Backup = Join-Path $backupDir "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store_v6_original.sql"
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($v6Backup, ($v6Def.TrimEnd() + ";" + "`r`n"), $enc)
    Copy-Item $sqlPath (Join-Path $backupDir $SqlName) -Force
    Say ("  saved " + $v6Backup)
    Say ("  saved " + $SqlName)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ APPLY
    Rule "APPLY - LIVE FUNCTION"
    $newV6 = $v6Def.Replace($oldExpr, $newExpr)
    if (-not $newV6.Contains($MarkerE)) {
        $newV6 = [regex]::Replace($newV6, "(AS\s*\`$function\`$|AS\s*\`$\`$)",
            ('$1' + "`r`n-- " + $MarkerE + " - a quality event with no defect catalogue is no longer promoted into the defect taxonomy."), 1)
    }
    $applyFile = Join-Path $backupDir "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store_v6_corrected.sql"
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($applyFile, ($newV6.TrimEnd() + ";" + "`r`n"), $enc)
    $res = Invoke-SqlFile -Path $applyFile -Tag "apply_v6"
    if ($res.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Say ("[FAIL] CREATE OR REPLACE failed: " + $res.Error.Trim())
        Say "  the previous definition is untouched because the statement did not commit."
        Die "apply failed."
    }
    Say "  live v6 CREATE OR REPLACE succeeded"

    Rule "APPLY - TRACKED SOURCE"
    $newSrc = $srcText.Replace($oldExpr, $newExpr)
    $newSrc = $newSrc.Replace("-- Captured from : ",
        ("-- " + $MarkerE + "`r`n-- Captured from : "))
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($sqlPath, $newSrc, $enc)
    Say ("  wrote " + $SqlName)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ SELF-CHECK
    Rule "SELF-CHECK - FINAL PARITY"
    $bad = 0
    $baseAfter = Get-Def -Fn "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store"
    $v6After   = Get-Def -Fn "ppiq_ml_refresh_feature_store_v6"
    $srcAfter  = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($sqlPath)

    $cLiveBase = ([regex]::Matches($baseAfter, $reClassUse)).Count
    $cLiveV6   = ([regex]::Matches($v6After,   $reClassUse)).Count
    $cSrc      = ([regex]::Matches($srcAfter,  $reClassUse)).Count
    Say ("  event_type fallback  live base  : " + $cLiveBase + " (required 0)")
    Say ("  event_type fallback  live v6    : " + $cLiveV6 + " (required 0)")
    Say ("  event_type fallback  source     : " + $cSrc + " (required 0, covers BOTH bodies)")
    if ($cLiveBase -ne 0 -or $cLiveV6 -ne 0 -or $cSrc -ne 0) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $cMark = ([regex]::Matches($v6After, [regex]::Escape($MarkerE))).Count
    Say ("  hotfix marker in live v6        : " + $cMark + " (required 1)")
    if ($cMark -ne 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    # Provenance survived, and nothing else moved.
    $provAfter = ([regex]::Matches($v6After, "'eventType'\s*,\s*qe\.event_type")).Count
    Say ("  provenance 'eventType' preserved: " + $provAfter + " / " + $provV6)
    if ($provAfter -ne $provV6) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

    $reInsert = "(INSERT\s+INTO\s+public\.ml_(?:feature|outcome)_values\s*\(\s*)([^)]*?)(\)\s*SELECT\s+)"
    foreach ($pair in @(
        @{ n = "live v6 value INSERTs"; before = ([regex]::Matches($v6Def, $reInsert)).Count;   after = ([regex]::Matches($v6After, $reInsert)).Count },
        @{ n = "source value INSERTs";  before = ([regex]::Matches($srcText, $reInsert)).Count; after = ([regex]::Matches($srcAfter, $reInsert)).Count })) {
        Say ("  " + $pair.n.PadRight(32) + ": " + $pair.before + " -> " + $pair.after + " (must be equal)")
        if ($pair.before -ne $pair.after) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    }
    foreach ($frozen in @("refresh_run_id", "source_system", "engine_key", "engine_version")) {
        $b = ([regex]::Matches($v6Def, [regex]::Escape($frozen))).Count
        $a = ([regex]::Matches($v6After, [regex]::Escape($frozen))).Count
        Say ("  frozen '" + $frozen.PadRight(16) + "' in v6 : " + $b + " -> " + $a + " (must be equal)")
        if ($b -ne $a) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
    }

    Rule "GATE"
    if ($bad -gt 0) {
        Say ("SELF-CHECK FAILED with " + $bad + " problem(s). AUTO-REVERTING BOTH SIDES.")
        $rev = Invoke-SqlFile -Path $v6Backup -Tag "revert_v6"
        if ($rev.ExitCode -eq 0) { Say "  live v6 restored" }
        else { Say ("  [CRITICAL] live revert FAILED: " + $rev.Error.Trim() + " - restore from " + $v6Backup) }
        Copy-Item (Join-Path $backupDir $SqlName) $sqlPath -Force
        Say "  tracked 760 restored"
        exit 1
    }
    Say "T-025e APPLIED - all self-checks green."
    Say ""
    Say "  event_type fallback:  live base 0 / source base 0 / live v6 0 / source v6 0"
    Say ""
    Say "Commit:"
    Say ("  git add Backend/database/scripts/" + $SqlName)
    Say "  git commit -m `"T-025e: remove the qe.event_type defect-taxonomy fallback from the v6 producer`""
}
finally {
    Remove-Item Env:\PGPASSWORD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
exit 0

[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\apply-T-026-closure-record.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=309, SizeKB=15.68, SHA256='205D821AA95831D5D039636F51BF867A65DB7D55577F9971A24CEFAE92EC02AB', Modified='2026-08-05 14:09:55']

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    PPIQ T-026 closure record. Writes one document. Changes nothing that runs.

.DESCRIPTION
    Records the validation as measured, the three seed phenomena and why each band
    says what it says, the confounding finding the first real run produced, my own
    defects in this task, and the limits carried forward to T-027.

    THE FINDING IS NOT SOFTENED. PPIQ-COIL-COILING-TEMP-DEFECTS is a correct PASS
    against what it declared AND is not a process phenomenon: the pooled effect of
    -0.1035 falls to 0.0004 once conditioned on grade_or_recipe. Both statements
    are true and the record states both.

    No database, no engine, no source change, so there is nothing to revert.

.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-026-closure-record.ps1 -ReportOnly
    .\tools\packs\apply-T-026-closure-record.ps1
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$ReportOnly)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:body = @'
# T-026 CLOSURE RECORD - Phenomenon test harness: manifest schema and runner

Milestone / Phase : M1 / M1-P1b
Database          : ppiq_presentation
Closed            : 2026-08-05
Backlog authority : PPIQ_Backlog_v2.9.1_03Aug2026 (FROZEN)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THE TASK REQUIRED
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Build the harness rather than hand-prove roughly 104 phenomena. Manifest columns:
phenomenon_id, population_query, expected_direction, minimum_population,
expected_effect_band, conditioning_variable, expected_after_conditioning,
negative_control. The runner walks the manifest and reports per row: population
met or not, direction matched, effect inside its band, conditioned result inside
its band, and negative control silent. A NEGATIVE CONTROL THAT STARTS CORRELATING
IS A FAILURE, NOT A CURIOSITY.

Validation: the harness runs against a manifest of at least three hand-checked
phenomena and produces a pass, a fail and a refusal, all three demonstrated. A
phenomenon whose population is below its minimum reports INSUFFICIENT rather than
passing quietly. The runner exits non-zero if any row fails.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. VALIDATION, MEASURED
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Run 2026-08-05 14:05:07, evidence T-026_harness_20260805_140507.txt

  phenomenon_id                              verdict       population   effect   conditioned
  PPIQ-COIL-COILING-TEMP-DEFECTS             PASS               17010  -0.1035        0.0004
  PPIQ-DOWNTIME-IMPACT-SCALES-WITH-STOPPAGE  FAIL                 630  -0.0257             -
  PPIQ-SENSOR-ARTEFACT-COILING-TEMP          INSUFFICIENT         117        -             -

  a pass, a fail and a refusal            ALL THREE DEMONSTRATED
  population below minimum reports        INSUFFICIENT, not a quiet pass
  runner exits non-zero when a row fails  exit 1

The self-test additionally forces every verdict the engine can produce, on
fixtures with no database: PASS, FAIL, INSUFFICIENT, a correlating negative
control, and an undefined statistic. Each is asserted against its declared
expected verdict, so a harness that could not produce a FAIL would fail its own
self-test rather than quietly making every future manifest meaningless.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. THE FINDING THIS RUN PRODUCED
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

THE COILING-TEMPERATURE EFFECT IS CONFOUNDING, NOT A PROCESS RELATIONSHIP.

Across the pooled fleet, mean CT_C per coil against catalogued defect count gives
Spearman -0.1035 over 17,010 coils. At that population the standard error of rho
is about 0.0077, so the pooled effect is roughly thirteen standard errors from
zero and is certainly not noise.

Conditioned on grade_or_recipe - six strata of roughly 2,800 coils each - the
same effect is 0.0004. It disappears entirely. Grades differ both in their
coiling temperature and in their defect rate, and correlating across the pooled
population measures that mix rather than any process effect. Within any single
grade there is no relationship at all.

The row is a correct PASS against what it declared, and it is NOT a process
phenomenon. Both statements are true and neither cancels the other.

THE CONSEQUENCE FOR T-027, WHICH OWNS MANIFEST POPULATION: a raw fleet-level
correlation is not a phenomenon until it survives conditioning. A manifest
populated from pooled correlations would be populated with grade-mix artefacts
that pass their bands and mean nothing.

This is what conditioning_variable exists for, and it earned its place on the
first row it was pointed at.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. THE THREE SEEDS, AND WHY EACH BAND SAYS WHAT IT SAYS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hand-checked means MEASURED FIRST and declared afterwards. A band declared before
measurement and then passed proves nothing, because the band was fitted to an
expectation rather than to the plant. Every band below was written around a
measured value with room either side, never fitted tight to it.

4.1 PPIQ-COIL-COILING-TEMP-DEFECTS - expects PASS
    direction negative, minimum_population 5000 against an actual 17,010,
    band -0.1600..-0.0500 around a measured -0.1035.
    expected_after_conditioning -0.0500..0.0500 around a measured 0.0004. That
    band is roughly six standard errors wide either side, and declaring it turns
    the confounding into a re-measured expectation: if a later fleet change gives
    coiling temperature a genuine within-grade effect, this row starts failing,
    and that is the signal.

4.2 PPIQ-DOWNTIME-IMPACT-SCALES-WITH-STOPPAGE - expects FAIL
    The expectation is the natural engineering one, written before looking: a
    longer stoppage should cost proportionally more production. direction
    positive, band 0.4000..1.0000. Measured -0.0257 over 630 events, with
    stopped_minutes spanning 3.70 to 89.38 and production_impact_minutes 0.00 to
    294.80, and zero rows where the two are identical. They are genuinely
    different quantities and genuinely unrelated, exactly as T-018 recorded.
    This FAIL is honest, not manufactured, and it documents a real property of
    the fleet.

4.3 PPIQ-SENSOR-ARTEFACT-COILING-TEMP - expects INSUFFICIENT
    117 coils carry a SENSOR_ARTEFACT. Detecting an effect the size of the
    fleet-level magnitude of about 0.10, at 80 percent power and alpha 0.05,
    needs roughly 780 pairs. minimum_population 780 therefore comes from the
    power requirement, not from a number chosen to force a refusal. The harness
    refuses to judge rather than reporting a meaningless coefficient.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. THE CONTRACT AS BUILT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

FROZEN COLUMNS. The eight named in the backlog, and no others. A ninth column is
rejected rather than absorbed, because widening the contract needs a ruling.

RESULT SHAPE. Every population_query returns a column x and a column y, plus a
column named exactly the conditioning_variable when one is set. Rows with a null
x or y are dropped BEFORE the population is counted, so a query returning ten
thousand nulls reports INSUFFICIENT rather than passing on volume.

EFFECT MEASURE. Spearman over average ranks. One measure for every row, because
the frozen columns cannot declare a method. A constant x or y yields an undefined
statistic and is reported as undefined, never as an effect of zero. The
conditioned effect is the population-weighted mean of the within-stratum effect,
skipping strata below eight pairs rather than letting noise dominate the average.
The candidate scan computes the identical statistic in SQL, so a band declared
from a scan means the same thing when the harness re-measures it.

VERDICTS. PASS, FAIL, INSUFFICIENT, ERROR. Exit 1 on any FAIL or ERROR.
INSUFFICIENT does not fail the run - it is a refusal to judge - but it is counted
and printed separately and can never be mistaken for a pass.

READ ONLY, PROVEN NOT ASSERTED. The connection sets
default_transaction_read_only, and the runner asks the server SHOW
transaction_read_only and stops with exit 2 unless the answer is on. An
environment variable the server ignored would otherwise leave every manifest
query running writable while the banner claimed otherwise.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. DEFECTS FOUND IN THIS TASK, INCLUDING MY OWN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

6.1 The first runner assigned to $pid, which is an automatic read-only variable
    in PowerShell holding the process ID. The throw skipped the assignment of
    $code, so the two exit lines then threw on an undefined variable and buried
    the real error under two false ones. Renamed; $code now initialises to 3,
    meaning "did not reach a verdict", before the try, so an abort can never
    exit 0. Every delivered script was swept for assignments to the automatic
    variable list.

6.2 The first runner wrapped each query in BEGIN READ ONLY ... COMMIT. psql
    prints a command tag per statement, so the word BEGIN became the first line
    of the CSV and therefore the header row, and all three phenomena returned
    ERROR. Read-only moved to the connection, which emits nothing.

6.3 The candidate scan tested 14 parameters, not 26. The twelve chemistry and
    steelmaking parameters - carbon, manganese, sulphur, phosphorus, silicon,
    aluminium, tap temp, LF final temp, argon, calcium, oxygen, power - sit on
    HEAT material units, and the scan joined parameter_observations directly to
    coils, so they never entered it. Given section 3, this matters more than it
    first appeared: heat-level chemistry is where a within-grade metallurgical
    effect would live, and the only pooled survivor turned out to be confounded.
    Widening the search across the genealogy join belongs to T-027.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. KNOWN LIMITS CARRIED FORWARD TO T-027
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  - Campaign ageing and defect positioning CANNOT be expressed as a
    population_query against canonical. Verified against the full 147-column

function Rule { param([string]$T) Say ""; Say ("=" * 78); Say $T; Say ("=" * 78) }

$repoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$outDir   = Join-Path $repoRoot "docs\m1\evidence"
$target   = Join-Path $outDir "T-026_CLOSURE.md"
$stamp    = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"

Rule "PPIQ T-026 CLOSURE RECORD"
Say ("Target : " + $target)

Rule "PREFLIGHT"
$na = 0
foreach ($ch in $script:body.ToCharArray()) {
    if ([int]$ch -gt 126 -and [int]$ch -ne 10 -and [int]$ch -ne 13) { $na = $na + 1 }
}
Say ("  non-ASCII : " + $na + " (required 0)")
Say ("  length    : " + $script:body.Length + " chars")
if ($na -ne 0) { Say "[FAIL] refusing to write non-ASCII."; exit 1 }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) {
    Say "  target EXISTS - would be backed up then replaced"
} else {
    Say "  target is new"
}
if ($ReportOnly) { Say ""; Say "REPORT ONLY - no file was written."; exit 0 }

Rule "WRITE"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $outDir -Force | Out-Null
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) {
    $backupDir = Join-Path $repoRoot ("tools\packs\_backup_T-026-closure_" + $stamp)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDir -Force | Out-Null
    Copy-Item $target (Join-Path $backupDir "T-026_CLOSURE.md") -Force
    Say "  previous version backed up"
}
$crlf = ($script:body -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($target, $crlf, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Say ("  wrote " + $target)

Rule "SELF-CHECK"
$bad = 0
$txt = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($target)
$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($target)
$hasBom = ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 239 -and $bytes[1] -eq 187 -and $bytes[2] -eq 191)
Say ("  bytes " + $bytes.Length + ", BOM " + $hasBom)
if ($hasBom) { $bad = $bad + 1 }

# Each needle names an exact artifact the record must carry. The confounding
# statement is checked because it is the one a later reader is most likely to
# lose, and losing it turns a documented artefact back into a green tick.
#
# MATCHED WHITESPACE-INSENSITIVELY. A literal needle that happens to straddle a
# line break can never match, which is exactly how the previous version of this
# check failed on a document whose text was correct. Escaping the needle and
# then turning every escaped space into \s+ makes the guard immune to reflowing
# rather than needing one string repaired each time the prose is rewrapped.
foreach ($needle in @("a pass, a fail and a refusal ALL THREE DEMONSTRATED",
                      "THE COILING-TEMPERATURE EFFECT IS CONFOUNDING, NOT A PROCESS RELATIONSHIP.",
                      "the same effect is 0.0004",
                      "a raw fleet-level correlation is not a phenomenon until it survives conditioning",
                      "INSUFFICIENT, not a quiet pass",
                      "The candidate scan tested 14 parameters, not 26",
                      "T-026 = DONE.")) {
    $pattern = [regex]::Escape($needle) -replace "\\ ", "\s+"
    $c = ([regex]::Matches($txt, $pattern)).Count
    Say ("  states '" + $needle + "' : " + $c + " (required at least 1)")
    if ($c -lt 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
}

Rule "GATE"
if ($bad -gt 0) { Say ("SELF-CHECK FAILED with " + $bad + " problem(s)."); exit 1 }
Say "T-026 CLOSURE RECORD WRITTEN - all self-checks green."
Say ""
Say "Commit:"
Say "  git add docs/m1/phenomena/manifest.csv Backend/tools/phenomenon_harness.py tools/run/Invoke-PpiqPhenomenonHarness.ps1 tools/run/Invoke-PpiqT026CandidateScan.ps1 docs/m1/evidence/"
Say "  git commit -m `"T-026 phenomenon harness: manifest schema, runner, three hand-checked seeds, closure record`""
exit 0

x = mean CT_C per coil. y = catalogued defect count on that coil. Quality events

  NAIVE, whole fleet                    n 17,010     rho -0.1035

  CONDITIONED ON GRADE
    DP600        n 2,559   rho -0.0048

THE ASSOCIATION SURVIVES THICKNESS STRATIFICATION AND DIES ON GRADE. That

defect rate, so a correlation computed across the pooled population measures the
grade mix and not any process relationship. Within every single grade there is no
relationship at all.

At n 17,010 the standard error of rho is about 0.0077, so the naive -0.1035 sits
roughly thirteen standard errors from zero. It is small and unambiguously real as
an association, and it is not a process effect.

src_meltshop_pg, src_caster_oracle_shape, src_hsm_oracle_shape, src_pkl_mssql_shape
and src_inspection_mysql_shape. The eight declared sources also name a Downtime
MySQL, a Yard file and a QA file; three of the eight have no schema here. That is
recorded, not treated as a structural failure, because continuity across the
canonical chain is complete.

TEMPORAL. No step precedes its predecessor. Zero children produced before their
genealogy parent, zero units ending before they started, zero quality events
before their material existed, zero parameters observed before their material
existed, zero process steps ending before they started.

ANALYTICAL. Every population the manifest depends on is present and non-empty,
and zero analysis rows exist without a compute run identity.

TRIGGER. The validation says the genealogy weight check is already enforced by a
database trigger and asks for confirmation that it fires. Every trigger on the
material and genealogy tables was enumerated from pg_trigger rather than inferred
from the repository, which matters because
ppiq_genealogy_edge_weight_guard_after_change is live and was not found in the
tracked scripts searched. It is a CONSTRAINT TRIGGER, DEFERRABLE INITIALLY
DEFERRED, so it normally fires at COMMIT - and a transaction that rolls back never
reaches that point. SET CONSTRAINTS ... IMMEDIATE was used so it fires on the
statement, which is the only way to confirm firing AND still roll back. It raised
its own message:

  Genealogy contribution weights must sum to 1.0 per child.
  child=6b3b5826-99e4-5020-82a4-b2b96f1315b5, sum=0.500000

After ROLLBACK, zero children were off the 1.0 weight sum. The confirmation
required the trigger's OWN message, so a different error raising would have been
reported as a false positive rather than as the guard firing.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. FINDING ONE - TWO GENERATOR DISTRIBUTIONS HAVE NO PHYSICAL FLOOR
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Every bound below is the parameter's own expected_min_value and
expected_max_value. No range was invented by the audit.

  parameter     declared     observed        offending   share    worst breach
                range        range                                as pct of range
  SUPERHEAT_C   10 .. 60     -2.712 .. 51.030      834   4.903%          25.42%
  CARBON_PCT    0.010..0.250  0.000 ..  0.213      332  17.566%           4.17%
  POWER_KWH     0 ..100000   69048.5..101071.9       1   0.053%           1.07%

  Total 1,167, reconciled independently against the audit's own count.

SUPERHEAT_C GOES NEGATIVE. Superheat is the excess of liquid steel temperature
above its liquidus. A negative value describes steel being cast below its own
melting point, which is not a tail but an impossibility. 834 observations breach,
and the observed maximum of 51.0 against a declared 60 shows the whole
distribution sitting low with its lower tail drawn straight through zero.

CARBON_PCT REACHES EXACTLY ZERO. 332 of 1,890 heats breach a declared floor of
0.010, and the observed minimum is 0.000. Carbon of exactly zero is not steel.
The hard 0.000 floor with a modest 4.17 percent worst breach is the signature of
a distribution clipped at zero rather than at its declared minimum.

POWER_KWH IS NOT A DEFECT. One observation of 1,890, 1.07 percent past the
declared maximum. That is an ordinary tail and is recorded as such rather than
being bundled with the other two to inflate a count.

OWNER AND REMEDY. This is a generator change, not an audit or a threshold change.
The declared ranges are correct and the draws should respect them. ESTIMATE: 1
hour to add a physical floor to both distributions and regenerate. NO RANGE WAS
WIDENED TO MAKE THIS LAYER PASS - widening expected_min_value until the data fits
would delete the finding rather than fix the plant.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. FINDING TWO - NINE PARAMETERS ARE DRAWN UNIFORM RANDOM
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The task requires natural variation, noise, outliers and shifts RATHER THAN
UNIFORM RANDOM. A uniform variable has an interquartile range of almost exactly
half its full range; a naturally varying one is materially narrower. The test is
IQR divided by range, and the uniform signature is 0.48 to 0.52.

  UNIFORM SIGNATURE          natural cohort, for contrast
  OXYGEN_NM3       0.5135    THICKNESS_MM     0.4070
  LF_ARGON_NM3     0.5117    SILICON_PCT      0.2926
  BATH_TEMP_C      0.5028    CARBON_PCT       0.2404
  LINE_SPEED_MPM   0.5023    CT_C             0.2210
  LF_CALCIUM_M     0.5015    FDT_C            0.2171
  QA_THK_MM        0.4974    SUPERHEAT_C      0.2101
  QA_WIDTH_MM      0.4963    ROLL_FORCE_KN    0.1887
  QA_ROUGHNESS_UM  0.4951    ROLL_TEMP_C      0.1727
  ACID_CONC_PCT    0.4842

Nine of twenty-nine measured parameters cluster tightly around 0.50 while the
rest sit between 0.17 and 0.41. That separation is not marginal. The nine are
concentrated in two families - the ladle-furnace additions (oxygen, argon,
calcium) and the pickling line and QA measurements (bath temperature, line speed,
acid concentration, QA thickness, width and roughness).

WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND REALISM. A uniform variable carries no natural clustering,
so it cannot exhibit a regime, a shift or an outlier. Any phenomenon declared on
one of these nine is undiscoverable by construction, whatever the analysis engine
does.

OWNER AND REMEDY. Generator change. ESTIMATE: 2 hours to replace nine uniform
draws with distributions carrying natural central tendency and tails, and to
re-run this layer. Zero parameters have zero spread, so nothing is constant.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. THE DENSITY CROSS-CHECK IS NOT COMPUTABLE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The validation requires derived volume times steel density compared against
stated weight within a stated tolerance. It needs four inputs:

  WIDTH_MM      present
  THICKNESS_MM  present
  LENGTH_MM     ABSENT - no such parameter code
  WEIGHT_KG     ABSENT - no such parameter code

Two of the four do not exist in the canonical parameter set, so the check cannot
run. It is recorded as UNMET rather than substituting a proxy and calling the
result a density test.

The check exists to catch exactly the inconsistency the Fleet v2 generator
already documents in its own header as FAULT-1: weight_kg is drawn independently
of width, thickness and length, so implied density is not physical. The fault is
real and donor-side; canonical does not currently carry the columns to expose it.

REMEDY. Emit LENGTH_MM and WEIGHT_KG as canonical parameter observations, then
this layer becomes computable and will very likely fail on FAULT-1 - which is the
correct outcome, because the check would then be doing its job. ESTIMATE: 1 hour
to emit, plus whatever fixing FAULT-1 itself is separately estimated at.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. MY OWN DEFECTS IN THIS TASK
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

6.1 I guessed the genealogy_edges column names. v1 used parent_unit_id and
    child_unit_id; the real names are parent_material_unit_id and
    child_material_unit_id. Two layers errored mid-run. v2 asserts the columns in
    preflight and prints the real list, so a wrong name becomes a refusal rather
    than two dead layers.

6.2 The v1 trigger test used those same wrong names, so its
    PPIQ-T029-TRIGGER-FIRED notice was a FALSE POSITIVE - a column error read as
    the guard firing. v2 requires the raised message to contain the guard's own
    wording and reports anything else as a false positive in those words.

6.3 A patch of mine silently did not apply. The per-parameter breakdown was
    anchored on a two-line string using LF against a CRLF file, so it matched
    nothing and failed without an error, leaving 1,167 as a bare total. Delivered
    separately as Invoke-PpiqT029RangeBreakdown.ps1.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. A CORRECTION TO A T-027 STATEMENT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The T-027 status record says the canonical parameter set contains no caster
variable. THAT IS WRONG. This audit measured SUPERHEAT_C, CASTING_SPEED_MPM and
MOULD_LEVEL_AVG, each with 17,010 observations.

What actually differs is naming. The phenomena matrix declares
casting_speed_m_min; the plant emits CASTING_SPEED_MPM. superheat_c matches the
emitted code exactly. So some rows classified SOURCE_VARIABLE_NOT_MATERIALISED
are VOCABULARY MISMATCHES rather than missing data.

T-027's zero-executable conclusion is unaffected - R1's assertion is a rate ratio
and unsupported by the frozen harness regardless of variable availability - but
the stated reason was wrong, and "the matrix was declared against a plant richer
than the one that was generated" is too strong. T-027 is not reopened. This is an
input to the future matrix work.

8. STATUS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  T-029 implementation / execution   COMPLETE
  T-029 acceptance                   BLOCKED

  BLOCKER: two of the five layers return offending rows and the density
  cross-check cannot run. All three are generator and emission shortfalls whose
  remedy the frozen task itself assigns to a small generator change with its own
  estimate, not to a threshold or tolerance change.

  Estimates recorded: 1 hour physical floors, 2 hours uniform distributions,

No range was widened, no tolerance was loosened, no threshold was touched and no
layer that could not run was reported as passing.

  docs/m1/evidence/T-029_realism_audit_v2_20260805_182726.txt

function Say  { param([string]$T) Write-Host $T }
function Rule { param([string]$T) Say ""; Say ("=" * 78); Say $T; Say ("=" * 78) }

$repoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$outDir   = Join-Path $repoRoot "docs\m1\evidence"
$target   = Join-Path $outDir "T-029_CLOSURE.md"
$stamp    = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"

Rule "PPIQ T-029 CLOSURE RECORD"
Say ("Target : " + $target)
$na = 0
foreach ($ch in $script:body.ToCharArray()) {
    if ([int]$ch -gt 126 -and [int]$ch -ne 10 -and [int]$ch -ne 13) { $na = $na + 1 }
}
Say ("  non-ASCII : " + $na + " (required 0)")
Say ("  length    : " + $script:body.Length + " chars")
if ($na -ne 0) { Say "[FAIL] refusing to write non-ASCII."; exit 1 }
if ($ReportOnly) { Say ""; Say "REPORT ONLY - nothing written."; exit 0 }

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $outDir -Force | Out-Null
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) {
    $backupDir = Join-Path $repoRoot ("tools\packs\_backup_T-029-closure_" + $stamp)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDir -Force | Out-Null
    Copy-Item $target (Join-Path $backupDir "T-029_CLOSURE.md") -Force
    Say "  previous version backed up"
}
$crlf = ($script:body -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($target, $crlf, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Say ("  wrote " + $target)

Rule "SELF-CHECK"
$bad = 0
$txt = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($target)
$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($target)
$hasBom = ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 239 -and $bytes[1] -eq 187 -and $bytes[2] -eq 191)
Say ("  bytes " + $bytes.Length + ", BOM " + $hasBom)
if ($hasBom) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
foreach ($needle in @("A LAYER THAT COULD NOT BE COMPUTED IS NOT A PASS.",
                      "SUPERHEAT_C GOES NEGATIVE.",
                      "CARBON_PCT REACHES EXACTLY ZERO.",
                      "POWER_KWH IS NOT A DEFECT.",
                      "NO RANGE WAS WIDENED TO MAKE THIS LAYER PASS",
                      "Nine of twenty-nine measured parameters",
                      "LENGTH_MM ABSENT - no such parameter code",
                      "its PPIQ-T029-TRIGGER-FIRED notice was a FALSE POSITIVE",
                      "THAT IS WRONG.",
                      "T-029 acceptance BLOCKED")) {
    $pattern = [regex]::Escape($needle) -replace "\\ ", "\s+"
    $c = ([regex]::Matches($txt, $pattern)).Count
    Say ("  states '" + $needle + "' : " + $c + " (required at least 1)")
    if ($c -lt 1) { $bad = $bad + 1 }
}
Rule "GATE"
if ($bad -gt 0) { Say ("SELF-CHECK FAILED with " + $bad + " problem(s)."); exit 1 }
Say "T-029 CLOSURE RECORDED - all self-checks green."
Say ""
Say "Commit:"
Say "  git add docs/m1/evidence/T-029_CLOSURE.md docs/m1/evidence/T-029_realism_audit_v2_20260805_182726.txt docs/m1/evidence/T-029_range_breakdown_20260805_183020.txt tools/run/Invoke-PpiqT029RealismAudit-v2.ps1 tools/run/Invoke-PpiqT029RangeBreakdown.ps1"
Say "  git commit -m `"T-029 five-layer realism audit: 3 layers and the weight guard pass, 2 generator findings recorded with estimates, density check unmet`""
exit 0

 PPIQ T-032a - CORRECTION PACK for the T-032 acceptance test

 SCOPE. ONE FILE:

 WHY

function Say([string]$m)  { Write-Host $m }
function Ok ([string]$m)  { Write-Host ("  [ OK ] " + $m) }
function Bad([string]$m)  { Write-Host ("  [FAIL] " + $m) -ForegroundColor Red; [void]$script:Failures.Add($m) }
function Info([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  [ .. ] " + $m) -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

function Write-Utf8NoBomCrLf([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
  $normalised = $Text -replace "`r`n", "`n"
  $normalised = $normalised -replace "`n", "`r`n"
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
  if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir) }
  $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $normalised, $enc)
}

function Read-Text([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }

function Count-Occurrences([string]$Haystack, [string]$Needle) {
  if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
  $n = 0; $i = 0
  while ($true) {
    $i = $Haystack.IndexOf($Needle, $i, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    if ($i -lt 0) { break }
    $n++; $i += $Needle.Length
  }
  return $n
}

// PPIQ T-032 acceptance. Two halves, and they prove different things.
//
// PART A is structural and reads the source tree: SharedAuthoringShell is THE
// authoring shell, and no second authoring PAGE component is exported. Scoped
// to page components on the 04-Aug ruling - retiring WidgetAuthoringPanel is

//
// PART B renders the shell in S1 and in S2 and asserts the four regions of
// Chapter 4 section 5.2.3, including that the toolbox is ABSENT and not merely
// disabled in SQL mode.

import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from "node:fs";
import { join, relative } from "node:path";
import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";

// The board is mocked: ReactFlow needs a layout engine jsdom does not have,
// and what this file is proving is the REGION CONTRACT, not the canvas.
vi.mock("@/canvas/CanvasShell", () => ({
  CanvasShell: () => <div data-testid="authoring-board" />,
