  Copy-Item -Path $script:Api -Destination (Join-Path $script:BackupDir "VisualMapperEndpoints.cs") -Force
  Ok ("backup folder: " + $script:BackupDir)
}

function Invoke-Restore([string]$From) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $From)) { throw ("backup folder not found: " + $From) }
  Say ""
  Say ("RESTORE from " + $From)
  Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $From "VisualMapperEndpoints.cs") -Destination $script:Api -Force
  Ok "restored VisualMapperEndpoints.cs"
  foreach ($p in @($script:Sql, $script:Test)) {
    if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item -Path $p -Force; Ok ("removed " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p)) }
  }
  Info "the 541 migration is idempotent, so any database it already ran on is unaffected"
  Say "RESTORE COMPLETE"
}

function Invoke-Migration {
  Say ""
  Say "MIGRATION"
  $psql = $env:PSQL_PATH
  if (-not $psql) { $psql = "psql" }
  if (-not (Get-Command $psql -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    Bad "psql not found - run 541 by hand against both databases"
    return
  }
  $profilePath = Join-Path $script:Repo $EnvProfile
  $line = Select-String -Path $profilePath -Pattern "^ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb=" | Select-Object -First 1
  if ($null -eq $line) { Bad ("no connection string in " + $EnvProfile); return }
  $conn = $line.Line.Substring($line.Line.IndexOf("=") + 1)
  $pgHost = "localhost"; $pgPort = "5432"; $pgUser = ""; $pgPass = ""
  foreach ($part in $conn.Split(";")) {
    $kv = $part.Split("=", 2)
    if ($kv.Count -ne 2) { continue }
    switch ($kv[0].Trim().ToLower()) {
      "host"     { $pgHost = $kv[1].Trim() }
      "port"     { $pgPort = $kv[1].Trim() }
      "username" { $pgUser = $kv[1].Trim() }
      "password" { $pgPass = $kv[1].Trim() }
    }
  }
  $env:PGHOST = $pgHost; $env:PGPORT = $pgPort; $env:PGUSER = $pgUser; $env:PGPASSWORD = $pgPass
  Ok ("credentials read from " + $EnvProfile + " - " + $pgUser + "@" + $pgHost + ":" + $pgPort)

  foreach ($db in $Databases) {
    $env:PGDATABASE = $db
    & $psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f $script:Sql
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Ok ("541 applied to " + $db) } else { Bad ("541 failed on " + $db) }
  }
  $env:PGPASSWORD = ""
}

function Invoke-SelfCheck {
  Say ""
  Say "SELF-CHECK"
  $t = Read-Text $script:Api

  # THE NEEDLE IS THE SQL FRAGMENT, NOT THE WORD. v1 of this pack searched for
  # the bare word and matched the COMMENT that explains the fix, so it reverted
  # correct code. Third time I have written a guard that matches its own
  # explanation - the rule is the same every time: a guard names the exact
  # artifact it forbids, never a word that also appears in prose about it.
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t "(tenant_id, session_name, status)") -eq 0)  { Ok "the stale INSERT column list is gone" }          else { Bad "the stale INSERT column list survives" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t "row_count, error_message") -eq 0)           { Ok "the stale dry-run columns are gone" }           else { Bad "row_count / error_message still written" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t "NewSourceCode(name)") -eq 1)                { Ok "source_code is generated per session" }          else { Bad "source_code generation missing" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t "(tenant_id, source_code, display_name, source_kind, status)") -eq 1) { Ok "the INSERT names the columns the table has" } else { Bad "the INSERT was not aligned" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t "safe_sql_passed, total_rows, mapped_rows, details") -eq 1) { Ok "the dry-run INSERT names real columns" } else { Bad "the dry-run INSERT was not aligned" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t 'dry.GetProperty') -eq 0)                    { Ok "no test code leaked into the endpoint" }         else { Bad "unexpected content in the endpoint" }

  foreach ($p in @($script:Api, $script:Sql, $script:Test)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $p)) { Bad ("missing: " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p)); continue }
    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p)
    if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF) { Bad ("BOM: " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p)) }
    $nonAscii = 0
    foreach ($b in $bytes) { if ($b -gt 127) { $nonAscii++ } }
    if ($nonAscii -gt 0) { Bad ("non-ASCII in " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p)) } else { Ok ("ASCII, no BOM: " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p)) }
  }
}

[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\apply-T-032f-join-order.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=224, SizeKB=9.65, SHA256='EA493804FB756ED07F3C0F8D9347E9B48B555F90C8306FD024AE9E25A1320DA5', Modified='2026-08-04 15:57:37']

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
================================================================================
 PPIQ T-032f - JOIN ORDER: A JOIN MAY ONLY REFERENCE TABLES ALREADY IN FROM
================================================================================

 SCOPE. ONE LOOP, in one method:
   Backend/PlantProcess.Api/Endpoints/Prep/VisualMapperEndpoints.cs
   :: BuildSafeSelect, the FROM and JOIN emitter

 THE DEFECT, observed in the browser on 04-Aug after T-032e unblocked sessions:
   The preview was refused with status failed.
   42P01: missing FROM-clause entry for table "t2" POSITION: 186

 THE CAUSE. The emitter filtered each table's joins with
   .Where(j => alias.ContainsKey(j.LeftTable) && alias.ContainsKey(j.RightTable))
 but the alias map is built for EVERY table before the loop starts, so the
 filter was always true. Joining t1 therefore emitted an ON clause that also
 carried the t1-to-t2 equality, naming t2 before t2 was in the query.

 WHY IT SURVIVED. Two tables always worked. It needs three or more in a chain,
 and the whole path had never been executed - a live check found ZERO sessions
 ever created in either database.

 THE FIX. A set of tables already emitted into the FROM clause, and each
 table's ON clause is restricted to joins whose other side is in that set. The
 refusal sentence for a table with no such join now names what to do about it.

 NOT IN THIS PACK. No frontend change. No schema change. No T-033 scope.

 CONTRACT
   -ReportOnly / (default) / -Revert -BackupPath
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$ReportOnly, [switch]$Revert, [string]$BackupPath)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:Failures  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Repo      = (Get-Location).Path
$script:Target    = Join-Path $script:Repo "Backend\PlantProcess.Api\Endpoints\Prep\VisualMapperEndpoints.cs"
$script:Stamp     = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$script:BackupDir = Join-Path $script:Repo ("tools\packs\_backup_T-032f-join-order_" + $script:Stamp)

$script:OldLines = @(
  '        foreach (var t in g.Tables.Skip(1))',
  '        {',
  '            var joins = g.Joins.Where(j => j.RightTable == t || j.LeftTable == t)',
  '                .Where(j => alias.ContainsKey(j.LeftTable) && alias.ContainsKey(j.RightTable)).ToArray();',
  '            if (joins.Length == 0) return (null, $"table ''{t}'' has no join to the graph", null);'
)

$script:NewLines = @(
  '        // T-032. A JOIN MAY ONLY REFERENCE TABLES ALREADY IN THE FROM CLAUSE.',
  '        //',
  '        // The previous filter tested alias.ContainsKey on both sides of every',
  '        // join, but the alias map is built for EVERY table BEFORE this loop',
  '        // starts, so that test was always true and filtered nothing.',
  '        //',
  '        // With three tables wired t0-t1 and t1-t2, the ON clause emitted while',
  '        // joining t1 contained "t1.x = t2.y" - and t2 was not in the query yet.',
  '        // PostgreSQL refused with 42P01, missing FROM-clause entry for table',
  '        // "t2". Two tables always worked, which is why this survived: the path',
  '        // had never been run, and a live check found ZERO sessions ever created.',
  '        //',
  '        // `emitted` tracks what is genuinely in the FROM clause so far.',
  '        var emitted = new HashSet<string> { g.Tables[0] };',
  '        foreach (var t in g.Tables.Skip(1))',
  '        {',
  '            var joins = g.Joins',
  '                .Where(j => (j.LeftTable == t && emitted.Contains(j.RightTable))',
  '                         || (j.RightTable == t && emitted.Contains(j.LeftTable)))',
  '                .ToArray();',
  '            if (joins.Length == 0) return (null, $"table ''{t}'' has no join to a table already in the query. Wire it to a table that is further left on the board.", null);',
  '            emitted.Add(t);'
)

function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Ok ([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  [ OK ] " + $m) }
function Bad([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  [FAIL] " + $m) -ForegroundColor Red; [void]$script:Failures.Add($m) }

function Read-Text([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }

function Count-Occurrences([string]$Haystack, [string]$Needle) {
  if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
  $n = 0; $i = 0
  while ($true) {
    $i = $Haystack.IndexOf($Needle, $i, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    if ($i -lt 0) { break }
    $n++; $i += $Needle.Length
  }
  return $n
}

function Resolve-Anchor([string]$Text) {
  foreach ($eol in @("`r`n", "`n")) {
    $candidate = ($script:OldLines -join $eol)
    if ((Count-Occurrences $Text $candidate) -eq 1) {
      return @{ Old = $candidate; New = ($script:NewLines -join $eol) }
    }
  }
  return $null
}

[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\apply-T-032g-join-planner.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=403, SizeKB=20.01, SHA256='D0C8316F3D521678AABFA3AEE81F2E8D29E70D94666411F4E6F4852431CB439F', Modified='2026-08-04 16:03:55']

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
================================================================================
 PPIQ T-032g - JOIN PLANNER: FRONTIER, NOT LIST ORDER
================================================================================

 WHY THIS FOLLOWS T-032f. T-032f fixed the SCOPE invariant - an ON clause may
 only name aliases already in the query - and that removed 42P01. It did NOT
 fix the REACHABILITY invariant: it still walked g.Tables in list order.

 The board sends tables in the order the author dropped them. A graph wired
 A-B and B-C can therefore arrive as [A, C, B], which is connected and legal.
 A list-order planner reaches C, finds no edge back to {A}, and refuses it.
 That is the reordering heuristic that was explicitly ruled out.

 THIS PACK implements the frontier loop:

   joined = { root }
   while tables remain:
       take any table with an edge to something already joined,
       in EITHER direction - LeftTable or RightTable
       emit its JOIN, orient the ON clause from the alias map
       add it to joined
   if none can be reached: refuse as disconnected, with a sentence

 AND IT ADDS THE REGRESSION TEST that the two-table tests could never catch:
 a three-node chain submitted as [A, C, B], asserting that the preview
 EXECUTES - not that the SQL string looks plausible - plus that t1 is
 introduced before t2. The chain is DISCOVERED from the live catalogue, so no
 plant table or column name appears in the test.

 WHAT THIS PACK TOUCHES
   EDIT  Backend/PlantProcess.Api/Endpoints/Prep/VisualMapperEndpoints.cs
   EDIT  Backend/tests/.../Mapping/VisualMapperSessionLifecycleTests.cs

 CONTRACT
   -ReportOnly / (default) / -Revert -BackupPath
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$ReportOnly, [switch]$Revert, [string]$BackupPath)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:Failures  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Repo      = (Get-Location).Path
$script:Api       = Join-Path $script:Repo "Backend\PlantProcess.Api\Endpoints\Prep\VisualMapperEndpoints.cs"
$script:Test      = Join-Path $script:Repo "Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Api.IntegrationTests\Mapping\VisualMapperSessionLifecycleTests.cs"
$script:Stamp     = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$script:BackupDir = Join-Path $script:Repo ("tools\packs\_backup_T-032g-join-planner_" + $script:Stamp)

$script:OldLines = @(
  '        var emitted = new HashSet<string> { g.Tables[0] };',
  '        foreach (var t in g.Tables.Skip(1))',
  '        {',
  '            var joins = g.Joins',
  '                .Where(j => (j.LeftTable == t && emitted.Contains(j.RightTable))',
  '                         || (j.RightTable == t && emitted.Contains(j.LeftTable)))',
  '                .ToArray();',
  '            if (joins.Length == 0) return (null, $"table ''{t}'' has no join to a table already in the query. Wire it to a table that is further left on the board.", null);',
  '            emitted.Add(t);',
  '            sb.Append(" JOIN \"").Append(schema).Append("\".\"").Append(t).Append("\" ").Append(alias[t]).Append(" ON ");',
  '            sb.Append(string.Join(" AND ", joins.Select(j =>',
  '                $"{alias[j.LeftTable]}.\"{j.LeftColumn}\" = {alias[j.RightTable]}.\"{j.RightColumn}\"")));',
  '        }'
)

$script:NewLines = @(
  '        // T-032. THE PLANNER WORKS FROM A FRONTIER, NOT FROM LIST ORDER.',
  '        //',
  '        // Two things are being satisfied here and they are not the same thing.',
  '        //',
  '        // THE SCOPE INVARIANT. An ON clause may reference only aliases already',
  '        // in the FROM clause plus the alias this JOIN introduces. Breaking it',
  '        // produced 42P01, missing FROM-clause entry for table "t2", because an',
  '        // earlier version filtered joins on alias.ContainsKey - and the alias',
  '        // map is built for EVERY table before any SQL is emitted, so that test',
  '        // was always true and filtered nothing.',
  '        //',
  '        // THE REACHABILITY INVARIANT. Which table is emitted next is decided by',
  '        // CONNECTIVITY, never by position in g.Tables. The board sends tables in',
  '        // the order the author dropped them, so a legal graph wired A-B and B-C',
  '        // can arrive as [A, C, B]. Walking the list in order would reach C,',
  '        // find no edge back to {A}, and refuse a graph that is perfectly valid.',
  '        //',
  '        // The loop below takes, on each pass, any pending table with an edge to',
  '        // something already emitted, in either direction - LeftTable or',
  '        // RightTable, it makes no difference. Only when NO pending table can be',
  '        // reached is the graph genuinely disconnected, and then it is refused',
  '        // with a sentence rather than compiled into SQL that cannot run.',
  '        var emitted = new HashSet<string> { g.Tables[0] };',
  '        var pending = new List<string>(g.Tables.Skip(1));',
  '        while (pending.Count > 0)',
  '        {',
  '            string? next = null;',
  '            var nextJoins = Array.Empty<JoinSpec>();',
  '            foreach (var candidate in pending)',
  '            {',
  '                var edges = g.Joins',
  '                    .Where(j => (j.LeftTable == candidate && emitted.Contains(j.RightTable))',
  '                             || (j.RightTable == candidate && emitted.Contains(j.LeftTable)))',
  '                    .ToArray();',
  '                if (edges.Length > 0) { next = candidate; nextJoins = edges; break; }',
  '            }',
  '            if (next is null)',
  '            {',
  '                return (null, $"table ''{pending[0]}'' has no join reaching the rest of the board. Wire it to a table that is already connected, or remove it.", null);',
  '            }',
  '            sb.Append(" JOIN \"").Append(schema).Append("\".\"").Append(next).Append("\" ").Append(alias[next]).Append(" ON ");',
  '            sb.Append(string.Join(" AND ", nextJoins.Select(j =>',
  '                $"{alias[j.LeftTable]}.\"{j.LeftColumn}\" = {alias[j.RightTable]}.\"{j.RightColumn}\"")));',
  '            emitted.Add(next);',
  '            pending.Remove(next);',
  '        }'
)

$script:OldTest = @(
  '        Assert.True(pub.GetProperty("versionNumber").GetInt32() >= 1,',
  '            "publish returned no version number");',
  '    }',
  '}'
)

$script:NewTest = @(
  '        Assert.True(pub.GetProperty("versionNumber").GetInt32() >= 1,',
  '            "publish returned no version number");',
  '    }',
  '',
  '    // T-032. THE THREE-NODE CHAIN, IN A DELIBERATELY AWKWARD ORDER.',
  '    //',
  '    // Two-table previews always worked, which is why the join planner shipped',
  '    // broken: with A-B and B-C the emitter named t2 inside the ON clause for',
  '    // t1, before t2 was in the query, and PostgreSQL refused with 42P01.',
  '    //',
  '    // This test submits the tables as [A, C, B] - connected, but NOT in',
  '    // connectivity order - so it fails both against the original emitter and',
  '    // against any fix that merely walks the list. And it asserts EXECUTION,',
  '    // not the shape of the string: a generated statement that looks plausible',
  '    // and will not run is exactly what this defect was.',
  '    [SkippableFact]',
  '    public async Task Three_table_chain_previews_regardless_of_the_order_tables_arrive_in()',
  '    {',
  '        Skip.IfNot(IsIntegrationDbReachable(), "Integration Postgres not reachable on this machine; runs in CI.");',
  '        var client = await CreateAuthenticatedClientAsync();',
  '',
  '        var dsRes = await client.GetAsync("/api/prep/visual-mapper/datasets");',
  '        Assert.True(dsRes.IsSuccessStatusCode);',
  '        var sets = JsonDocument.Parse(await dsRes.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).RootElement;',
  '',
  '        // Find any A-B-C chain from the live catalogue. No plant table or column',
  '        // name appears in this file - the chain is discovered, never assumed.',
  '        var tables = new List<(string Name, HashSet<string> Cols)>();',
  '        foreach (var s in sets.EnumerateArray())',
  '        {',
  '            var cols = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);',
  '            foreach (var c in s.GetProperty("columns").EnumerateArray())',
  '            {',
  '                cols.Add(c.GetProperty("name").GetString() ?? "");',
  '            }',
  '            tables.Add((s.GetProperty("table").GetString() ?? "", cols));',
  '        }',
  '',
  '        string? a = null, b = null, c = null, keyAb = null, keyBc = null;',
  '        foreach (var mid in tables)',
  '        {',
  '            foreach (var left in tables)',
  '            {',
  '                if (left.Name == mid.Name) { continue; }',
  '                var k1 = left.Cols.FirstOrDefault(x => mid.Cols.Contains(x));',
  '                if (k1 is null) { continue; }',
  '                foreach (var right in tables)',
  '                {',
  '                    if (right.Name == mid.Name || right.Name == left.Name) { continue; }',
  '                    var k2 = right.Cols.FirstOrDefault(x => mid.Cols.Contains(x));',
  '                    if (k2 is null) { continue; }',
  '                    a = left.Name; b = mid.Name; c = right.Name; keyAb = k1; keyBc = k2;',
  '                    break;',
  '                }',
  '                if (a is not null) { break; }',
  '            }',
  '            if (a is not null) { break; }',
  '        }',
  '        Skip.If(a is null, "no three-table chain in the staged catalogue on this machine");',
  '',
  '        var createRes = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(',
  '            "/api/prep/visual-mapper/sessions", new { name = "T-032 three node chain" });',
  '        Assert.True(createRes.IsSuccessStatusCode);',
  '        var sessionId = JsonDocument.Parse(await createRes.Content.ReadAsStringAsync())',
  '            .RootElement.GetProperty("sessionId").GetGuid();',
  '',
  '        // TABLES ARRIVE AS A, C, B. C is not reachable from A alone, so a',
  '        // planner that walks the list refuses here; a frontier planner emits',
  '        // B first and then C.',
  '        var graph = new',
  '        {',
  '            name = "T-032 three node chain",',
  '            targetEntity = "MaterialUnit",',
  '            tables = new[] { a, c, b },',
  '            joins = new object[]',
  '            {',
  '                new { leftTable = a, leftColumn = keyAb, rightTable = b, rightColumn = keyAb },',
  '                new { leftTable = c, leftColumn = keyBc, rightTable = b, rightColumn = keyBc }',
  '            }',
  '        };',
  '        var saveRes = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(',
  '            "/api/prep/visual-mapper/sessions/" + sessionId + "/graph", graph);',
  '        Assert.True(saveRes.IsSuccessStatusCode,',
  '            "save graph failed: " + await saveRes.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());',
  '',
  '        var dryRes = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(',
  '            "/api/prep/visual-mapper/sessions/" + sessionId + "/dry-run", new { });',
  '        Assert.True(dryRes.IsSuccessStatusCode,',
  '            "dry run failed: " + await dryRes.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());',
  '        var dry = JsonDocument.Parse(await dryRes.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).RootElement;',
  '',
  '        // THE ASSERTION IS EXECUTION. The message is carried through so a',
  '        // failure names the PostgreSQL code rather than saying "expected true".',
  '        var message = dry.TryGetProperty("message", out var m) ? m.GetString() : null;',
  '        Assert.True(dry.GetProperty("status").GetString() == "succeeded",',
  '            "three-table preview did not execute: " + (message ?? "no message"));',
  '',
  '        // And the compiled statement must name every alias, in a legal order:',
  '        // t0 in FROM, t1 and t2 each introduced by their own JOIN.',
  '        var sql = dry.TryGetProperty("sql", out var s2) ? s2.GetString() ?? "" : "";',
  '        Assert.Contains(" t0", sql);',
  '        Assert.Contains(" t1 ON ", sql);',
  '        Assert.Contains(" t2 ON ", sql);',
  '        Assert.True(sql.IndexOf(" t1 ON ", StringComparison.Ordinal) < sql.IndexOf(" t2 ON ", StringComparison.Ordinal),',
  '            "t2 was introduced before t1: " + sql);',
  '    }',
  '}'

function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Ok ([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  [ OK ] " + $m) }
function Bad([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  [FAIL] " + $m) -ForegroundColor Red; [void]$script:Failures.Add($m) }
function Info([string]$m){ Write-Host ("  [ .. ] " + $m) -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
function Read-Text([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }

function Count-Occurrences([string]$Haystack, [string]$Needle) {
  if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
  $n = 0; $i = 0
  while ($true) {
    $i = $Haystack.IndexOf($Needle, $i, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    if ($i -lt 0) { break }
    $n++; $i += $Needle.Length
  }
  return $n
}

function Resolve-Anchor([string]$Text, [string[]]$OldLines, [string[]]$NewLines) {
  foreach ($eol in @("`r`n", "`n")) {
    $candidate = ($OldLines -join $eol)
    if ((Count-Occurrences $Text $candidate) -eq 1) {
      return @{ Old = $candidate; New = ($NewLines -join $eol) }
    }
  }
  return $null
}

function Invoke-Preflight {
  Say ""
  Say "PREFLIGHT"
  if (-not (Test-Path $script:Api))  { Bad "VisualMapperEndpoints.cs not found - run from the repository root"; return }
  if (-not (Test-Path $script:Test)) { Bad "VisualMapperSessionLifecycleTests.cs not found - apply T-032e first"; return }
  Ok "both target files present"

  $a = Read-Text $script:Api
  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "var pending = new List<string>(g.Tables.Skip(1));") -gt 0) { Bad "the frontier planner is already present - nothing to do"; return }
  if ($null -eq (Resolve-Anchor $a $script:OldLines $script:NewLines)) { Bad "the T-032f emitter block was not found exactly once - apply T-032f first" } else { Ok "the T-032f emitter block found exactly once" }

  $t = Read-Text $script:Test
  if ($null -eq (Resolve-Anchor $t $script:OldTest $script:NewTest)) { Bad "the end of the lifecycle test was not found exactly once" } else { Ok "the test tail found exactly once" }
}

function Invoke-Backup {
  Say ""
  Say "BACKUP"
  [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $script:BackupDir)
  Copy-Item -Path $script:Api  -Destination (Join-Path $script:BackupDir "VisualMapperEndpoints.cs") -Force
  Copy-Item -Path $script:Test -Destination (Join-Path $script:BackupDir "VisualMapperSessionLifecycleTests.cs") -Force
  Ok ("backup folder: " + $script:BackupDir)
}

function Invoke-Restore([string]$From) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $From)) { throw ("backup folder not found: " + $From) }
  Say ""
  Say ("RESTORE from " + $From)
  Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $From "VisualMapperEndpoints.cs") -Destination $script:Api -Force
  Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $From "VisualMapperSessionLifecycleTests.cs") -Destination $script:Test -Force
  Ok "restored both files"
}

function Invoke-SelfCheck {
  Say ""
  Say "SELF-CHECK"
  $a = Read-Text $script:Api

  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "var pending = new List<string>(g.Tables.Skip(1));") -eq 1) { Ok "the pending set is declared once" }        else { Bad "the pending set is missing" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "while (pending.Count > 0)") -eq 1)                          { Ok "the frontier loop is present" }             else { Bad "the frontier loop is missing" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "foreach (var t in g.Tables.Skip(1))") -eq 0)                { Ok "the list-order walk is gone" }              else { Bad "the list-order walk survives" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "pending.Remove(next);") -eq 1)                              { Ok "each emitted table leaves the pending set" } else { Bad "pending.Remove is wrong" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "emitted.Add(next);") -eq 1)                                 { Ok "each emitted table joins the emitted set" }  else { Bad "emitted.Add is wrong" }

  $t = Read-Text $script:Test
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t "Three_table_chain_previews_regardless_of_the_order_tables_arrive_in") -eq 1) { Ok "the chain regression test is present" } else { Bad "the chain regression test is missing" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t "tables = new[] { a, c, b }") -eq 1)                          { Ok "the test submits the tables out of connectivity order" } else { Bad "the test does not exercise ordering" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t 'GetString() == "succeeded"') -eq 1)                          { Ok "the test asserts EXECUTION, not string shape" }         else { Bad "the execution assertion is missing" }

  foreach ($p in @($script:Api, $script:Test)) {
    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p)
    if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF) { Bad ("BOM: " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p)) }
    $nonAscii = 0
    foreach ($b in $bytes) { if ($b -gt 127) { $nonAscii++ } }
    if ($nonAscii -gt 0) { Bad ("non-ASCII in " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p)) } else { Ok ("ASCII, no BOM: " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p)) }
  }
}

Say "================================================================"

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
================================================================================
 PPIQ T-032g - JOIN PLANNER: FRONTIER, NOT LIST ORDER  (v2)
================================================================================

 WHY THIS FOLLOWS T-032f. T-032f fixed the SCOPE invariant - an ON clause may
 only name aliases already in the query - and that removed 42P01. It did NOT
 fix the REACHABILITY invariant: it still walked g.Tables in list order.

 The board sends tables in the order the author dropped them. A graph wired
 A-B and B-C can therefore arrive as [A, C, B], which is connected and legal.
 A list-order planner reaches C, finds no edge back to {A}, and refuses it.
 That is the reordering heuristic that was explicitly ruled out.

 THIS PACK implements the frontier loop:

   joined = { root }
   while tables remain:
       take any table with an edge to something already joined,
       in EITHER direction - LeftTable or RightTable
       emit its JOIN, orient the ON clause from the alias map
       add it to joined
   if none can be reached: refuse as disconnected, with a sentence

 AND IT ADDS THE REGRESSION TEST that the two-table tests could never catch:
 a three-node chain submitted as [A, C, B], asserting that the preview
 EXECUTES - not that the SQL string looks plausible - plus that t1 is
 introduced before t2. The chain is DISCOVERED from the live catalogue, so no
 plant table or column name appears in the test.

 WHAT THIS PACK TOUCHES
   EDIT  Backend/PlantProcess.Api/Endpoints/Prep/VisualMapperEndpoints.cs
   EDIT  Backend/tests/.../Mapping/VisualMapperSessionLifecycleTests.cs

 CONTRACT
   -ReportOnly / (default) / -Revert -BackupPath
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$ReportOnly, [switch]$Revert, [string]$BackupPath)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:Failures  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Repo      = (Get-Location).Path
$script:Api       = Join-Path $script:Repo "Backend\PlantProcess.Api\Endpoints\Prep\VisualMapperEndpoints.cs"
$script:Test      = Join-Path $script:Repo "Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Api.IntegrationTests\Mapping\VisualMapperSessionLifecycleTests.cs"
$script:Stamp     = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$script:BackupDir = Join-Path $script:Repo ("tools\packs\_backup_T-032g-join-planner_" + $script:Stamp)

$script:OldLines = @(
  '        var emitted = new HashSet<string> { g.Tables[0] };',
  '        foreach (var t in g.Tables.Skip(1))',
  '        {',
  '            var joins = g.Joins',
  '                .Where(j => (j.LeftTable == t && emitted.Contains(j.RightTable))',
  '                         || (j.RightTable == t && emitted.Contains(j.LeftTable)))',
  '                .ToArray();',
  '            if (joins.Length == 0) return (null, $"table ''{t}'' has no join to a table already in the query. Wire it to a table that is further left on the board.", null);',
  '            emitted.Add(t);',
  '            sb.Append(" JOIN \"").Append(schema).Append("\".\"").Append(t).Append("\" ").Append(alias[t]).Append(" ON ");',
  '            sb.Append(string.Join(" AND ", joins.Select(j =>',
  '                $"{alias[j.LeftTable]}.\"{j.LeftColumn}\" = {alias[j.RightTable]}.\"{j.RightColumn}\"")));',
  '        }'

$script:NewLines = @(
  '        // T-032. THE PLANNER WORKS FROM A FRONTIER, NOT FROM LIST ORDER.',
  '        //',
  '        // Two things are being satisfied here and they are not the same thing.',
  '        //',
  '        // THE SCOPE INVARIANT. An ON clause may reference only aliases already',
  '        // in the FROM clause plus the alias this JOIN introduces. Breaking it',
  '        // produced 42P01, missing FROM-clause entry for table "t2", because an',
  '        // earlier version filtered joins on alias.ContainsKey - and the alias',
  '        // map is built for EVERY table before any SQL is emitted, so that test',
  '        // was always true and filtered nothing.',
  '        //',
  '        // THE REACHABILITY INVARIANT. Which table is emitted next is decided by',
  '        // CONNECTIVITY, never by position in g.Tables. The board sends tables in',
  '        // the order the author dropped them, so a legal graph wired A-B and B-C',
  '        // can arrive as [A, C, B]. Walking the list in order would reach C,',
  '        // find no edge back to {A}, and refuse a graph that is perfectly valid.',
  '        //',
  '        // The loop below takes, on each pass, any pending table with an edge to',
  '        // something already emitted, in either direction - LeftTable or',
  '        // RightTable, it makes no difference. Only when NO pending table can be',
  '        // reached is the graph genuinely disconnected, and then it is refused',
  '        // with a sentence rather than compiled into SQL that cannot run.',
  '        var emitted = new HashSet<string> { g.Tables[0] };',
  '        var pending = new List<string>(g.Tables.Skip(1));',
  '        while (pending.Count > 0)',
  '        {',
  '            string? next = null;',
  '            var nextJoins = Array.Empty<JoinSpec>();',
  '            foreach (var candidate in pending)',
  '            {',
  '                var edges = g.Joins',
  '                    .Where(j => (j.LeftTable == candidate && emitted.Contains(j.RightTable))',
  '                             || (j.RightTable == candidate && emitted.Contains(j.LeftTable)))',
  '                    .ToArray();',
  '                if (edges.Length > 0) { next = candidate; nextJoins = edges; break; }',
  '            }',
  '            if (next is null)',
  '            {',
  '                return (null, $"table ''{pending[0]}'' has no join reaching the rest of the board. Wire it to a table that is already connected, or remove it.", null);',
  '            }',
  '            sb.Append(" JOIN \"").Append(schema).Append("\".\"").Append(next).Append("\" ").Append(alias[next]).Append(" ON ");',
  '            sb.Append(string.Join(" AND ", nextJoins.Select(j =>',
  '                $"{alias[j.LeftTable]}.\"{j.LeftColumn}\" = {alias[j.RightTable]}.\"{j.RightColumn}\"")));',
  '            emitted.Add(next);',
  '            pending.Remove(next);',
  '        }'
)

  '    }',

  '            "/api/prep/visual-mapper/sessions/" + sessionId + "/graph", graph);',
  '        Assert.True(saveRes.IsSuccessStatusCode,',
  '            "save graph failed: " + await saveRes.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());',
  '',
  '        var dryRes = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(',
  '            "/api/prep/visual-mapper/sessions/" + sessionId + "/dry-run", new { });',
  '        Assert.True(dryRes.IsSuccessStatusCode,',
  '            "dry run failed: " + await dryRes.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());',
  '        var dry = JsonDocument.Parse(await dryRes.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).RootElement;',
  '',
  '        // THE ASSERTION IS EXECUTION. The message is carried through so a',
  '        // failure names the PostgreSQL code rather than saying "expected true".',
  '        var message = dry.TryGetProperty("message", out var m) ? m.GetString() : null;',
  '        Assert.True(dry.GetProperty("status").GetString() == "succeeded",',
  '            "three-table preview did not execute: " + (message ?? "no message"));',
  '',
  '        // And the compiled statement must name every alias, in a legal order:',
  '        // t0 in FROM, t1 and t2 each introduced by their own JOIN.',
  '        var sql = dry.TryGetProperty("sql", out var s2) ? s2.GetString() ?? "" : "";',
  '        Assert.Contains(" t0", sql);',
  '        Assert.Contains(" t1 ON ", sql);',
  '        Assert.Contains(" t2 ON ", sql);',

function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Ok ([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  [ OK ] " + $m) }
function Bad([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  [FAIL] " + $m) -ForegroundColor Red; [void]$script:Failures.Add($m) }
function Info([string]$m){ Write-Host ("  [ .. ] " + $m) -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
function Read-Text([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }

function Count-Occurrences([string]$Haystack, [string]$Needle) {
  if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
  $n = 0; $i = 0
  while ($true) {
    $i = $Haystack.IndexOf($Needle, $i, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    if ($i -lt 0) { break }
    $n++; $i += $Needle.Length
  }
  return $n
}

function Resolve-Anchor([string]$Text, [string[]]$OldLines, [string[]]$NewLines) {
  foreach ($eol in @("`r`n", "`n")) {
    $candidate = ($OldLines -join $eol)
    if ((Count-Occurrences $Text $candidate) -eq 1) {
      return @{ Old = $candidate; New = ($NewLines -join $eol) }
    }
  }
  return $null
}

function Invoke-Preflight {
  Say ""
  Say "PREFLIGHT"
  if (-not (Test-Path $script:Api))  { Bad "VisualMapperEndpoints.cs not found - run from the repository root"; return }
  if (-not (Test-Path $script:Test)) { Bad "VisualMapperSessionLifecycleTests.cs not found - apply T-032e first"; return }
  Ok "both target files present"

  $a = Read-Text $script:Api
  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "var pending = new List<string>(g.Tables.Skip(1));") -gt 0) { Bad "the frontier planner is already present - nothing to do"; return }
  if ($null -eq (Resolve-Anchor $a $script:OldLines $script:NewLines)) { Bad "the T-032f emitter block was not found exactly once - apply T-032f first" } else { Ok "the T-032f emitter block found exactly once" }

  $t = Read-Text $script:Test
  if ($null -eq (Resolve-Anchor $t $script:OldTest $script:NewTest)) { Bad "the end of the lifecycle test was not found exactly once" } else { Ok "the test tail found exactly once" }
}

function Invoke-SelfCheck {
  Say ""
  Say "SELF-CHECK"
  $a = Read-Text $script:Api

  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "var pending = new List<string>(g.Tables.Skip(1));") -eq 1) { Ok "the pending set is declared once" }        else { Bad "the pending set is missing" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "while (pending.Count > 0)") -eq 1)                          { Ok "the frontier loop is present" }             else { Bad "the frontier loop is missing" }
  # THE NEEDLE NAMES THE EMITTER, NOT A SHAPE THAT ALSO APPEARS ELSEWHERE.
  # v1 of this pack searched for "foreach (var t in g.Tables.Skip(1))" and
  # matched the ALIAS MAP builder higher in the same method - a correct,
  # unrelated loop that must stay. The refusal sentence below belongs to the
  # old emitter and to nothing else, so it is what proves the replacement.
  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "has no join to a table already in the query") -eq 0)      { Ok "the list-order emitter is gone" }           else { Bad "the list-order emitter survives" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "pending.Remove(next);") -eq 1)                              { Ok "each emitted table leaves the pending set" } else { Bad "pending.Remove is wrong" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $a "emitted.Add(next);") -eq 1)                                 { Ok "each emitted table joins the emitted set" }  else { Bad "emitted.Add is wrong" }

  $t = Read-Text $script:Test
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t "Three_table_chain_previews_regardless_of_the_order_tables_arrive_in") -eq 1) { Ok "the chain regression test is present" } else { Bad "the chain regression test is missing" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t "tables = new[] { a, c, b }") -eq 1)                          { Ok "the test submits the tables out of connectivity order" } else { Bad "the test does not exercise ordering" }
  if ((Count-Occurrences $t 'GetString() == "succeeded"') -eq 1)                          { Ok "the test asserts EXECUTION, not string shape" }         else { Bad "the execution assertion is missing" }

  foreach ($p in @($script:Api, $script:Test)) {
    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p)
    if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF) { Bad ("BOM: " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p)) }
    $nonAscii = 0
    foreach ($b in $bytes) { if ($b -gt 127) { $nonAscii++ } }
    if ($nonAscii -gt 0) { Bad ("non-ASCII in " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p)) } else { Ok ("ASCII, no BOM: " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p)) }
  }
}

 PPIQ T-032h - ASSERT THE SCOPE INVARIANT, NOT THE ALIAS NUMBERING
================================================================================

 SCOPE. ONE ASSERTION BLOCK, in one test:
   Backend/tests/.../Mapping/VisualMapperSessionLifecycleTests.cs
   :: Three_table_chain_previews_regardless_of_the_order_tables_arrive_in

 WHAT HAPPENED. The planner fix is correct and the preview EXECUTED. The test
 still failed, on my own secondary assertion:

   t2 was introduced before t1: SELECT * FROM "..._cast_sequence" t0
     JOIN "..._cast_pieces" t2 ON t0."sequence_no" = t2."sequence_no"
     JOIN "..._hsm_coils"  t1 ON t1."heat_no"     = t2."heat_no" LIMIT 50;

 That statement is legal. Every ON clause references only aliases already
 introduced. Alias NUMBERS come from the table list; JOIN ORDER comes from
 connectivity, and the fix decouples them on purpose - so t2 before t1 is the
 planner working, not failing.

 The instruction was explicit: do not merely string-match t0/t1/t2, prove the
 compiled SQL executes. I added the string match anyway, and it was the only
 thing that failed.

 THE CORRECTION. The block now walks the statement and asserts the real
 invariant - the one whose breach produced 42P01: every alias referenced in an
 ON clause has already been introduced by FROM or by an earlier JOIN. The
 execution assertion above it is untouched and already passes.

 NOT IN THIS PACK. No product code. No planner change. Test only.

 CONTRACT
   -ReportOnly / (default) / -Revert -BackupPath
#>

  '        var segments = sql.Split(new[] { " JOIN " }, StringSplitOptions.None);',
  '        Assert.True(segments.Length == 3, "expected two JOINs in a three-table chain: " + sql);',
  '',
  '        var introduced = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);',
  '        foreach (System.Text.RegularExpressions.Match m in',
  '                 System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Matches(segments[0], "\\bt[0-9]+\\b"))',
  '        {',
  '            introduced.Add(m.Value);',
  '        }',
  '',
  '        for (var seg = 1; seg < segments.Length; seg++)',
  '        {',
  '            var onAt = segments[seg].IndexOf(" ON ", StringComparison.Ordinal);',
  '            Assert.True(onAt > 0, "a JOIN without an ON clause: " + sql);',
  '',
  '            // The alias this JOIN introduces is in scope for its own ON clause.',
  '            var head = segments[seg].Substring(0, onAt);',
  '            foreach (System.Text.RegularExpressions.Match m in',

  '            {',
  '                introduced.Add(m.Value);',
  '            }',
  '',
  '            var on = segments[seg].Substring(onAt + 4);',
  '            foreach (System.Text.RegularExpressions.Match m in',

function Say([string]$m)  { Write-Host $m }
function Ok ([string]$m)  { Write-Host ("  [ OK ] " + $m) }
function Bad([string]$m)  { Write-Host ("  [FAIL] " + $m) -ForegroundColor Red; [void]$script:Failures.Add($m) }
function Info([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  [ .. ] " + $m) -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

function Write-Utf8NoBomCrLf([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
  $normalised = $Text -replace "`r`n", "`n"
  $normalised = $normalised -replace "`n", "`r`n"
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
  if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir) }
  $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $normalised, $enc)
}

function Read-Text([string]$Path) {
  return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)
}

function Count-Occurrences([string]$Haystack, [string]$Needle) {
  if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
  $n = 0; $i = 0
  while ($true) {
    $i = $Haystack.IndexOf($Needle, $i, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    if ($i -lt 0) { break }
    $n++; $i += $Needle.Length
  }
  return $n
}

function Replace-Once([string]$Path, [string]$Old, [string]$New) {
  $text = Read-Text $Path
  $hits = Count-Occurrences $text $Old
  if ($hits -ne 1) { throw ("anchor is not unique in " + $Path + " (" + $hits + " hits): " + $Old) }
  $text = $text.Replace($Old, $New)
  $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $text, $enc)
}

$script:NewFiles["Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src/authoring/authoringPurposes.ts"] = @'
// PPIQ T-032. Chapter 4 section 5.2.1 - THE RULING: there is ONE authoring
// shell, not five surfaces that resemble each other. One surface whose schema
// tree, palette, validator and board semantics are parameterised by the
// purpose it was opened for. A user who learns the shell once has learned
// every authoring act in the product.
//
// This module is that parameterisation, and it is a REGISTRY: a purpose is
// added by adding a row, never by adding a branch in a component.

export type AuthoringPurpose = "S1" | "S2" | "S3" | "S4" | "S5";

// Section 5.2.2 - the toggle is always present and always offers exactly two
// modes. Neither mode is a lesser citizen.
export type AuthoringMode = "block" | "sql";

export interface AuthoringPurposeDefinition {
  purpose: AuthoringPurpose;
  /** The name the author sees in the mode bar. */
  label: string;
  /** Section 5.2.1 column 2 - what is authored. */
  authors: string;
  /** Section 5.2.1 column 4 - the output artifact class. */
  outputArtifact: string;
  /** Section 5.2.1 column 3 - which toolbox groups this purpose presents. */
  paletteGroups: string[];
  /**
   * Section 5.2.4 - two groups in the tree on S1 ONLY, because S1's whole
   * purpose is to move data between staging and the plant schema. S2 to S5
   * show the canonical model only.
   */
  showsStagingCatalogue: boolean;
}

export const AUTHORING_PURPOSES: readonly AuthoringPurposeDefinition[] = [
  {
    purpose: "S1",
    label: "Data preparation",
    authors: "Staged data filtered, joined, aliased and mapped into the plant schema",
    outputArtifact: "Transformation Definition",
    paletteGroups: ["source-output", "relational"],
    showsStagingCatalogue: true,
  },
  {
    purpose: "S2",
    label: "Widget and page binding",
    authors: "The dataset a widget displays",
    outputArtifact: "Widget definition",
    paletteGroups: ["source-output", "relational"],
    showsStagingCatalogue: false,
  },
  {
    purpose: "S3",
    label: "Analysis authoring",
    authors: "Correlation, statistics, mathematics",
    outputArtifact: "Analysis Definition",
    paletteGroups: ["source-output", "relational", "statistics"],
    showsStagingCatalogue: false,
  },
  {
    purpose: "S4",
    label: "Model authoring",
    authors: "Model-based analyses over the same canonical data",
    outputArtifact: "Model Definition",
    paletteGroups: ["source-output", "relational", "model-feature"],
    showsStagingCatalogue: false,
  },
  {
    purpose: "S5",
    label: "Plant data log",
    authors: "Rules emitting info, warning and error entries",
    outputArtifact: "Rule Definition",
    paletteGroups: ["source-output", "condition-action"],
    showsStagingCatalogue: false,
  },
];

export function purposeDefinition(purpose: AuthoringPurpose): AuthoringPurposeDefinition {
  const found = AUTHORING_PURPOSES.find((p) => p.purpose === purpose);
  if (!found) {
    // Unreachable through the type, reachable through a bad cast at a call
    // site. Refusing loudly beats rendering a shell with no palette at all.
    throw new Error("Unknown authoring purpose: " + String(purpose));
  }
  return found;
}

$script:NewFiles["Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src/authoring/AuthoringSchemaTree.tsx"] = @'
// PPIQ T-032. Chapter 4 section 5.2.4 - the schema table bar, the INLINE-START
// region of the shell. Three levels, every level unfolding: schema, table,
// attribute with name, type and key marker.
//
// Section 5.2.4 also states WHY it is present in both modes: a SQL author
// needs the column names and types constantly, which is why the tree is
// unchanged when the palette disappears.
//
// Behaviour carried over from the S1 canvas UNCHANGED, because T-032 is a
// convergence and not a rewrite: click a schema or table row to unfold,
// double-click a table or click a column to put the table on the board.

import { StandardP2Button } from "@/components/standard/StandardP2Controls";
import type { StagedDataset } from "@/api/canvasApi";

export interface AuthoringSchemaTreeProps {
  catalogue: StagedDataset[];
  openSchemas: Record<string, boolean>;
  openTables: Record<string, boolean>;
  onToggleSchema: (schema: string) => void;
  onToggleTable: (table: string) => void;
  onAddTable: (dataset: StagedDataset) => void;
  /** Stated when the catalogue is empty. Never a bare blank panel. */
  emptyMessage: string;
}

interface SchemaGroup {
  schema: string;
  tables: StagedDataset[];
}

export function groupBySchema(catalogue: StagedDataset[]): SchemaGroup[] {
  const groups: Record<string, StagedDataset[]> = {};
  for (const d of catalogue) {
    const key = d.source || "unknown";
    if (!groups[key]) { groups[key] = []; }
    groups[key].push(d);
  }
  return Object.keys(groups).sort().map((k) => ({
    schema: k,
    tables: groups[k].slice().sort((a, b) => a.table.localeCompare(b.table)),
  }));
}

export function AuthoringSchemaTree({
  catalogue, openSchemas, openTables, onToggleSchema, onToggleTable, onAddTable, emptyMessage,
}: AuthoringSchemaTreeProps) {
  const schemaGroups = groupBySchema(catalogue);

  return (
    <div className="schema-tree" data-testid="canvas-schema-tree">
      {schemaGroups.length === 0 && (
        <div className="schema-tree__empty">{emptyMessage}</div>
      )}
      {schemaGroups.map((g) => {
        const schemaOpen = openSchemas[g.schema] === true;
        return (
          <div key={g.schema}>
            <StandardP2Button
              variant="ghost"
              type="button"
              className="schema-tree__row schema-tree__row--schema"
              aria-expanded={schemaOpen}
              onClick={() => onToggleSchema(g.schema)}
            >
              <span className={"schema-tree__chev" + (schemaOpen ? " schema-tree__chev--open" : "")} />
              <span className="schema-tree__name">{g.schema}</span>
              <span className="schema-tree__meta">{g.tables.length} tables</span>
            </StandardP2Button>

            {schemaOpen && g.tables.map((d) => {
              const tableOpen = openTables[d.table] === true;
              const keys = d.columns.filter((c) => c.isKeyCandidate).length;
              return (
                <div key={d.table}>
                  <StandardP2Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    type="button"
                    className="schema-tree__row schema-tree__row--table"
                    aria-expanded={tableOpen}
                    onClick={() => onToggleTable(d.table)}
                    onDoubleClick={() => onAddTable(d)}
                    title="Click to unfold columns, double-click to add to the board"
                  >
                    <span className={"schema-tree__chev" + (tableOpen ? " schema-tree__chev--open" : "")} />
                    <span className="schema-tree__name">{d.table}</span>
                    <span className="schema-tree__meta">
                      {d.columns.length} cols{keys > 0 ? " / " + keys + " key" : ""}
                    </span>
                  </StandardP2Button>

                  {tableOpen && d.columns.map((c) => (
                    <StandardP2Button
                      key={d.table + "." + c.name}
                      variant="ghost"
                      type="button"
                      className="schema-tree__col"
                      onClick={() => onAddTable(d)}
                      title={"Add " + d.table + " to the board"}
                    >
                      <span className="schema-tree__name">{c.name}</span>
                      {c.isKeyCandidate && <span className="schema-tree__key">key</span>}
                      <span className="schema-tree__coltype">{c.sqlType}</span>
                    </StandardP2Button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

$script:NewFiles["Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src/authoring/AuthoringToolbox.tsx"] = @'
// PPIQ T-032. Chapter 4 section 5.2.5 - the toolbox, the INLINE-END region of
// the shell: grouped, searchable, and driven entirely by the block registry.
// This component knows about no individual block; adding one is a registry row.
//
// Section 5.2.3: in SQL mode the toolbox is HIDDEN ENTIRELY AND NOT MERELY
// DISABLED, because a disabled palette invites clicking and an absent one does
// not. That decision belongs to the shell, which does not render this
// component at all in SQL mode.
//
// Section 5.2.14: the advanced groups are COLLAPSED BY DEFAULT and expand with
// one click. They are not hidden behind a tier.

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { StandardP2Button, StandardP2Input } from "@/components/standard/StandardP2Controls";
import { blocksInGroup, groupsForPalette, type BlockDefinition } from "./blockRegistry";

export interface AuthoringToolboxProps {
  /** Group ids this purpose presents, from the purpose registry. */
  paletteGroups: readonly string[];
  /** Stated once, at the head of the region, for blocks not yet wired. */
  unavailableReason: string;
}

export function AuthoringToolbox({ paletteGroups, unavailableReason }: AuthoringToolboxProps) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  const groups = useMemo(() => groupsForPalette(paletteGroups), [paletteGroups]);
  const needle = search.trim().toLowerCase();

  const matches = (b: BlockDefinition) =>
    needle === "" || b.label.toLowerCase().indexOf(needle) >= 0;

  return (
    <div className="authoring-toolbox" data-testid="authoring-toolbox">
      <StandardP2Input
        className="authoring-toolbox__search"
        aria-label="Search the toolbox"
        placeholder="Search blocks"
        value={search}
        onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
      />

      <div className="authoring-toolbox__note">{unavailableReason}</div>

      {groups.map((g) => {
        const blocks = blocksInGroup(g.id).filter(matches);
        const isCollapsed = collapsed[g.id] === undefined ? g.advanced : collapsed[g.id];
        if (blocks.length === 0) { return null; }
        return (
          <div className="authoring-toolbox__group" key={g.id} data-testid={"toolbox-group-" + g.id}>
            <StandardP2Button
              variant="ghost"
              type="button"
              className="authoring-toolbox__grouphead"
              aria-expanded={!isCollapsed}
              onClick={() => setCollapsed((c) => ({ ...c, [g.id]: !isCollapsed }))}
            >
              <span className="authoring-toolbox__grouplabel">{g.label}</span>
              <span className="authoring-toolbox__groupcount">{blocks.length}</span>
            </StandardP2Button>

            {!isCollapsed && blocks.map((b) => (
              <StandardP2Button
                key={b.id}
                variant="ghost"
                type="button"
                className="authoring-toolbox__block"
                disabled={!b.available}
                aria-disabled={!b.available}
                title={b.inputs + " -> " + b.outputs}
              >
                <span className="authoring-toolbox__blocklabel">{b.label}</span>
                <span className="authoring-toolbox__blockports">{b.inputs} to {b.outputs}</span>
              </StandardP2Button>
            ))}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
