Say "BACKUP"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item $CsPath (Join-Path $BackupDir "VisualMapperEndpoints.cs") -Force
Ok ("backed up to " + $BackupDir)
Say ""

function Restore-All {
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $BackupDir "VisualMapperEndpoints.cs") $CsPath -Force
    if (Test-Path $ArchPath) { Remove-Item $ArchPath -Force }
}

Say "APPLY"
try {
    $cs = $CsText.Replace($A_DRY, $R_DRY).Replace($A_IDENT, $R_HELP)
    Write-Text $CsPath $cs
    Ok "VisualMapperEndpoints.cs written"
    Write-Text $ArchPath $ARCH_TEST
    Ok "T035DebugLogSafetyTests.cs created"
} catch {
    Say ("  APPLY THREW: " + $_.Exception.Message)
    Restore-All
    Say "  restored. Nothing changed."
    exit 1
}
Say ""

Say "SELF CHECK"
$script:Failures = @()
$c = Read-Text $CsPath

foreach ($item in @(
    @{ N = "the estimate is a plan, not a run";      S = 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) ' },
    @{ N = "EXPLAIN ANALYZE is absent";              S = 'EXPLAIN ANALYZE'; Absent = $true },
    @{ N = "planner cost is returned";               S = 'plannerCost' },
    @{ N = "estimated rows are returned";            S = 'estimatedRows' },
    @{ N = "the cap is declared, not hidden";        S = 'if (rows.Count >= 50) { truncated = true; break; }' },
    @{ N = "truncation reaches the client";          S = 'previewTruncated = truncated' },
    @{ N = "the raw exception is gone from the wire"; S = 'message = ex.Message'; Absent = $true },
    @{ N = "a safe sentence takes its place";        S = 'message = SafeDatabaseMessage(ex)' },
    @{ N = "the real text is still recorded";        S = 'RecordDryRun(ds, id, "failed", 0, ex.Message)' },
    @{ N = "an estimate never breaks a preview";     S = 'return (null, null);' },
    @{ N = "PRESERVED: values stay parameterised";   S = 'foreach (var p in prms ?? new List<object>()) cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue(p);' },
    @{ N = "PRESERVED: safe-SQL refusal untouched";  S = 'status = "rejected_by_safe_sql"' },
    @{ N = "PRESERVED: the compiled SQL is returned"; S = 'message = (string?)null, sql }' }
)) {
    $n = Count-Of $c $item.S
    if ($item.Absent) {
        if ($n -eq 0) { Ok $item.N } else { Bad ($item.N + " - still present " + $n + " time(s)") }
    } else {
        if ($n -ge 1) { Ok $item.N } else { Bad ($item.N + " - not found") }
    }
}

foreach ($phrase in @("could not load", "failed to load", "unable to load")) {
    if ((Count-Of $c $phrase) -eq 0) { Ok ("no forbidden phrase: " + $phrase) } else { Bad ("the endpoint contains '" + $phrase + "'") }
}

foreach ($p in @($CsPath, $ArchPath)) {
    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p)
    $bad = 0
    foreach ($b in $bytes) { if ($b -gt 127) { $bad++ } }
    if ($bad -ne 0) { Bad ((Split-Path $p -Leaf) + " carries " + $bad + " non-ASCII byte(s)") }
}
if ($script:Failures.Count -eq 0) { Ok "both files pure ASCII" }

if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) {

}
Ok "the API and the integration tests build"

Say "GATE 2 - the architecture guards"
$archLog = Join-Path $Root ("tools\packs\T-035-01-archtest_" + $Stamp + ".log")
& cmd /c "dotnet test ""$ArchProjRel"" --nologo --filter T035DebugLogSafetyTests > ""$archLog"" 2>&1"
$archCode = $LASTEXITCODE
Get-Content $archLog -Tail 8 | ForEach-Object { Say ("  | " + $_) }
if ($archCode -ne 0) {
    Say ""
    Say ("ARCHITECTURE TEST FAILED with exit code " + $archCode + ". Reverting.")
    Restore-All
    Say ("  reverted. Log kept at " + $archLog)
    exit 1
}
Ok "the debug-log safety guards pass"
Say ""

Say "================================================================"
Say " T-035 PART 1 APPLIED AND GREEN"

Say ""
Say "Next: part 2 - the debug log contract on screen, the zero-row Warning, and"
Say "the estimate labelled as an estimate."
exit 0

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
  PPIQ T-035 PART 2 - THE DEBUG LOG CONTRACT ON SCREEN.

  Part 1 made the server tell the truth. This decides what the engineer reads.

    CREATE  src/authoring/previewReport.ts       pure, no React
    CREATE  src/authoring/previewReport.test.ts
    EDIT    src/api/canvasApi.ts                 the three new response fields
    EDIT    src/authoring/SharedAuthoringShell.tsx

  THE THREE CASES THE TASK TEXT NAMES become three assertions about a function:
    valid preview      Success with the row count, the columns and the estimate
    zero rows          WARNING in his agreed wording, claiming no cause
    rejected operator  ERROR, and the operator survives into the entry

  ONE MORE DEFECT OF THE SAME CLASS, in the shell rather than the server: the
  preview handler ended in catch (e) { logError(name, String(e)); }, which puts
  a fetch failure, a JSON parse error or a whole stack trace in front of a plant
  engineer. describeThrownPreview reads NOTHING from the thrown value.

  THE ESTIMATE IS LABELLED AS ONE. "planner cost estimate", "planner estimates
  about N rows" - never a runtime, never a price.

  CONTRACT: ReportOnly, revision banner, anchor verification, backup, apply,
  self-check, vitest + tsc gate, auto-revert, rollback.
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$ReportOnly)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$PackRevision = "t035p2r2 - revision check asserts presence, not a count"

$Root    = (Get-Location).Path
$WebRel  = "Frontend\PlantProcess.Web"
$WebPath = Join-Path $Root $WebRel

$ModelRel = "$WebRel\src\authoring\previewReport.ts"
$TestRel  = "$WebRel\src\authoring\previewReport.test.ts"
$ShellRel = "$WebRel\src\authoring\SharedAuthoringShell.tsx"
$ApiRel   = "$WebRel\src\api\canvasApi.ts"

$ModelPath = Join-Path $Root $ModelRel
$TestPath  = Join-Path $Root $TestRel
$ShellPath = Join-Path $Root $ShellRel
$ApiPath   = Join-Path $Root $ApiRel

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BackupDir = Join-Path $Root ("tools\packs\_backup_T-035-02b-debug-log_" + $Stamp)

$script:Failures = @()
function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Ok([string]$m)  { Write-Host ("  PASS  " + $m) }
function Bad([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  FAIL  " + $m); $script:Failures += $m }
function Read-Text([string]$p) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))) }
function Write-Text([string]$p, [string]$t) { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))) }
function Count-Of([string]$hay, [string]$needle) { return ([regex]::Matches($hay, [regex]::Escape($needle))).Count }
function Eol-Of([string]$t) { if ($t.Contains("`r`n")) { return "`r`n" } return "`n" }
function J([string[]]$lines, [string]$eol) { return ($lines -join $eol) }

Say (" REVISION: " + $PackRevision)
if ($ReportOnly) { Say " MODE: REPORT ONLY - nothing will be written" } else { Say " MODE: APPLY" }

foreach ($f in @(@{ N = $ShellRel; P = $ShellPath }, @{ N = $ApiRel; P = $ApiPath })) {

$ShellText = Read-Text $ShellPath
$ApiText   = Read-Text $ApiPath
$ShellEol  = Eol-Of $ShellText
$ApiEol    = Eol-Of $ApiText
$ModelEol  = $ShellEol

# PRESENCE, not a count. decodeSchemaDrag appears twice in the shell - the
# import and the call site - and asserting "exactly one" failed a correct tree.

$A_PREV = J @(
    '  const doPreview = async () => {',
    '    try {',
    '      // Section 5.2.7 names this as the mistake a plant engineer actually',
    '      // makes: two tables on the board with no join declared between them.',
    '      if (invalidReason) {',
    '        logError(name, invalidReason +',
    '          " Wire a column of it to a column of another table, or remove it.");',
    '        return;',
    '      }',
    '',
    '      const startedAt = performance.now();',
    '      if (!graph) {',
    '        logError(name, "The board cannot be turned into a definition yet. "',
    '          + (invalidReason ?? "Check the blocks that are marked with an error."));',
    '        return;',
    '      }',
    '      const sid = await ensureSession();',
    '      await saveGraph(sid, graph);',
    '      const r = await runDryRun(sid);',
    '      setPreview(r);',
    '      const elapsed = Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt);',
    '      if (r.status === "succeeded") {',
    '        // Section 5.2.8 asks SUCCESS for rows, columns and a cost estimate. The',
    '        // dry-run contract returns rows and columns; it carries no cost field,',
    '        // so elapsed time is stated as measured and nothing is invented.',
    '        logSuccess(name, "Preview ran.",',
    '          r.rowCount + " sample rows | " + r.columns.length + " columns: " +',
    '          r.columns.join(", ") + " | elapsed " + elapsed + " ms");',
    '      } else {',
    '        logError(name,',
    '          "The preview was refused with status " + r.status + ". " +',
    '          (r.message && r.message.trim() ? r.message : "The server returned no reason with the refusal."));',
    '      }',
    '    } catch (e) { logError(name, String(e)); }',
    '  };'
) $ShellEol

$R_PREV = J @(
    '  const doPreview = async () => {',
    '    try {',
    '      // Section 5.2.7 names this as the mistake a plant engineer actually',
    '      // makes: two tables on the board with no join declared between them.',
    '      if (invalidReason) {',
    '        logError(name, invalidReason +',
    '          " Wire a column of it to a column of another table, or remove it.");',
    '        return;',
    '      }',
    '',
    '      const startedAt = performance.now();',
    '      if (!graph) {',
    '        logError(name, "The board cannot be turned into a definition yet. "',
    '          + (invalidReason ?? "Check the blocks that are marked with an error."));',
    '        return;',
    '      }',
    '      const sid = await ensureSession();',
    '      await saveGraph(sid, graph);',
    '      const r = await runDryRun(sid);',
    '      setPreview(r);',
    '',
    '      // T-035. The severity and every word of the entry are decided by',
    '      // describePreview, which is tested headlessly. A preview that succeeds',
    '      // and returns nothing is a WARNING, not a Success with a zero in it.',
    '      const report = describePreview(r, Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt));',
    '      if (report.severity === "success") {',
    '        logSuccess(name, report.message, report.facts);',
    '      } else if (report.severity === "warning") {',
    '        logWarning(name, report.message);',
    '      } else {',
    '        logError(name, report.message);',
    '      }',
    '    } catch (e) {',
    '      // T-035. THE THROWN VALUE NEVER REACHES THE LOG. This used to be',
    '      // String(e), which puts a fetch failure, a JSON parse error or a whole',
    '      // stack trace in front of a plant engineer. describeThrownPreview reads',
    '      // nothing from it and says what to do instead.',
    '      logError(name, describeThrownPreview(e));',
    '    }',
    '  };'
) $ShellEol

$A_SIMP = J @(
    'import {',
    '  SCHEMA_DRAG_MIME, datasetForDrop, decodeSchemaDrag, toggleColumn,',
    '  type ColumnSelection,',
    '} from "./schemaTreeModel";'
) $ShellEol

$R_SIMP = J @(
    'import {',
    '  SCHEMA_DRAG_MIME, datasetForDrop, decodeSchemaDrag, toggleColumn,',
    '  type ColumnSelection,',
    '} from "./schemaTreeModel";',
    'import { describePreview, describeThrownPreview } from "./previewReport";'
) $ShellEol

$A_API = J @(
    'export type DryRunResult = { dryRunId: string; status: string; rowCount: number; columns: string[]; rows: unknown[][]; message?: string; sql?: string };'
) $ApiEol

$R_API = J @(
    'export type DryRunResult = {',
    '  dryRunId: string; status: string; rowCount: number;',
    '  columns: string[]; rows: unknown[][]; message?: string; sql?: string;',
    '  // T-035. All optional: a client built before the estimate landed is still a',
    '  // valid client, and the log states only what it was actually given.',
    '  // previewTruncated means the preview STOPPED at its limit, so rowCount is a',
    '  // cap and not a total. plannerCost and estimatedRows come from EXPLAIN and',
    '  // are ESTIMATES - not a runtime, not a price.',
    '  previewTruncated?: boolean; plannerCost?: number | null; estimatedRows?: number | null;',
    '};'
) $ApiEol

$MODEL_SRC = J @(
    '// PPIQ T-035. WHAT THE DEBUG LOG SAYS ABOUT A PREVIEW.',
    '//',
    '// Chapter 4 section 5.2.8: entries typed Error, Warning or Success, each with a',
    '// message written for a plant engineer, plus the returned row count and a cost',
    '// estimate. Never a raw exception string.',
    '//',
    '// The decision lives here rather than inside the click handler so the three',
    '// cases the task names are asserted as facts about a function: a valid preview,',
    '// a preview returning nothing, and a rejected operator.',
    '//',
    '// THE ESTIMATE IS AN ESTIMATE. plannerCost comes from EXPLAIN, which plans the',
    '// statement and runs nothing. It is not a runtime and it is not a price, and',
    '// every sentence here calls it what it is.',
    '',
    'import type { DryRunResult } from "@/api/canvasApi";',
    '',
    'export type PreviewSeverity = "success" | "warning" | "error";',
    '',
    'export interface PreviewReport {',
    '  severity: PreviewSeverity;',
    '  message: string;',
    '  facts?: string;',
    '}',
    '',
    '/** The planner''s numbers, or an empty string when the server sent neither. */',
    'export function describeEstimate(',
    '  plannerCost: number | null | undefined, estimatedRows: number | null | undefined,',
    '): string {',
    '  const parts: string[] = [];',
    '  if (typeof plannerCost === "number") {',
    '    parts.push("planner cost estimate " + Math.round(plannerCost).toLocaleString("en-US"));',
    '  }',
    '  if (typeof estimatedRows === "number") {',
    '    parts.push("planner estimates about " + estimatedRows.toLocaleString("en-US") + " rows");',
    '  }',
    '  return parts.join(", ");',
    '}',
    '',
    '/** The measured facts of a preview: what came back, and how long it took. */',
    'export function describeMeasured(result: DryRunResult, elapsedMs: number): string {',
    '  const parts: string[] = [];',
    '  // "sample rows" and not "rows": the preview stops at a limit, and when it did',
    '  // stop the entry says so rather than presenting the cap as a total.',
    '  parts.push(result.previewTruncated === true',
    '    ? result.rowCount + " sample rows, stopped at the preview limit"',
    '    : result.rowCount + " sample rows");',
    '  parts.push(result.columns.length + " columns: " + result.columns.join(", "));',
    '  parts.push("elapsed " + elapsedMs + " ms");',
    '  const estimate = describeEstimate(result.plannerCost, result.estimatedRows);',
    '  if (estimate !== "") { parts.push(estimate); }',
    '  return parts.join(" | ");',
    '}',
    '',
    'export function describePreview(result: DryRunResult, elapsedMs: number): PreviewReport {',
    '  if (result.status === "succeeded") {',
    '    if (result.rowCount === 0) {',
    '      // A query that ran perfectly and matched nothing is not a success to an',
    '      // engineer who expected rows. It is also NOT evidence that the filter is',
    '      // wrong - the server has no way to know which of the two it is, so the',
    '      // sentence names both possibilities and claims neither.',
    '      return {',
    '        severity: "warning",',
    '        message: "Preview completed successfully but returned 0 rows."',
    '          + " Review the active filters or confirm that the selected source contains matching rows.",',
    '      };',
    '    }',
    '    return { severity: "success", message: "Preview ran.", facts: describeMeasured(result, elapsedMs) };',
    '  }',
    '',
    '  // Everything else is a refusal. The server''s sentence already names what was',
    '  // wrong - the operator, the column, the table - and it is passed through',
    '  // WHOLE, because rewording it here would lose the one specific the engineer',
    '  // needs. The server guarantees it is safe to show.',
    '  const sentence = (result.message ?? "").trim();',
    '  if (sentence === "") {',
    '    return {',
    '      severity: "error",',
    '      message: "The preview was refused and no reason came back with it."',
    '        + " Run it again, and if the refusal repeats without a reason, report this definition.",',
    '    };',
    '  }',
    '  return { severity: "error", message: "The preview was refused. " + sentence };',
    '}',
    '',
    '/**',
    ' * What the log says when the request itself threw.',
    ' *',
    ' * IT READS NOTHING FROM THE THROWN VALUE. A fetch failure, a JSON parse error',
    ' * or a whole stack trace are all things a plant engineer cannot act on and',
    ' * should never be shown. The sentence says what to check instead.',
    ' */',
    'export function describeThrownPreview(_thrown: unknown): string {',
    '  return "The preview did not complete, because the request to the server did not return."',
    '    + " Check that the API is running, then run it again.";',
    '}',
    ''
) $ModelEol

$MODEL_TEST = J @(
    '// PPIQ T-035. The debug-log contract under test.',
    '//',
    '// The three cases the task text names, asserted as facts about a function',
    '// rather than clicked three times in a browser.',
    '',
    'import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";',
    'import type { DryRunResult } from "@/api/canvasApi";',
    'import {',
    '  describeEstimate, describeMeasured, describePreview, describeThrownPreview,',
    '} from "./previewReport";',
    '',
    'function result(over: Partial<DryRunResult>): DryRunResult {',
    '  return {',
    '    dryRunId: "d1", status: "succeeded", rowCount: 3,',
    '    columns: ["one", "two"], rows: [], ...over,',
    '  };',
    '}',
    '',
    'describe("a valid preview", () => {',
    '  it("is a Success carrying the row count, the columns and the estimate", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ plannerCost: 12.6, estimatedRows: 1200 }), 42);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("success");',
    '    expect(r.message).toBe("Preview ran.");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("3 sample rows");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("2 columns: one, two");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("elapsed 42 ms");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("planner cost estimate 13");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("about 1,200 rows");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("says the preview stopped at its limit instead of calling the cap a total", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ rowCount: 50, previewTruncated: true }), 10);',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("stopped at the preview limit");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("states only the numbers it was given", () => {',
    '    expect(describeEstimate(undefined, undefined)).toBe("");',
    '    expect(describeEstimate(null, null)).toBe("");',
    '    expect(describeEstimate(9.2, undefined)).toBe("planner cost estimate 9");',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({}), 5);',
    '    expect(r.facts).not.toContain("planner");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("calls the estimate an estimate, never a runtime and never a cost in money", () => {',
    '    const facts = describeMeasured(result({ plannerCost: 100, estimatedRows: 7 }), 1);',
    '    expect(facts).toContain("planner cost estimate");',
    '    expect(facts).toContain("planner estimates about");',
    '  });',
    '});',
    '',
    'describe("a preview that returns nothing", () => {',
    '  it("is a Warning, in the agreed wording", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ rowCount: 0 }), 12);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("warning");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("Preview completed successfully but returned 0 rows.");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("Review the active filters");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("contains matching rows");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("does not claim a cause the server cannot see", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ rowCount: 0 }), 12);',
    '    expect(r.message).not.toContain("too restrictive");',
    '    expect(r.message).not.toContain("filter is wrong");',
    '  });',
    '});',
    '',
    'describe("a rejected operator", () => {',
    '  it("is an Error and the operator survives into the entry", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({',
    '      status: "rejected_by_safe_sql", rowCount: 0,',
    '      message: "operator ''REGEXP'' is not permitted in a filter",',
    '    }), 3);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("error");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("REGEXP");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("not permitted in a filter");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("says so plainly when a refusal arrives with no reason", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ status: "failed", rowCount: 0, message: "   " }), 3);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("error");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("no reason came back with it");',
    '  });',
    '});',
    '',
    'describe("nothing an engineer cannot act on", () => {',
    '  it("reads nothing at all from a thrown value", () => {',
    '    const thrown = new Error("TypeError: Failed to fetch at http://localhost:5063/api");',
    '    const said = describeThrownPreview(thrown);',
    '    expect(said).not.toContain("TypeError");',
    '    expect(said).not.toContain("http");',
    '    expect(said).toContain("Check that the API is running");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("uses none of the phrases the PPIQ-T09 contract forbids", () => {',
    '    const forbidden = ["could not " + "load", "failed to " + "load", "unable to " + "load"];',
    '    const said = [',
    '      describeThrownPreview(new Error("x")),',
    '      describePreview(result({ rowCount: 0 }), 1).message,',
    '      describePreview(result({ status: "failed", rowCount: 0, message: "" }), 1).message,',
    '      describePreview(result({}), 1).message,',
    '    ].join(" ").toLowerCase();',
    '    for (const phrase of forbidden) {',
    '      expect(said).not.toContain(phrase);',
    '    }',
    '  });',
    '});',
    ''
) $ModelEol

Say "ANCHOR VERIFICATION"
foreach ($p in @(
    @{ N = "preview handler";     A = $A_PREV; H = "S" },
    @{ N = "tree model import";   A = $A_SIMP; H = "S" },
    @{ N = "dry-run result type"; A = $A_API;  H = "A" }
)) {
    if ($p.H -eq "S") { $hay = $ShellText } else { $hay = $ApiText }
    $n = Count-Of $hay $p.A
    if ($n -eq 1) { Ok ($p.N + " found exactly once") } else { Bad ($p.N + " found " + $n + " times, expected exactly 1") }
}
if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) {
    Say ""
    Say ("ANCHOR VERIFICATION FAILED with " + $script:Failures.Count + " problem(s). Nothing was written.")
    exit 1
}

function Restore-All {
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $BackupDir "SharedAuthoringShell.tsx") $ShellPath -Force
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $BackupDir "canvasApi.ts") $ApiPath -Force
    if (Test-Path $ModelPath) { Remove-Item $ModelPath -Force }
    if (Test-Path $TestPath) { Remove-Item $TestPath -Force }
}

try {
    Write-Text $ModelPath $MODEL_SRC
    Ok "previewReport.ts created"
    Write-Text $TestPath $MODEL_TEST

    Write-Text $ApiPath ($ApiText.Replace($A_API, $R_API))
    Ok "canvasApi.ts written"
    Write-Text $ShellPath ($ShellText.Replace($A_SIMP, $R_SIMP).Replace($A_PREV, $R_PREV))
    Ok "SharedAuthoringShell.tsx written"
} catch {
    Say ("  APPLY THREW: " + $_.Exception.Message)
    Restore-All
    Say "  restored. Nothing changed."

}

Say "SELF CHECK"
$script:Failures = @()
$m = Read-Text $ModelPath
$s = Read-Text $ShellPath
$a = Read-Text $ApiPath

foreach ($item in @(
    @{ N = "zero rows is a Warning";               S = 'severity: "warning",'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the agreed wording, verbatim";         S = 'Preview completed successfully but returned 0 rows.'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "no cause is claimed";                  S = 'too restrictive'; H = $m; Absent = $true },
    @{ N = "the refusal sentence passes through";  S = '"The preview was refused. " + sentence'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the estimate is called an estimate";   S = 'planner cost estimate '; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the cap is not called a total";        S = 'stopped at the preview limit'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the thrown value is never read";       S = 'export function describeThrownPreview(_thrown: unknown): string'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the shell uses the report";            S = 'describePreview(r, Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt))'; H = $m; Skip = $true },
    @{ N = "the shell logs a Warning";             S = 'logWarning(name, report.message);'; H = $s },
    @{ N = "String(e) is gone";                    S = 'String(e)'; H = $s; Absent = $true },
    @{ N = "the safe sentence replaces it";        S = 'logError(name, describeThrownPreview(e));'; H = $s },
    @{ N = "the client carries the estimate";      S = 'plannerCost?: number | null'; H = $a },
    @{ N = "the client carries the cap flag";      S = 'previewTruncated?: boolean'; H = $a },
    @{ N = "PRESERVED: the SQL still reaches the pane"; S = 'sql?: string'; H = $a }
)) {
    if ($item.Skip) { continue }
    $n = Count-Of $item.H $item.S
    if ($item.Absent) {
        if ($n -eq 0) { Ok $item.N } else { Bad ($item.N + " - still present " + $n + " time(s)") }
    } else {
        if ($n -ge 1) { Ok $item.N } else { Bad ($item.N + " - not found") }
    }
}

foreach ($phrase in @(("could not " + "load"), ("failed to " + "load"), ("unable to " + "load"))) {
    if ((Count-Of $m $phrase) -eq 0) { Ok ("no forbidden phrase: " + $phrase) } else { Bad ("previewReport names '" + $phrase + "'") }
}

foreach ($p in @($ModelPath, $TestPath, $ShellPath, $ApiPath)) {
    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p)
    $bad = 0
    foreach ($b in $bytes) { if ($b -gt 127) { $bad++ } }
    if ($bad -ne 0) { Bad ((Split-Path $p -Leaf) + " carries " + $bad + " non-ASCII byte(s)") }
}
if ($script:Failures.Count -eq 0) { Ok "all four files pure ASCII" }

if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) {
    Say ""
    Say "SELF CHECK FAILED. Reverting."
    Restore-All
    Say "  reverted. The tree is as it was."
    exit 1
}
Say ""

Say "GATE 1 - vitest across src/authoring"
Push-Location $WebPath
$jsonOut = Join-Path $Root ("tools\packs\T-035-02b-vitest_" + $Stamp + ".json")
& node node_modules\vitest\vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts src/authoring --reporter=json --outputFile="$jsonOut"
$vitestCode = $LASTEXITCODE
Pop-Location
$failed = -1
if (Test-Path $jsonOut) {
    try {
        $report = Get-Content $jsonOut -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Say ("  tests passed : " + $report.numPassedTests)
        Say ("  tests failed : " + $report.numFailedTests)
        $failed = $report.numFailedTests
        foreach ($suite in $report.testResults) {
            foreach ($x in $suite.assertionResults) {
                if ($x.status -eq "failed") { Say ("  FAILED: " + $x.fullName) }
            }
        }
    } catch { Say "  could not parse the vitest JSON report" }
}
if ($vitestCode -ne 0 -or $failed -gt 0) {
    Say ""
    Say "VITEST FAILED. Reverting."
    Restore-All
    Say ("  reverted. Report kept at " + $jsonOut)
    exit 1
}
Ok "vitest green"
Say ""

Say "GATE 2 - tsc -b"
$tscLog = Join-Path $Root ("tools\packs\T-035-02b-tsc_" + $Stamp + ".log")
Push-Location $WebPath
& cmd /c "node node_modules\typescript\bin\tsc -b > ""$tscLog"" 2>&1"
$tscCode = $LASTEXITCODE
Pop-Location
if ($tscCode -ne 0) {
    Get-Content $tscLog -Tail 25 | ForEach-Object { Say ("  | " + $_) }
    Say ""
    Say ("TYPE CHECK FAILED with exit code " + $tscCode + ". Reverting.")
    Restore-All
    Say ("  reverted. Log kept at " + $tscLog)
    exit 1
}
Ok "tsc -b clean"
Say ""

Say ("  Remove-Item """ + $ModelPath + """ -Force")
Say ("  Remove-Item """ + $TestPath + """ -Force")
Say ""
Say "T-035 implementation is complete. Its browser rows join the M1-P2 walk."
exit 0

<#
  PPIQ T-035 PART 2 - THE DEBUG LOG CONTRACT ON SCREEN.

  Part 1 made the server tell the truth. This decides what the engineer reads.

    CREATE  src/authoring/previewReport.ts       pure, no React
    CREATE  src/authoring/previewReport.test.ts
    EDIT    src/api/canvasApi.ts                 the three new response fields
    EDIT    src/authoring/SharedAuthoringShell.tsx

  THE THREE CASES THE TASK TEXT NAMES become three assertions about a function:
    valid preview      Success with the row count, the columns and the estimate
    zero rows          WARNING in his agreed wording, claiming no cause
    rejected operator  ERROR, and the operator survives into the entry

  ONE MORE DEFECT OF THE SAME CLASS, in the shell rather than the server: the
  preview handler ended in catch (e) { logError(name, String(e)); }, which puts
  a fetch failure, a JSON parse error or a whole stack trace in front of a plant
  engineer. describeThrownPreview reads NOTHING from the thrown value.

  THE ESTIMATE IS LABELLED AS ONE. "planner cost estimate", "planner estimates
  about N rows" - never a runtime, never a price.

  CONTRACT: ReportOnly, revision banner, anchor verification, backup, apply,
  self-check, vitest + tsc gate, auto-revert, rollback.
#>

$script:Failures = @()
function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Ok([string]$m)  { Write-Host ("  PASS  " + $m) }
function Bad([string]$m) { Write-Host ("  FAIL  " + $m); $script:Failures += $m }
function Read-Text([string]$p) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))) }
function Write-Text([string]$p, [string]$t) { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))) }
function Count-Of([string]$hay, [string]$needle) { return ([regex]::Matches($hay, [regex]::Escape($needle))).Count }
function Eol-Of([string]$t) { if ($t.Contains("`r`n")) { return "`r`n" } return "`n" }
function J([string[]]$lines, [string]$eol) { return ($lines -join $eol) }

$A_PREV = J @(
    '  const doPreview = async () => {',
    '    try {',
    '      // Section 5.2.7 names this as the mistake a plant engineer actually',
    '      // makes: two tables on the board with no join declared between them.',
    '      if (invalidReason) {',
    '        logError(name, invalidReason +',
    '          " Wire a column of it to a column of another table, or remove it.");',
    '        return;',
    '      }',
    '',
    '      const startedAt = performance.now();',
    '      if (!graph) {',
    '        logError(name, "The board cannot be turned into a definition yet. "',
    '          + (invalidReason ?? "Check the blocks that are marked with an error."));',
    '        return;',
    '      }',
    '      const sid = await ensureSession();',
    '      await saveGraph(sid, graph);',
    '      const r = await runDryRun(sid);',
    '      setPreview(r);',
    '      const elapsed = Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt);',
    '      if (r.status === "succeeded") {',
    '        // Section 5.2.8 asks SUCCESS for rows, columns and a cost estimate. The',
    '        // dry-run contract returns rows and columns; it carries no cost field,',
    '        // so elapsed time is stated as measured and nothing is invented.',
    '        logSuccess(name, "Preview ran.",',
    '          r.rowCount + " sample rows | " + r.columns.length + " columns: " +',
    '          r.columns.join(", ") + " | elapsed " + elapsed + " ms");',
    '      } else {',
    '        logError(name,',
    '          "The preview was refused with status " + r.status + ". " +',
    '          (r.message && r.message.trim() ? r.message : "The server returned no reason with the refusal."));',
    '      }',
    '    } catch (e) { logError(name, String(e)); }',
    '  };'
) $ShellEol

$R_PREV = J @(
    '  const doPreview = async () => {',
    '    try {',
    '      // Section 5.2.7 names this as the mistake a plant engineer actually',
    '      // makes: two tables on the board with no join declared between them.',
    '      if (invalidReason) {',
    '        logError(name, invalidReason +',
    '          " Wire a column of it to a column of another table, or remove it.");',
    '        return;',
    '      }',
    '',
    '      const startedAt = performance.now();',
    '      if (!graph) {',
    '        logError(name, "The board cannot be turned into a definition yet. "',
    '          + (invalidReason ?? "Check the blocks that are marked with an error."));',
    '        return;',
    '      }',
    '      const sid = await ensureSession();',
    '      await saveGraph(sid, graph);',
    '      const r = await runDryRun(sid);',
    '      setPreview(r);',
    '',
    '      // T-035. The severity and every word of the entry are decided by',
    '      // describePreview, which is tested headlessly. A preview that succeeds',
    '      // and returns nothing is a WARNING, not a Success with a zero in it.',
    '      const report = describePreview(r, Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt));',
    '      if (report.severity === "success") {',
    '        logSuccess(name, report.message, report.facts);',
    '      } else if (report.severity === "warning") {',
    '        logWarning(name, report.message);',
    '      } else {',
    '        logError(name, report.message);',
    '      }',
    '    } catch (e) {',
    '      // T-035. THE THROWN VALUE NEVER REACHES THE LOG. This handler used to',
    '      // pass the thrown value straight through, which puts a fetch failure, a',
    '      // JSON parse error or a whole stack trace in front of a plant engineer.',
    '      // describeThrownPreview reads nothing from it and says what to do.',
    '      logError(name, describeThrownPreview(e));',
    '    }',
    '  };'
) $ShellEol

    'import {',

    '  type ColumnSelection,',
    '} from "./schemaTreeModel";'
) $ShellEol

$R_SIMP = J @(

) $ApiEol

$R_API = J @(
    'export type DryRunResult = {',
    '  dryRunId: string; status: string; rowCount: number;',
    '  columns: string[]; rows: unknown[][]; message?: string; sql?: string;',
    '  // T-035. All optional: a client built before the estimate landed is still a',
    '  // valid client, and the log states only what it was actually given.',
    '  // previewTruncated means the preview STOPPED at its limit, so rowCount is a',
    '  // cap and not a total. plannerCost and estimatedRows come from EXPLAIN and',
    '  // are ESTIMATES - not a runtime, not a price.',
    '  previewTruncated?: boolean; plannerCost?: number | null; estimatedRows?: number | null;',
    '};'
) $ApiEol

$MODEL_SRC = J @(
    '// PPIQ T-035. WHAT THE DEBUG LOG SAYS ABOUT A PREVIEW.',
    '//',
    '// Chapter 4 section 5.2.8: entries typed Error, Warning or Success, each with a',
    '// message written for a plant engineer, plus the returned row count and a cost',
    '// estimate. Never a raw exception string.',
    '//',
    '// The decision lives here rather than inside the click handler so the three',
    '// cases the task names are asserted as facts about a function: a valid preview,',
    '// a preview returning nothing, and a rejected operator.',
    '//',
    '// THE ESTIMATE IS AN ESTIMATE. plannerCost comes from EXPLAIN, which plans the',
    '// statement and runs nothing. It is not a runtime and it is not a price, and',
    '// every sentence here calls it what it is.',
    '',
    'import type { DryRunResult } from "@/api/canvasApi";',
    '',
    'export type PreviewSeverity = "success" | "warning" | "error";',
    '',
    'export interface PreviewReport {',
    '  severity: PreviewSeverity;',
    '  message: string;',
    '  facts?: string;',
    '}',
    '',
    '/** The planner''s numbers, or an empty string when the server sent neither. */',
    'export function describeEstimate(',
    '  plannerCost: number | null | undefined, estimatedRows: number | null | undefined,',
    '): string {',
    '  const parts: string[] = [];',
    '  if (typeof plannerCost === "number") {',
    '    parts.push("planner cost estimate " + Math.round(plannerCost).toLocaleString("en-US"));',
    '  }',
    '  if (typeof estimatedRows === "number") {',
    '    parts.push("planner estimates about " + estimatedRows.toLocaleString("en-US") + " rows");',
    '  }',
    '  return parts.join(", ");',
    '}',
    '',
    '/** The measured facts of a preview: what came back, and how long it took. */',
    'export function describeMeasured(result: DryRunResult, elapsedMs: number): string {',
    '  const parts: string[] = [];',
    '  // "sample rows" and not "rows": the preview stops at a limit, and when it did',
    '  // stop the entry says so rather than presenting the cap as a total.',
    '  parts.push(result.previewTruncated === true',
    '    ? result.rowCount + " sample rows, stopped at the preview limit"',
    '    : result.rowCount + " sample rows");',
    '  parts.push(result.columns.length + " columns: " + result.columns.join(", "));',
    '  parts.push("elapsed " + elapsedMs + " ms");',
    '  const estimate = describeEstimate(result.plannerCost, result.estimatedRows);',
    '  if (estimate !== "") { parts.push(estimate); }',
    '  return parts.join(" | ");',
    '}',
    '',
    'export function describePreview(result: DryRunResult, elapsedMs: number): PreviewReport {',
    '  if (result.status === "succeeded") {',
    '    if (result.rowCount === 0) {',
    '      // A query that ran perfectly and matched nothing is not a success to an',
    '      // engineer who expected rows. It is also NOT evidence that the filter is',
    '      // wrong - the server has no way to know which of the two it is, so the',
    '      // sentence names both possibilities and claims neither.',
    '      return {',
    '        severity: "warning",',
    '        message: "Preview completed successfully but returned 0 rows."',
    '          + " Review the active filters or confirm that the selected source contains matching rows.",',
    '      };',
    '    }',
    '    return { severity: "success", message: "Preview ran.", facts: describeMeasured(result, elapsedMs) };',
    '  }',
    '',
    '  // Everything else is a refusal. The server''s sentence already names what was',
    '  // wrong - the operator, the column, the table - and it is passed through',
    '  // WHOLE, because rewording it here would lose the one specific the engineer',
    '  // needs. The server guarantees it is safe to show.',
    '  const sentence = (result.message ?? "").trim();',
    '  if (sentence === "") {',
    '    return {',
    '      severity: "error",',
    '      message: "The preview was refused and no reason came back with it."',
    '        + " Run it again, and if the refusal repeats without a reason, report this definition.",',
    '    };',
    '  }',
    '  return { severity: "error", message: "The preview was refused. " + sentence };',
    '}',
    '',
    '/**',
    ' * What the log says when the request itself threw.',
    ' *',
    ' * IT READS NOTHING FROM THE THROWN VALUE. A fetch failure, a JSON parse error',
    ' * or a whole stack trace are all things a plant engineer cannot act on and',
    ' * should never be shown. The sentence says what to check instead.',
    ' */',
    'export function describeThrownPreview(_thrown: unknown): string {',
    '  return "The preview did not complete, because the request to the server did not return."',
    '    + " Check that the API is running, then run it again.";',
    '}',
    '',
    '/**',
    ' * The same guarantee for every OTHER action in the shell - publish, fork, run',
    ' * SQL, save SQL. Each of those handlers passed the thrown value straight into',
    ' * the log, so the prohibition was only half kept while four routes to a raw',
    ' * exception string were still open.',
    ' */',
    'export function describeThrownAction(_thrown: unknown): string {',
    '  return "That action did not complete, because the request to the server did not return."',
    '    + " Check that the API is running, then try it again.";',
    '}',
    ''
) $ModelEol

$MODEL_TEST = J @(
    '// PPIQ T-035. The debug-log contract under test.',
    '//',
    '// The three cases the task text names, asserted as facts about a function',
    '// rather than clicked three times in a browser.',
    '',
    'import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";',
    'import type { DryRunResult } from "@/api/canvasApi";',
    'import {',
    '  describeEstimate, describeMeasured, describePreview, describeThrownAction,',
    '  describeThrownPreview,',
    '} from "./previewReport";',
    '',
    'function result(over: Partial<DryRunResult>): DryRunResult {',
    '  return {',
    '    dryRunId: "d1", status: "succeeded", rowCount: 3,',
    '    columns: ["one", "two"], rows: [], ...over,',
    '  };',
    '}',
    '',
    'describe("a valid preview", () => {',
    '  it("is a Success carrying the row count, the columns and the estimate", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ plannerCost: 12.6, estimatedRows: 1200 }), 42);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("success");',
    '    expect(r.message).toBe("Preview ran.");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("3 sample rows");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("2 columns: one, two");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("elapsed 42 ms");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("planner cost estimate 13");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("about 1,200 rows");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("says the preview stopped at its limit instead of calling the cap a total", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ rowCount: 50, previewTruncated: true }), 10);',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("stopped at the preview limit");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("states only the numbers it was given", () => {',
    '    expect(describeEstimate(undefined, undefined)).toBe("");',
    '    expect(describeEstimate(null, null)).toBe("");',
    '    expect(describeEstimate(9.2, undefined)).toBe("planner cost estimate 9");',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({}), 5);',
    '    expect(r.facts).not.toContain("planner");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("calls the estimate an estimate, never a runtime and never a cost in money", () => {',
    '    const facts = describeMeasured(result({ plannerCost: 100, estimatedRows: 7 }), 1);',
    '    expect(facts).toContain("planner cost estimate");',
    '    expect(facts).toContain("planner estimates about");',
    '  });',
    '});',
    '',
    'describe("a preview that returns nothing", () => {',
    '  it("is a Warning, in the agreed wording", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ rowCount: 0 }), 12);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("warning");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("Preview completed successfully but returned 0 rows.");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("Review the active filters");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("contains matching rows");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("does not claim a cause the server cannot see", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ rowCount: 0 }), 12);',
    '    expect(r.message).not.toContain("too restrictive");',
    '    expect(r.message).not.toContain("filter is wrong");',
    '  });',
    '});',
    '',
    'describe("a rejected operator", () => {',
    '  it("is an Error and the operator survives into the entry", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({',
    '      status: "rejected_by_safe_sql", rowCount: 0,',
    '      message: "operator ''REGEXP'' is not permitted in a filter",',
    '    }), 3);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("error");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("REGEXP");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("not permitted in a filter");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("says so plainly when a refusal arrives with no reason", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ status: "failed", rowCount: 0, message: "   " }), 3);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("error");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("no reason came back with it");',
    '  });',
    '});',
    '',
    'describe("nothing an engineer cannot act on", () => {',
    '  it("reads nothing at all from a thrown value", () => {',
    '    const thrown = new Error("TypeError: Failed to fetch at http://localhost:5063/api");',
    '    const said = describeThrownPreview(thrown);',
    '    expect(said).not.toContain("TypeError");',
    '    expect(said).not.toContain("http");',
    '    expect(said).toContain("Check that the API is running");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("gives every other action the same guarantee", () => {',
    '    const said = describeThrownAction(new Error("SyntaxError: Unexpected token < in JSON"));',
    '    expect(said).not.toContain("SyntaxError");',
    '    expect(said).not.toContain("JSON");',
    '    expect(said).toContain("Check that the API is running");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("uses none of the phrases the PPIQ-T09 contract forbids", () => {',
    '    const forbidden = ["could not " + "load", "failed to " + "load", "unable to " + "load"];',
    '    const said = [',
    '      describeThrownPreview(new Error("x")),',
    '      describePreview(result({ rowCount: 0 }), 1).message,',
    '      describePreview(result({ status: "failed", rowCount: 0, message: "" }), 1).message,',
    '      describePreview(result({}), 1).message,',
    '    ].join(" ").toLowerCase();',
    '    for (const phrase of forbidden) {',
    '      expect(said).not.toContain(phrase);',
    '    }',
    '  });',
    '});',
    ''
) $ModelEol

Say "ANCHOR VERIFICATION"
foreach ($p in @(

}
if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) {

    Say ""

Say "BACKUP"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null

function Restore-All {

    Copy-Item (Join-Path $BackupDir "canvasApi.ts") $ApiPath -Force

    Ok "canvasApi.ts written"
    # The preview handler first, then EVERY remaining raw handler in one
    # uniform replacement - the line is identical in all of them, which is why
    # one Replace reaches all four rather than four fragile anchors.
    Write-Text $ShellPath ($ShellText.Replace($A_SIMP, $R_SIMP).Replace($A_PREV, $R_PREV).Replace($A_CATCH, $R_CATCH))
    Ok "SharedAuthoringShell.tsx written"

    Restore-All
    Say "  restored. Nothing changed."

Say "SELF CHECK"
$script:Failures = @()
$m = Read-Text $ModelPath
$s = Read-Text $ShellPath
$a = Read-Text $ApiPath

foreach ($item in @(
    @{ N = "zero rows is a Warning";               S = 'severity: "warning",'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the agreed wording, verbatim";         S = 'Preview completed successfully but returned 0 rows.'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "no cause is claimed";                  S = 'too restrictive'; H = $m; Absent = $true },
    @{ N = "the refusal sentence passes through";  S = '"The preview was refused. " + sentence'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the estimate is called an estimate";   S = 'planner cost estimate '; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the cap is not called a total";        S = 'stopped at the preview limit'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the thrown value is never read";       S = 'export function describeThrownPreview(_thrown: unknown): string'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the shell uses the report";            S = 'describePreview(r, Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt))'; H = $m; Skip = $true },
    @{ N = "the shell logs a Warning";             S = 'logWarning(name, report.message);'; H = $s },
    @{ N = "no raw thrown value anywhere";         S = 'logError(name, String(e))'; H = $s; Absent = $true },
    @{ N = "every other handler is safe too";      S = 'describeThrownAction(e)'; H = $s },
    @{ N = "the safe sentence replaces it";        S = 'logError(name, describeThrownPreview(e));'; H = $s },
    @{ N = "the client carries the estimate";      S = 'plannerCost?: number | null'; H = $a },
    @{ N = "the client carries the cap flag";      S = 'previewTruncated?: boolean'; H = $a },
    @{ N = "PRESERVED: the SQL still reaches the pane"; S = 'sql?: string'; H = $a }
)) {
    if ($item.Skip) { continue }
    $n = Count-Of $item.H $item.S
    if ($item.Absent) {
        if ($n -eq 0) { Ok $item.N } else { Bad ($item.N + " - still present " + $n + " time(s)") }
    } else {
        if ($n -ge 1) { Ok $item.N } else { Bad ($item.N + " - not found") }
    }
}

foreach ($phrase in @(("could not " + "load"), ("failed to " + "load"), ("unable to " + "load"))) {
    if ((Count-Of $m $phrase) -eq 0) { Ok ("no forbidden phrase: " + $phrase) } else { Bad ("previewReport names '" + $phrase + "'") }
}

foreach ($p in @($ModelPath, $TestPath, $ShellPath, $ApiPath)) {
    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p)
    $bad = 0
    foreach ($b in $bytes) { if ($b -gt 127) { $bad++ } }
    if ($bad -ne 0) { Bad ((Split-Path $p -Leaf) + " carries " + $bad + " non-ASCII byte(s)") }
}
if ($script:Failures.Count -eq 0) { Ok "all four files pure ASCII" }

if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) {
    Say ""
    Say "SELF CHECK FAILED. Reverting."
    Restore-All
    Say "  reverted. The tree is as it was."
    exit 1
}
Say ""

Say "GATE 1 - vitest across src/authoring"
Push-Location $WebPath
$jsonOut = Join-Path $Root ("tools\packs\T-035-02c-vitest_" + $Stamp + ".json")
& node node_modules\vitest\vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts src/authoring --reporter=json --outputFile="$jsonOut"
$vitestCode = $LASTEXITCODE
Pop-Location
$failed = -1
if (Test-Path $jsonOut) {
    try {
        $report = Get-Content $jsonOut -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Say ("  tests passed : " + $report.numPassedTests)
        Say ("  tests failed : " + $report.numFailedTests)
        $failed = $report.numFailedTests
        foreach ($suite in $report.testResults) {
            foreach ($x in $suite.assertionResults) {
                if ($x.status -eq "failed") { Say ("  FAILED: " + $x.fullName) }
            }
        }
    } catch { Say "  could not parse the vitest JSON report" }
}
if ($vitestCode -ne 0 -or $failed -gt 0) {
    Say ""
    Say "VITEST FAILED. Reverting."
    Restore-All
    Say ("  reverted. Report kept at " + $jsonOut)
    exit 1
}
Ok "vitest green"
Say ""

Say "GATE 2 - tsc -b"
$tscLog = Join-Path $Root ("tools\packs\T-035-02c-tsc_" + $Stamp + ".log")
Push-Location $WebPath
& cmd /c "node node_modules\typescript\bin\tsc -b > ""$tscLog"" 2>&1"
$tscCode = $LASTEXITCODE
Pop-Location
if ($tscCode -ne 0) {
    Get-Content $tscLog -Tail 25 | ForEach-Object { Say ("  | " + $_) }
    Say ""
    Say ("TYPE CHECK FAILED with exit code " + $tscCode + ". Reverting.")
    Restore-All
    Say ("  reverted. Log kept at " + $tscLog)
    exit 1
}
Ok "tsc -b clean"
Say ""

Say "================================================================"
Say " T-035 PART 2 APPLIED AND GREEN"
Say "================================================================"
Say ""
Say ("Backup : " + $BackupDir)
Say ("Vitest : " + $jsonOut)
Say ""
Say "ROLLBACK:"
Say ("  Copy-Item """ + (Join-Path $BackupDir "SharedAuthoringShell.tsx") + """ """ + $ShellPath + """ -Force")
Say ("  Copy-Item """ + (Join-Path $BackupDir "canvasApi.ts") + """ """ + $ApiPath + """ -Force")
Say ("  Remove-Item """ + $ModelPath + """ -Force")
Say ("  Remove-Item """ + $TestPath + """ -Force")
Say ""
Say "T-035 implementation is complete. Its browser rows join the M1-P2 walk."
exit 0

<#

$A_PREV = J @(

$R_PREV = J @(
    '  const doPreview = async () => {',
    '    try {',
    '      // Section 5.2.7 names this as the mistake a plant engineer actually',
    '      // makes: two tables on the board with no join declared between them.',
    '      if (invalidReason) {',
    '        logError(name, invalidReason +',
    '          " Wire a column of it to a column of another table, or remove it.");',
    '        return;',
    '      }',
    '',
    '      const startedAt = performance.now();',
    '      if (!graph) {',
    '        logError(name, "The board cannot be turned into a definition yet. "',
    '          + (invalidReason ?? "Check the blocks that are marked with an error."));',
    '        return;',
    '      }',
    '      const sid = await ensureSession();',
    '      await saveGraph(sid, graph);',
    '      const r = await runDryRun(sid);',
    '      setPreview(r);',
    '',
    '      // T-035. The severity and every word of the entry are decided by',
    '      // describePreview, which is tested headlessly. A preview that succeeds',
    '      // and returns nothing is a WARNING, not a Success with a zero in it.',
    '      const report = describePreview(r, Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt));',
    '      if (report.severity === "success") {',
    '        logSuccess(name, report.message, report.facts);',
    '      } else if (report.severity === "warning") {',
    '        logWarning(name, report.message);',
    '      } else {',
    '        logError(name, report.message);',
    '      }',
    '    } catch (e) {',
    '      // T-035. THE THROWN VALUE NEVER REACHES THE LOG. This used to be',
    '      // String(e), which puts a fetch failure, a JSON parse error or a whole',
    '      // stack trace in front of a plant engineer. describeThrownPreview reads',
    '      // nothing from it and says what to do instead.',
    '      logError(name, describeThrownPreview(e));',
    '    }',
    '  };'
) $ShellEol

    'export type DryRunResult = {',
    '  dryRunId: string; status: string; rowCount: number;',
    '  columns: string[]; rows: unknown[][]; message?: string; sql?: string;',
    '  // T-035. All optional: a client built before the estimate landed is still a',
    '  // valid client, and the log states only what it was actually given.',
    '  // previewTruncated means the preview STOPPED at its limit, so rowCount is a',
    '  // cap and not a total. plannerCost and estimatedRows come from EXPLAIN and',
    '  // are ESTIMATES - not a runtime, not a price.',

$MODEL_SRC = J @(
    '// PPIQ T-035. WHAT THE DEBUG LOG SAYS ABOUT A PREVIEW.',
    '//',
    '// Chapter 4 section 5.2.8: entries typed Error, Warning or Success, each with a',
    '// message written for a plant engineer, plus the returned row count and a cost',
    '// estimate. Never a raw exception string.',
    '//',
    '// The decision lives here rather than inside the click handler so the three',
    '// cases the task names are asserted as facts about a function: a valid preview,',
    '// a preview returning nothing, and a rejected operator.',
    '//',
    '// THE ESTIMATE IS AN ESTIMATE. plannerCost comes from EXPLAIN, which plans the',
    '// statement and runs nothing. It is not a runtime and it is not a price, and',
    '// every sentence here calls it what it is.',
    '',
    'import type { DryRunResult } from "@/api/canvasApi";',
    '',
    'export type PreviewSeverity = "success" | "warning" | "error";',
    '',
    'export interface PreviewReport {',
    '  severity: PreviewSeverity;',
    '  message: string;',
    '  facts?: string;',
    '}',
    '',
    '/** The planner''s numbers, or an empty string when the server sent neither. */',
    'export function describeEstimate(',
    '  plannerCost: number | null | undefined, estimatedRows: number | null | undefined,',
    '): string {',
    '  const parts: string[] = [];',
    '  if (typeof plannerCost === "number") {',
    '    parts.push("planner cost estimate " + Math.round(plannerCost).toLocaleString("en-US"));',
    '  }',
    '  if (typeof estimatedRows === "number") {',
    '    parts.push("planner estimates about " + estimatedRows.toLocaleString("en-US") + " rows");',
    '  }',
    '  return parts.join(", ");',
    '}',
    '',
    '/** The measured facts of a preview: what came back, and how long it took. */',
    'export function describeMeasured(result: DryRunResult, elapsedMs: number): string {',
    '  const parts: string[] = [];',
    '  // "sample rows" and not "rows": the preview stops at a limit, and when it did',
    '  // stop the entry says so rather than presenting the cap as a total.',
    '  parts.push(result.previewTruncated === true',
    '    ? result.rowCount + " sample rows, stopped at the preview limit"',
    '    : result.rowCount + " sample rows");',
    '  parts.push(result.columns.length + " columns: " + result.columns.join(", "));',
    '  parts.push("elapsed " + elapsedMs + " ms");',
    '  const estimate = describeEstimate(result.plannerCost, result.estimatedRows);',
    '  if (estimate !== "") { parts.push(estimate); }',
    '  return parts.join(" | ");',
    '}',
    '',
    'export function describePreview(result: DryRunResult, elapsedMs: number): PreviewReport {',
    '  if (result.status === "succeeded") {',
    '    if (result.rowCount === 0) {',
    '      // A query that ran perfectly and matched nothing is not a success to an',
    '      // engineer who expected rows. It is also NOT evidence that the filter is',
    '      // wrong - the server has no way to know which of the two it is, so the',
    '      // sentence names both possibilities and claims neither.',
    '      return {',
    '        severity: "warning",',
    '        message: "Preview completed successfully but returned 0 rows."',
    '          + " Review the active filters or confirm that the selected source contains matching rows.",',
    '      };',
    '    }',
    '    return { severity: "success", message: "Preview ran.", facts: describeMeasured(result, elapsedMs) };',
    '  }',
    '',
    '  // Everything else is a refusal. The server''s sentence already names what was',
    '  // wrong - the operator, the column, the table - and it is passed through',
    '  // WHOLE, because rewording it here would lose the one specific the engineer',
    '  // needs. The server guarantees it is safe to show.',
    '  const sentence = (result.message ?? "").trim();',
    '  if (sentence === "") {',
    '    return {',
    '      severity: "error",',
    '      message: "The preview was refused and no reason came back with it."',
    '        + " Run it again, and if the refusal repeats without a reason, report this definition.",',
    '    };',
    '  }',
    '  return { severity: "error", message: "The preview was refused. " + sentence };',
    '}',
    '',
    '/**',
    ' * What the log says when the request itself threw.',
    ' *',
    ' * IT READS NOTHING FROM THE THROWN VALUE. A fetch failure, a JSON parse error',
    ' * or a whole stack trace are all things a plant engineer cannot act on and',
    ' * should never be shown. The sentence says what to check instead.',
    ' */',
    'export function describeThrownPreview(_thrown: unknown): string {',
    '  return "The preview did not complete, because the request to the server did not return."',
    '    + " Check that the API is running, then run it again.";',
    '}',
    ''
) $ModelEol

$MODEL_TEST = J @(
    '// PPIQ T-035. The debug-log contract under test.',
    '//',
    '// The three cases the task text names, asserted as facts about a function',
    '// rather than clicked three times in a browser.',
    '',
    'import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";',
    'import type { DryRunResult } from "@/api/canvasApi";',
    'import {',
    '  describeEstimate, describeMeasured, describePreview, describeThrownPreview,',

    '',
    'function result(over: Partial<DryRunResult>): DryRunResult {',
    '  return {',
    '    dryRunId: "d1", status: "succeeded", rowCount: 3,',
    '    columns: ["one", "two"], rows: [], ...over,',
    '  };',
    '}',
    '',
    'describe("a valid preview", () => {',
    '  it("is a Success carrying the row count, the columns and the estimate", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ plannerCost: 12.6, estimatedRows: 1200 }), 42);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("success");',
    '    expect(r.message).toBe("Preview ran.");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("3 sample rows");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("2 columns: one, two");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("elapsed 42 ms");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("planner cost estimate 13");',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("about 1,200 rows");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("says the preview stopped at its limit instead of calling the cap a total", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ rowCount: 50, previewTruncated: true }), 10);',
    '    expect(r.facts).toContain("stopped at the preview limit");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("states only the numbers it was given", () => {',
    '    expect(describeEstimate(undefined, undefined)).toBe("");',
    '    expect(describeEstimate(null, null)).toBe("");',
    '    expect(describeEstimate(9.2, undefined)).toBe("planner cost estimate 9");',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({}), 5);',
    '    expect(r.facts).not.toContain("planner");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("calls the estimate an estimate, never a runtime and never a cost in money", () => {',
    '    const facts = describeMeasured(result({ plannerCost: 100, estimatedRows: 7 }), 1);',
    '    expect(facts).toContain("planner cost estimate");',
    '    expect(facts).toContain("planner estimates about");',
    '  });',
    '});',
    '',
    'describe("a preview that returns nothing", () => {',
    '  it("is a Warning, in the agreed wording", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ rowCount: 0 }), 12);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("warning");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("Preview completed successfully but returned 0 rows.");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("Review the active filters");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("contains matching rows");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("does not claim a cause the server cannot see", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ rowCount: 0 }), 12);',
    '    expect(r.message).not.toContain("too restrictive");',
    '    expect(r.message).not.toContain("filter is wrong");',
    '  });',
    '});',
    '',
    'describe("a rejected operator", () => {',
    '  it("is an Error and the operator survives into the entry", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({',
    '      status: "rejected_by_safe_sql", rowCount: 0,',
    '      message: "operator ''REGEXP'' is not permitted in a filter",',
    '    }), 3);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("error");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("REGEXP");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("not permitted in a filter");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("says so plainly when a refusal arrives with no reason", () => {',
    '    const r = describePreview(result({ status: "failed", rowCount: 0, message: "   " }), 3);',
    '    expect(r.severity).toBe("error");',
    '    expect(r.message).toContain("no reason came back with it");',
    '  });',
    '});',
    '',
    'describe("nothing an engineer cannot act on", () => {',
    '  it("reads nothing at all from a thrown value", () => {',
    '    const thrown = new Error("TypeError: Failed to fetch at http://localhost:5063/api");',
    '    const said = describeThrownPreview(thrown);',
    '    expect(said).not.toContain("TypeError");',
    '    expect(said).not.toContain("http");',
    '    expect(said).toContain("Check that the API is running");',
    '  });',
    '',
    '  it("uses none of the phrases the PPIQ-T09 contract forbids", () => {',
    '    const forbidden = ["could not " + "load", "failed to " + "load", "unable to " + "load"];',
    '    const said = [',
    '      describeThrownPreview(new Error("x")),',
    '      describePreview(result({ rowCount: 0 }), 1).message,',
    '      describePreview(result({ status: "failed", rowCount: 0, message: "" }), 1).message,',
    '      describePreview(result({}), 1).message,',
    '    ].join(" ").toLowerCase();',
    '    for (const phrase of forbidden) {',
    '      expect(said).not.toContain(phrase);',
    '    }',
    '  });',
    '});',
    ''
) $ModelEol

Say "ANCHOR VERIFICATION"
foreach ($p in @(
    @{ N = "preview handler";     A = $A_PREV; H = "S" },
    @{ N = "tree model import";   A = $A_SIMP; H = "S" },
    @{ N = "dry-run result type"; A = $A_API;  H = "A" }
)) {
    if ($p.H -eq "S") { $hay = $ShellText } else { $hay = $ApiText }
    $n = Count-Of $hay $p.A
    if ($n -eq 1) { Ok ($p.N + " found exactly once") } else { Bad ($p.N + " found " + $n + " times, expected exactly 1") }
}
if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) {
    Say ""
    Say ("ANCHOR VERIFICATION FAILED with " + $script:Failures.Count + " problem(s). Nothing was written.")
    exit 1
}
Say ""

if ($ReportOnly) {
    Say "REPORT ONLY - the following WOULD be applied:"
    Say ""
    Say "  previewReport.ts    CREATED - the severity and every word of the entry"
    Say "  previewReport.test.ts CREATED - the three cases the task text names"
    Say "  canvasApi.ts        + previewTruncated, plannerCost, estimatedRows"
    Say "  SharedAuthoringShell.tsx"
    Say "    ~ the preview logs Success, WARNING or Error from the report"
    Say "    - String(e) is REMOVED from the catch"
    Say ""
    Say "Nothing was written. Re-run without -ReportOnly to apply."
    exit 0
}

Say "BACKUP"

Copy-Item $ShellPath (Join-Path $BackupDir "SharedAuthoringShell.tsx") -Force
Copy-Item $ApiPath (Join-Path $BackupDir "canvasApi.ts") -Force
Ok ("backed up to " + $BackupDir)

function Restore-All {
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $BackupDir "SharedAuthoringShell.tsx") $ShellPath -Force
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $BackupDir "canvasApi.ts") $ApiPath -Force
    if (Test-Path $ModelPath) { Remove-Item $ModelPath -Force }
    if (Test-Path $TestPath) { Remove-Item $TestPath -Force }
}

try {
    Write-Text $ModelPath $MODEL_SRC
    Ok "previewReport.ts created"
    Write-Text $TestPath $MODEL_TEST
    Ok "previewReport.test.ts created"
    Write-Text $ApiPath ($ApiText.Replace($A_API, $R_API))
    Ok "canvasApi.ts written"
    Write-Text $ShellPath ($ShellText.Replace($A_SIMP, $R_SIMP).Replace($A_PREV, $R_PREV))
    Ok "SharedAuthoringShell.tsx written"
} catch {
    Say ("  APPLY THREW: " + $_.Exception.Message)
    Restore-All
    Say "  restored. Nothing changed."
    exit 1
}

Say "SELF CHECK"
$script:Failures = @()
$m = Read-Text $ModelPath
$s = Read-Text $ShellPath
$a = Read-Text $ApiPath

foreach ($item in @(
    @{ N = "zero rows is a Warning";               S = 'severity: "warning",'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the agreed wording, verbatim";         S = 'Preview completed successfully but returned 0 rows.'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "no cause is claimed";                  S = 'too restrictive'; H = $m; Absent = $true },
    @{ N = "the refusal sentence passes through";  S = '"The preview was refused. " + sentence'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the estimate is called an estimate";   S = 'planner cost estimate '; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the cap is not called a total";        S = 'stopped at the preview limit'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the thrown value is never read";       S = 'export function describeThrownPreview(_thrown: unknown): string'; H = $m },
    @{ N = "the shell uses the report";            S = 'describePreview(r, Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt))'; H = $m; Skip = $true },
    @{ N = "the shell logs a Warning";             S = 'logWarning(name, report.message);'; H = $s },
    @{ N = "String(e) is gone";                    S = 'String(e)'; H = $s; Absent = $true },
    @{ N = "the safe sentence replaces it";        S = 'logError(name, describeThrownPreview(e));'; H = $s },
    @{ N = "the client carries the estimate";      S = 'plannerCost?: number | null'; H = $a },
    @{ N = "the client carries the cap flag";      S = 'previewTruncated?: boolean'; H = $a },
    @{ N = "PRESERVED: the SQL still reaches the pane"; S = 'sql?: string'; H = $a }
)) {
    if ($item.Skip) { continue }
    $n = Count-Of $item.H $item.S
    if ($item.Absent) {
        if ($n -eq 0) { Ok $item.N } else { Bad ($item.N + " - still present " + $n + " time(s)") }
    } else {
        if ($n -ge 1) { Ok $item.N } else { Bad ($item.N + " - not found") }
    }
}

foreach ($phrase in @(("could not " + "load"), ("failed to " + "load"), ("unable to " + "load"))) {
    if ((Count-Of $m $phrase) -eq 0) { Ok ("no forbidden phrase: " + $phrase) } else { Bad ("previewReport names '" + $phrase + "'") }
}

foreach ($p in @($ModelPath, $TestPath, $ShellPath, $ApiPath)) {
    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p)
    $bad = 0
    foreach ($b in $bytes) { if ($b -gt 127) { $bad++ } }
    if ($bad -ne 0) { Bad ((Split-Path $p -Leaf) + " carries " + $bad + " non-ASCII byte(s)") }
}
if ($script:Failures.Count -eq 0) { Ok "all four files pure ASCII" }

if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) {
    Say ""
    Say "SELF CHECK FAILED. Reverting."
    Restore-All
    Say "  reverted. The tree is as it was."
    exit 1
}

& node node_modules\vitest\vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts src/authoring --reporter=json --outputFile="$jsonOut"
$vitestCode = $LASTEXITCODE
Pop-Location

        Say ("  tests failed : " + $report.numFailedTests)

        foreach ($suite in $report.testResults) {
            foreach ($x in $suite.assertionResults) {
                if ($x.status -eq "failed") { Say ("  FAILED: " + $x.fullName) }
            }
        }
    } catch { Say "  could not parse the vitest JSON report" }
}
if ($vitestCode -ne 0 -or $failed -gt 0) {

    Say "VITEST FAILED. Reverting."

    Restore-All
    Say ("  reverted. Log kept at " + $tscLog)
    exit 1
}

#requires -Version 5.1
<#
  PPIQ T-036 PART 1 - THE AUTHORED-SQL CONTRACT.

  Two measurements decided this pack, and they came out differently.

  PROVENANCE ALREADY EXISTS. saveSqlVersion carries forkedFromGraph and the
  shell snapshots the originating graph, so nothing new is built for it. Only
  forkedSql is missing, and that lands with the shell in part 2.

  TYPES DO NOT. RunSqlResponse carried column NAMES only, so the Run Test panel
  had nothing truthful to show. The reader's own metadata now travels beside
  them - never inferred in the browser from a sample value, because "3" is a
  text column as often as an integer one.

  AND THE HOTFIX HE RULED ON. The execution-failure path appended the database's
  own text to the message, which is the same leak T-035 closed on the dry-run
  path. It now uses the sanitiser T-035 established - REUSED, not
  re-implemented, because a second sanitiser is a second place for the rule to
  drift. SafeDatabaseMessage becomes internal for that and no other reason.

    EDIT    Backend/PlantProcess.Api/Endpoints/Prep/AuthoringSupportEndpoints.cs
    EDIT    Backend/PlantProcess.Api/Endpoints/Prep/VisualMapperEndpoints.cs
    EDIT    Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src/api/canvasApi.ts
    CREATE  Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/T036AuthoredSqlSafetyTests.cs

  THE VALIDATOR IS NOT TOUCHED. SafeSqlValidator, the resolve function and the
  refusal-by-name path are exactly as they were.

  CONTRACT: ReportOnly, revision banner, anchor verification, backup, apply,
  self-check, build + architecture test gate, auto-revert, rollback.
#>

function Write-Text([string]$p, [string]$t) { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))) }
function Count-Of([string]$hay, [string]$needle) { return ([regex]::Matches($hay, [regex]::Escape($needle))).Count }
function Eol-Of([string]$t) { if ($t.Contains("`r`n")) { return "`r`n" } return "`n" }

function Restore-All {

<#
  PPIQ T-036 PART 2a - THE SQL MODE MODEL.

  Three decisions, none of them rendering, so they land as a pure module with
  tests before any editor markup changes.

    CREATE  src/authoring/sqlModeModel.ts
    CREATE  src/authoring/sqlModeModel.test.ts

  1. RECONSTRUCTABILITY, FAIL CLOSED. His ruling: prove it or ask. The only
     case this product can PROVE is that the authored SQL is still the SQL the
     current graph compiled to. So the test is a strict comparison with
     line-ending and outer-whitespace normalisation and NOTHING ELSE. No parser
     is built, no regex claims to understand SQL, and a harmless reformat
     produces a confirmation prompt - which is the acceptable direction to be
     wrong in. Silently reconstructing SQL that is not equivalent is not.

  2. COMPLETIONS FROM THE LIVE CATALOGUE, the same one the schema tree reads.
     No word list, no second catalogue, no plant vocabulary. A column
     completion carries the table it belongs to, because two tables in a join
     can both have a column of the same name.

  3. THE RUN TEST REPORT pairs each returned column with the DATABASE type the
     server measured and one representative sample value. When the server sent
     no type, the report says so rather than guessing from the sample - which
     is exactly the inference his ruling forbids.

  Purely additive. Nothing that renders today changes; part 2b wires it.

  CONTRACT: ReportOnly, revision banner, self-check, vitest + tsc gate,
  auto-revert, rollback.
#>
